entries.zh: §S《Megacorp》§!是一个以经济为重心的扩展包，为商业带来更多的复杂性，帮助你在竞争激烈的市场中获得优势。
entries.en: §SMegacorp§! is an economy-focused expansion which brings greater complexity to commerce and helps you gain an upper hand in competitive markets.

entries.zh: 我们推荐§S《寰宇企业》§!，因为该帝国的特质与其侧重商业的机制及主题相吻合。
entries.en: We're recommending §SMegacorp§! as the makeup of this empire suits its commerce-focused mechanics and themes.

entries.zh: 我们推荐选择§SMegacorp§!，因为该帝国的特质完美契合其中以强硬手段管理人力资源的核心玩法。
entries.en: We're recommending §SMegacorp§! as the makeup of this empire suits one of its themes, namely the ruthless management of human resources.

§E$PLANET_HOUSING_TITLE$代表着住家、公寓、以及各种可以容纳居民的建筑和设施。无法满足其人口住房需求的殖民地将会受到$r_stability$方面的惩罚。§!
entries.en: §E$PLANET_HOUSING_TITLE$ represents homes, apartments and other infrastructure dedicated to housing its inhabitants. A Colony that does not meet the Housing needs of its drone population will suffer penalties to $r_stability$.§!

entries.zh: §t§H稳定度§!是量化殖民地上的工作单位整体效率的指标。该指标主要受影响于所有子个体对于§H$PLANET_HOUSING_TITLE$§!和§H$PLANET_AMENITIES_TITLE$§!的基础需求是否得到满足。\n\n拥有高$PLANET_STABILITY_TITLE$的殖民地会获得资源生产加成，而拥有低$PLANET_STABILITY_TITLE$的殖民地则会受到惩罚，甚至会引发诸如全面§H叛乱§!（如果殖民地上有非格式塔人口的存在）等负面事件。§!
entries.en: §t§HStability§! is a measure of the overall functionality of the drone population on the colony. It is primarily determined by ensuring that all drones have their basic needs for §H$PLANET_HOUSING_TITLE$§! and §H$PLANET_AMENITIES_TITLE$§! fulfilled.\n\nA colony with high $PLANET_STABILITY_TITLE$ will have increased resource production, while a colony with low $PLANET_STABILITY_TITLE$ will suffer penalties and may experience negative events or even a full-scale §HRevolt§! if there are non-drone Pops present on the colony.§!

entries.en:
§t§HDeviancy§! is a measure of the overall level of anomalous behavior and non-compliance of a £colony£ ['concept_colony'].

A high level of §HDeviancy§! causes negative events to occur on the colony and may reduce £stability£ ['concept_stability'].

It is naturally caused by having a large population, and can be reduced by employing £job_patrol_drone£ §H$job_patrol_drone_plural$§!.§!

entries.en: Remove the currently prioritized species, allowing for the assembly of any valid species on $PLANET|Y$. The choice of species to be assembled will immediately be re-evaluated.\n\nIf a switch from §Yorganic§! to §Yrobotic§! pop assembly or vice versa is made as a result, this will cost us §R100%§! of our current assembly progress. Otherwise, if the newly-picked species is different to the current one, $VALUE|0%R$ of our progress will be lost.

$SYSTEM|Y$ already have a destination for routing

entries.zh: 这座恒星基地是$NAME|Y$的贸易首都。所有抵达这座恒星基地的贸易额都将转换成其它更有用的资源。
entries.en: This starbase is the Trade Capital of $NAME|Y$. All Trade that reaches this starbase will be converted into other more useful resources.

entries.zh: §E要建立一条通往你的贸易首都的贸易路线，先点击你想要连接的贸易中心，然后右键点击你的贸易首都§!
entries.en: §ETo create a trade Route to your Trade Capital, click the Trade Hub you want to connect and then right-click on your Trade Capital§!

entries.zh: 这座§H恒星基地§!收集的$r_trade$必须经由§H贸易路线§!送至我们的§Y贸易首都§!的§H恒星基地§!，才能变为可用的资源。
entries.en: The $r_trade$ that is collected by this §HStarbase§! needs to be transported along §HTrade Routes§! to our §YTrade Capital§! §HStarbase§! in order to be converted into actual resources.

entries.zh: §E要从这座§H恒星基地§!创建一个§H贸易路线§!，右键点击我们的§Y贸易首都§!的§H恒星基地§!，或是任何其它有效§Y贸易中心§!的§H恒星基地§!目的地§!。
entries.en: §ETo create a §HTrade Route§! from this §HStarbase§!, right-click our §YTrade Capital§! §HStarbase§! or any other valid §YTrade Hub§! §HStarbase§! destination§!.

entries.zh: 贸易路线价值：£trade_value£ $VALUE|Y2$\n最大海盗活动：£trade_value£ $MAX|+=2$\n海盗活动效果：£trade_value£ $EFFECTS|+=2$
因§H贸易额§!大于§H海盗镇压度§!，§H当前海盗活动§!将在£time£ $DAYS|Y$天内增长至最大值。
entries.en: Because §HTrade Value§! is greater than §HPiracy Suppression§!, §HCurrent Piracy§! will grow to its maximum value in £time£ $DAYS|Y$ days.

entries.en: To reduce §HPiracy§!, have your fleets §HPatrol§! this system. Smaller ships have higher §HPiracy Suppression§! value.

entries.en: §HFeatures§!\nHere is shown any §Yblockers§! or §Yrare features§! the colony has, as well as the features that provide its districts.

entries.zh: §E£job£§H$concept_jobs$§!代表了£pop£['concept_pops']在帝国内所承担的角色和职业，决定了资源产出、科研成果和社会运转。§!
entries.en: §E£job£ §H$concept_jobs$§! represent the roles and professions that £pop£ ['concept_pops'] undertake within an empire, determining resource production, research output, and societal function.§!

entries.zh: 我们需要更多的§H情报§!才能探明殖民地特征。
entries.en: We need more §HIntel§! to reveal features.

entries.zh: §E$POP_ASSEMBLY_TITLE$代表着殖民地人工制造新人口的总能力。对于大部分类型的帝国来说，人口组装来自于[roboticist.GetIcon]§Y[roboticist.GetName]§!等岗位，用于组装£pop£ §Y机械人口§!，但蜂巢思维和特定克隆装置可以自己组装活体人口。§!
entries.en: §E$POP_ASSEMBLY_TITLE$ represents the total capacity the colony has to artificially create new pops. For most types of empires, Pop Assembly comes from [roboticist.GetIcon] §Y[roboticist.GetName]§! jobs and is used to build £pop£ §YRobot Pops§!, but Organic Pop Assembly in Hives or from certain cloning facilities can build living creatures.§!

entries.zh: §H卫戍军§!\n卫戍军是行星上§Y防御部队§!与§Y进攻部队§!军力的总和。
entries.en: §HGarrison Army§!\nThe Garrison is the combined strength of §YDefense Armies§! and §YAssault Armies§! on the planet.

entries.zh: §H进攻部队§!\n这些部队可以登船并对其他行星执行入侵。
entries.en: §HAssault Army§!\nThese armies can be embarked and used for invasion on other planets.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$必须有£engineering_research£§Y$tech_droid_workers$§!科技才可以使用机器人进行殖民。
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$The £engineering_research£ §Y$tech_droid_workers$§! technology is required to colonize with Robots.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$该物种没有足够的智能，无法自行殖民。
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$This species has insufficient mental capacity to colonize on their own.

entries.en: This colony currently has §Y$NUM$/$MAX$§! total districts built.

entries.en: This job can only be worked by Free Pops that are not being purged.

entries.zh: 这个岗位仅能由自由人口或是被允许参军的奴隶兵人口从事。
entries.en: This job can only be worked by Free or Battle Thrall Pops that are allowed to serve in the military.

entries.zh: 这个岗位仅能由那些当前没有在被净化的人口从事。
entries.en: This job can only be worked by Pops that are not being purged.

entries.zh: 这个岗位仅能由那些被允许参军的人口从事。
entries.en: This job can only be worked by Pops that are allowed to serve in the military.

entries.zh: 这个岗位仅能由那些当前没有在被净化的无人机从事。
entries.en: This job can only be worked by Drones that are not being purged.

entries.zh: 这些密集的城市中心地带为办公人员提供了大量住房和办公区。
entries.en: These dense urban centers provide large amounts of housing and office space for clerical workers.

entries.zh: 这些特殊的巨城区划利用整合式垂直建筑，可实现地表面积人口密度最大化。
entries.en: With these special ecumenopolistic city districts, integrated vertical architecture is utilized to maximize population density over land surface area.

entries.zh: 这座巨城区划以军工为目的，熔炉的嘶吼与铸造厂的哐铛声在里面不断回响。
entries.en: Geared towards military industries, this ecumenopolis district is filled with the roar of smelters and the clang of metallurgies.

entries.zh: 这座区划的阶层街道两侧布满了工匠作坊和民用工厂。
entries.en: Workshops filled with artisans and civilian industries line the stacked streets of this district.

entries.zh: 巨城的居民们在这里打发休闲时光。
entries.en: Where denizens of the ecumenopolis unwind in their leisure hours.

entries.zh: 成群结队的行政文员和官僚们甘做牛马，以满足一个正在扩张的官僚体系不断提出的全新要求。
entries.en: Where hordes of administrative staff and bureaucrats toil away to meet the growing expectations of an expanding bureaucracy.

entries.zh: 这些尖塔是我们信仰虔敬的真鉴与实证，关乎我们整个帝国的精神福祉。
entries.en: A true testament to our devotion, these spires may hold the key to the spiritual well-being of our empire.

entries.zh: 这些高耸的建筑由人工智能控制的人工气候，可以模仿智慧有机生物需要的任何环境。其中的有机生物的住房需求可以完全被满足。
entries.en: These towering structures feature AI-controlled artificial climates that mimic any environment a sapient organic being could require. The organics within have their housing needs completely fulfilled.

entries.zh: 这些采矿城镇和资源提取中心为了获取到大量矿物资源而挖了钻井直达地下深处。
entries.en: These mining towns and resource extraction centers drill deep into the mantle to access mineral deposits.

entries.zh: 那些农耕的土地要么用来种庄稼，要么用来放牧动物。
entries.en: Land set aside for cultivation, either through the growing of crops or animal husbandry.

entries.zh: 一排排的大型发电厂可以生成大量的能源，这些能源可以用来做其他事情，也可以转化为能量币。
entries.en: Rows of massive power plants that generate large amounts of energy which can then be used or converted into energy credits.

entries.zh: 当子个体不在工作时，就会集结于这些高耸的尖塔之处摄取营养素。
entries.en: These towering spires are where the drones gather when not working to rejuvenate and consume nutrients.

entries.zh: 被控制并部署到工作岗位的无人机来自于这些集中区划。
entries.en: Centralized districts from which drones are controlled and deployed to their work assignments.

entries.zh: 该区划遍布着冶炼设施和工厂，以原材料制造出先进的产品。
entries.en: Smelting facilities and factories fill this district, creating advanced products out of raw materials.

entries.zh: 度假村、休养场所和娱乐场所，休息、放纵和完美避世所需的一切应有尽有。
entries.en: Resorts, retreats, and pleasure domes. Everything required for rest, indulgence, and the perfect escape.

entries.zh: 一个充满活力的空间，在这里，精彩体验被精心打造，珍贵回忆悄然诞生，无数奇妙等待着你的探索。
entries.en: A vibrant space where experiences are crafted, memories are made, and countless wonders await.

entries.zh: 囚室、哨塔、高墙和安检口。这里的一切都是为了这个社会的囚犯的收容和改造而生。
entries.en: Cells, guard towers, high walls, and security checkpoints. All are designed for the containment and rehabilitation of society's detainees.

entries.zh: 车间、工厂、监视系统以及牢固的围墙，目的是在安全有序的范围内进行拘留和生产劳动。
entries.en: Workshops, factories, surveillance systems, and fortified barriers for detainment and productive labor within the bounds of security and order.

entries.zh: 利用纳米交易系统和神经化学保存算法，这些开发商为无数智慧生命消费者们带来最新的虚拟娱乐软件。
entries.en: Using nano-transaction systems and neuro-chemical retention algorithms, these development houses bring the latest in virtual entertainment software into the homes and lives of billions of sapient consumers.

entries.zh: 这些殖民地企业工厂生产并组装各种必不可少的舰船部件。
entries.en: These colony-based corporate factories produce and assemble a variety of components that are vital in starship construction.

entries.zh: 这间办公室可让当地居民加入惊险刺激的企业佣兵生涯。丰厚的薪资、有限的健康保险以及传奇冒险故事确保了新兵源源不绝。
entries.en: This office allows locals to sign up for the exciting life of a corporate soldier of fortune. Generous compensation, limited health insurance and stories of adventure ensure a steady stream of recruits.

entries.zh: 这里的环境轻松惬意，很适合商讨生意。权贵，当地经济领袖，以及其它重要人物可以在这里会见企业代表。
entries.en: Movers and shakers, local economic leaders, and other important figures can meet with corporate representatives here in a relaxed, soothing environment ideal for the creation of new business deals.

entries.zh: 无数高耸拥挤的格子间组成的无尽的贫民窟，用于以最小的成本最大限度地容纳个体。
entries.en: Endless slums of towering, densely packed housing are designed to hold the maximum number of individuals with minimal upkeep.

entries.zh: 实用的兵营和致命的训练场地旨在打造最凶猛的战斗仆从军。
entries.en: Utilitarian barracks and deadly training grounds designed to forge the most ferocious battle thralls.

entries.zh: 行星§Y分部价值§!将提升该建筑的§Y产出§!。
entries.en: Planetary §YBranch Office Value§! improves this building's §YProduction§!.

\n$trade_value_from$：殖民地上每$pop_group_unit$§Y消费品§!或§Y合金§!岗位§G+0.5%§!\n$branch_office_building_trade_bonus$

entries.zh: 可以让你梦想成真的神奇场所，这座游乐城提供老少皆宜、企业认可的家庭娱乐项目。
entries.en: A magical place where dreams can become reality, this megaplex features wholesome, corporate-sanctioned fun for the entire family unit.

entries.zh: 一家寰宇企业旗下的私人采矿公司。其雇佣当地矿工以攫取该星球的财富。
entries.en: A private mineral extraction company owned by a megacorporation. It employs local miners to access the planet's wealth.

entries.zh: 实惠、方便、营养价值无可挑剔。没有毒素*、没有麻烦！\n\n*食物中可能含有微量苯甲酸钾、硝酸、暗物质、人肉制品和烟熏液。
entries.en: Affordable, fast, and with a perfectly acceptable nutritional value. Zero toxins* and zero hassle!\n\n* Food may contain traces of potassium benzoate, nitric acid, dark matter, soylent green and liquid smoke.

entries.zh: 任何大企业都躲不开误解与怀疑。广开言路符合公众利益，而这家公关公司正是为其雇主的诉求所生。
entries.en: Misconceptions and suspicions are always floating around any large corporate entity. It is in the public's interest to hear out all sides of any dispute, and this PR firm makes it their business to get their employer's point across.

entries.zh: 在这些最先进的设施里，私人科技企业为其母公司进行着重要的科技研发。
entries.en: In these state-of-the-art facilities, private tech-enterprises carry out important research and development on behalf of their parent company.

entries.zh: 一座戒备森严的神殿，为建造它的大教会传播福音。
entries.en: A high-security temple that spreads the gospel of the Megachurch that built it.

entries.zh: 为企业高层人员而建的豪华度假村。他们可以在这高度安全的环境中品味当地文化。
entries.en: A luxurious resort complex for high ranking corporate officers. Here they can sample the local culture in a high security environment.

entries.zh: 该企业中介提供各种星际旅游的宣传服务，同时也为希望搬至企业空间的移民者提供就业福利与签约奖励。
entries.en: This corporate agency promotes a wide variety of interstellar tourist attractions, as well as offering employment packages and signing bonuses to potential emigrants interested in relocating to corporate space.

entries.zh: 位于偏远地区的地下药物实验室，从地表几乎无法发现它的存在。化学家在这里日夜不停地工作，生产各种非法、极易上瘾且利润丰厚的毒品。
entries.en: Subterranean drug labs in remote regions that are virtually undetectable from the surface. Chemists work day and night here to produce various illegal, highly addictive and quite lucrative narcotics.

entries.zh: 被盗、被劫赃船于此处被拆成废铁。任何有价值的部件与合金都会被小心地回收。
entries.en: Stolen vessels and prize ships brought in by pirates are broken into scrap here. Any valuable components and alloys are carefully salvaged.

entries.zh: 这些非法俱乐部可以满足宾客的种种邪欲。夜幕降临后，它们在殖民地上乌烟瘴气之处开始营业。
entries.en: These illegal entertainment clubs will satisfy any vice. As night descends, they are open for business in the colony's seedier districts.

entries.zh: 位于殖民地上的一座隐秘城市，海盗与流氓聚集于此修理舰船，顺带插科打诨。
entries.en: A secluded and hidden city on the colony, where pirates and other lowlifes can congregate to repair their ships and trade stories.

entries.zh: 此违章太空港每天吞吐大量非法货物，由于区域隐蔽，加之行贿阔绰，目前仍未被发现。
entries.en: An unauthorized spaceport that remains off the records thanks to secrecy and generous bribes. Large volumes of illegal cargo passes through here every day.

entries.zh: 此开采作业行事违法、环境高危，穷困潦倒者在此拼命劳作，妄图一夜暴富。
entries.en: Illegal, highly unsafe mining operations operated by the destitute and the desperate, who toil away in the vain hopes of striking it rich.

entries.zh: 这些地下设施将不忠的员工和其它令人反胃的有机物质加工成即食食品。
entries.en: Underground facilities where disloyal employees and other forms of unsavory bio-matter are reprocessed into ready-to-eat food products.

entries.zh: 这些企业表面合法，可以掩护当地犯罪集团的非法活动。
entries.en: These above-the-board businesses allow the local criminal syndicate to operate behind a veneer of upstanding legality.

entries.zh: 这些秘密实验室里进行着各种极端非法的研究。
entries.en: All manner of highly illegal research and development is carried out in these secret laboratories.

entries.zh: 邪教集团的追随者们聚集和举行仪式的地点。
entries.en: A meeting place for followers of the Subversive Cult to gather and conduct their ceremonies.

entries.zh: 与公共安全部队不同，该私营公司专注于维稳和安保，不会顾及一些鸡毛蒜皮的道德关切。
entries.en: Unlike public security forces, this private firm prioritizes order and security over trivial ethical or moral concerns.

entries.zh: 以极低的成本向国有生产商提供外星零部件的独立供应商。
entries.en: Independent suppliers provide state producers with off-world components at a fraction of the cost.

entries.zh: 这座设施专用于宣扬渗透在殖民地上进行的每一笔交易中的独特企业文化。
entries.en: A site dedicated to glorifying the unique corporate culture that permeates every business transaction conducted on the colony.

entries.zh: 在这座设施里，关于殖民地商业文化的关键决策将被制订成战略，并由智慧生命资源专家进行潜意识重点测试。
entries.en: A facility where crucial decisions concerning the business culture of the colony can by strategized and subconsciously focus-tested by sapient resource specialists.

entries.zh: 一座巨大的超光速通讯论坛，可以合作协调数百万企业分部的企业文化。
entries.en: A massive FTL communications forum capable of synergizing the corporate culture of millions of corporate subdivisions.

entries.zh: 一座巨大的地下宝库，既是商业指挥中心，也是纪念这家寰宇企业长久盈利史的公共博物馆。
entries.en: An enormous underground vault that serves the dual purpose of business coordination site and public museum to the long and profitable history of the Megacorporation that built it.

entries.zh: 该工厂使用极为先进的纳米材料大量生产各种稀有资源。缺少纳米材料时生产将会暂停。
entries.en: This factory mass-produces a variety of rare resources using extremely advanced nanites. A Nanite deficit will halt production.

entries.zh: 一座复杂的官僚机构，负责管理人口众多的居住站。
entries.en: An extensive complex of bureaucratic offices that oversees the administration of a highly-populated habitat.

entries.zh: 大型天体产生的£mod_planet_max_districts_add£ 最大区划槽：§G+$@hab_districts_per_major_body_tier3|2$§!\n
entries.en: £mod_planet_max_districts_add£ Max District Slots from Major Celestial Bodies: §G+$@hab_districts_per_major_body_tier3|2$§!\n

entries.zh: 一座规模庞大的官僚机构复合体，负责人口众多的居住站的行政监管。
entries.en: A huge sprawling complex of bureaucratic offices that oversees the administration of a highly-populated habitat.

entries.zh: 大型天体产生的£mod_planet_max_districts_add£ 最大区划槽：§G+$@hab_districts_per_major_body_tier4|2$§!\n

entries.zh: 居住站的住宅区划，可为其居民提供舒适紧致的居所。
entries.en: A habitat housing district provides comfortable, if compact residences for its population.

entries.zh: 错综复杂的居住站商业区划，商人和销售员们在这里进行买卖。
entries.en: A sprawling habitat trading district where merchants and clerks conduct business.

entries.zh: 有了这样的居住站娱乐中心，谁还需要大自然呢？
entries.en: Who needs the great outdoors, with hubs of habitat entertainment like these?

entries.zh: 居住站上的发电区划可生产能量币，同时也为理想城自身供电。
entries.en: Habitat-side energy production plant districts generate energy credits, as well as provide power to the arcology on which they are built.

entries.zh: 这些居住站区划是科学发现的中心，汇集了无数科研领域的研究者们。
entries.en: Centers of scientific discovery, these habitat districts employ researchers from myriad fields of study.

entries.zh: 这一居住站区划遍布工业生产设施，充分利用低重力的优势。
entries.en: Industrial machinery fills this habitat district, taking full advantage of the benefits of low gravity.

entries.zh: 每一个非都市星球只能建立一个工业焦点建筑。
entries.en: Only one industrial focus building can be built per non-Ecumenopolis planet.

entries.zh: 这些人口不属于任何特定的社会阶层。
entries.en: These pops do not belong to any specific stratum.

entries.zh: 我们人口中未就业、受教育或受培训的部分。会四处寻找工作机会。
entries.en: The segment of our population not currently engaged in employment, education or training. Will travel for work.

entries.zh: §H居民§!是帝国中最普普通通的居住者。他们在这个庞大的系统中居住、工作，却又没有占据任何权力地位或特殊智能。无论是生为一具血肉、一段代码或是集体意志，他们都是这个文明的培养基。\n\n§H平民§!和§H维护子个体§!是两种典型的§H居民§!。
entries.en: §HDenizens§! are the everyday inhabitants of an empire. Those who live, work, and exist within its vast systems without holding positions of power or specialization. Whether born of flesh, code, or collective will, they are the living substrate of civilization.\n\n§HCivilians§! and §HMaintenance Drones§! are examples of §HDenizens§!.

entries.zh: 这些机械仆从服从其主人的指令。
entries.en: Mechanical servants bound to the will of their masters.
Career criminals living beyond the reach of the law.

entries.zh: 这些反常的子个体拒绝遵从蜂巢的意志。
entries.en: Deviants who have rejected the will of the Hive Mind.

entries.zh: 这些濒危的土著物种被保存在一个完美复制其原生环境的保留地中。
entries.en: Endangered primitive species that are kept preserved in a perfect replica of their natural environment.

entries.zh: 一个远古的失落帝国的主体物种，这些先驱者们所拥有的科技奇迹是年轻物种连做梦都不曾企及的。
entries.en: The dominant species in an ancient Fallen Empire, these precursors live among technological marvels that the younger races can only dream of.

entries.zh: 尽管仍算是原始的野兽，可它们的行为中却透露出一定程度的智慧……
entries.en: Simple beasts to an extent, and yet their behavior betrays some degree of intelligence...

entries.zh: 腐化的无人机不再依照核心智慧设定的指令行动。
entries.en: Corrupted drone units operating outside the parameters set by the core intelligence.

entries.zh: 由于已被认作是其主人的合法财产，这些契约劳工既没有酬劳也没有出人头地的机会。
entries.en: Considered the rightful property of their masters for life, these indentured laborers toil without renumeration or prospect of advancement.

entries.zh: 免除了伤害、苦难、甚至是自灭倾向的威胁，这些活着的生体陈设衣食无忧，一群不知疲倦的仆从随时满足他们的一切需求。
entries.en: Sheltered from harm, suffering, and even their own self-destructive tendencies, Bio-Trophies want for nothing; their every need tended to and provided for by a team of tireless servitors.

entries.zh: 这些$pop_cat_bio_trophy_plural$长期被忽视，缺乏我们的关怀与守护，任由它们暴露在银河的严酷环境之中。它们的境遇，正是我们失职的明证。
entries.en: These $pop_cat_bio_trophy_plural$ are neglected and without our care, exposing them to the cruelty of the galaxy. Their existence is our failure.

entries.zh: 无法被社会容纳之人将被清除，彻底而永久。
entries.en: Those that have no place in society will be removed from it. Permanently.

entries.zh: 这些一般工人是工农业、制造业以及基本服务的中坚力量。
entries.en: These general laborers form the backbone of industrial and agricultural production, manufacturing, and basic services.

entries.zh: 这些工人在高度专业化的领域中生产先进产品，以及提供专业服务。
entries.en: These are the workers who provide advanced goods and services in highly-specialized fields.

entries.zh: 领袖的领导和行政能力对殖民地的管理极为重要，尽管这是件艰巨的重任。
entries.en: The heads of leadership and administration on a colony are vital to its management, uneasy though they may rest.

entries.zh: 这些子个体负责执行高度专业化的复杂任务。
entries.en: These drones perform complex tasks that require a high degree of specialization.

entries.zh: 这些无人机负责基础工业生产，并提供基本服务。
entries.en: These drones are tasked with basic industrial production and the provision of general services.

entries.zh: 公民们享有四处漫游之自由。他们想要的就是在该殖民地上肆意地探索。
entries.en: Citizens embracing the freedom to wander. The colony's indulgences are theirs to explore.

entries.zh: 帝国思潮使£job_tourist£$job_tourist_plural$产生额外效果：$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—£mod_ethic_attraction_mult£§Y主流思潮吸引力§![GettouristSpiMatOutput][GettouristEgalAuthOutput][GettouristMilPacOutput][GettouristXenoOutput]

entries.zh: 装备现代化动力钻头与先进机械设备，这些子个体可提取有价值的矿物，用于工业、军事以及消费品生产。
entries.en: Equipped with modern power drills and advanced machinery, these drones extract and prepare valuable minerals for industrial, military, and consumer use.

entries.zh: 专门训练军事无人机与舰队终端的军事专业化无人机。
entries.en: Military experts who specialize in the training of new army drones and naval crew.

entries.zh: 专门从地层中小心地开采并精炼稀有水晶的矿机。
entries.en: Miners specialized in carefully extracting and refining rare crystals from geological formations.

entries.zh: 因为这种奇异微粒的易爆特性，专门捕获并采集这些微粒的无人机需要频繁更替。
entries.en: Due to the inherently volatile nature of preternatural motes, the drones who specialize in trapping and harvesting them have a high turnover rate.

entries.zh: 这些无人机专精于使用先进的水力压裂技术将岩床中的异星天然气提取出来。
entries.en: These specialized drones employ advanced hydraulic fracking methods to free rare, exotic gases from promising rock beds.

entries.zh: 粮食生产需要大量劳动力从事一系列的耕种、收割、浇水、施肥、消灭害虫等等的工作。
entries.en: Food production requires a variety of workers, from operators of planting and harvesting machinery, to watering, fertilizer and pesticide systems managers, to livestock handlers.

entries.zh: 负责监管发电厂运营的机工、作业及技术子个体。
entries.en: The machinists, operators, and technicians who manage and oversee power plant operations.

entries.zh: 这些子个体通过精密的温度操纵、营养供应、以及消除感染等步骤，在孵化池内来照料幼年体。
entries.en: By careful management of temperatures, nutrition, and infection prevention, these drones tend to the spawning pools that produce young.

entries.zh: §H\n产卵池只能组装蜂巢思维物种。\n§!
entries.en: §H\nOnly Hive-Minded species may be assembled by the Spawning Pools.\n§!

entries.zh: 负责生产生产机械人的机械人……
entries.en: A machine that builds a machine that builds a machine that...

entries.zh: 这些特化的工蜂监管生物幼体的培育，可以确保我们的义体工蜂后代可以发展成为对集体有用的成员。
entries.en: Designed to nurture, these specialized drones oversee the growth of young biologicals, preparing them to become integral cybernetic contributors to the collective.

entries.zh: [gestation_drone.GetIcon][gestation_drone.GetNamePlural]将$r_alloys$和$r_food$（或$r_minerals$）转化为$r_society$、$r_engineering$、£mod_planet_amenities_add£§Y$PLANET_AMENITIES_TITLE$§!以及全帝国的£mod_logistic_growth_mult£§Y$MOD_LOGISTIC_GROWTH_MULT$§!。
作为突触结构的宏观体现，这些子个体专注于强化主脑所传播的指令信息无缝持续而不受干扰。
entries.en: The macroscopic embodiment of a synapse, these drones focus on amplifying the overmind's ceaseless messages, and cleaning them of distortions.

entries.zh: 发至和发自智能核心的信号必须被放大、增强，并清除静电干扰及数据损坏。
entries.en: Signals to and from the Core must be amplified, boosted, and cleaned of static and data corruption.

entries.zh: 发至和发自子个体的信号必须被放大、分析，铲除反常。
entries.en: Signals to and from the Drones must be amplified, analyzed and cleaned of deviancy.

entries.zh: 服务于机械智能的机器、系统和基础设施必须时刻维护。子个体也是同样的道理。
entries.en: The machinery, systems and infrastructure that serve our needs must be constantly maintained. As must other drones.

entries.zh: 这些子个体是集体后勤系统的大动脉，保障着无数其他子个体的资源供给。
entries.en: These drones serve as the arteries of the collective's supply lines, ensuring every other drone receives required resources.

entries.zh: 可以垄断贸易网络来满足后勤需求，高效运输资源和设备。
entries.en: The trade network can be monopolized for logistic needs, to efficiently shift resources and gear around.

entries.zh: 子个体会不知疲倦地把补给和资源带到我们需要的地方。
entries.en: Drones will diligently carry supplies and resources wherever we need them.

entries.zh: 科学探索、研究与发明创新：脑部子个体是负责指引国家的科技发展的关键部分。
entries.en: Scientists, researchers, and inventors: Brain Drones are responsible for the technological development of the nation.

entries.zh: 演算者会反复地计算、推演、以及测试新的功能，它引导机械智能科技的发展。
entries.en: Endlessly processing equations, probabilities, and testing new functions, Calculators lead the technological development of the Machine Intelligence.
