entries.en: Endlessly processing equations, probabilities, and testing new functions, Calculators lead the technological development of the Machine Intelligence.

entries.zh: 演算者会反复地计算、推演、以及测试新的功能，它引导机械智能科技的发展。
entries.en: Endlessly processing equations, probabilities, and testing new functions, Calculators lead the technological development of the Machine Intelligence.

entries.zh: 珍贵的矿物质由高度专业化的制造者加工成牢固的合金以用作海军发展和高级建筑材料。
entries.en: Valuable minerals are processed into durable alloys for naval development and advanced construction by highly-specialized Fabricators.

entries.zh: 各种各样的消费品和必需品都是由这些子个体所生产。另外，偶尔迸发出的美学创作也并非乏善可陈。
entries.en: A variety of consumable goods and necessities are manufactured by these artisanal drones. Additionally, the occasional aesthetic creation is not entirely without merits.

entries.zh: 珍贵的矿物质由高度专业化的铸造子个体加工成牢固的合金以用作海军发展和高级建筑材料。
entries.en: Valuable minerals are processed into durable alloys for naval development and advanced construction by highly-specialized Foundry Drones.

entries.zh: 反常和机能腐败都是影响集体意识稳定性的不和谐成分，因此必须被铲除掉。
entries.en: Deviancy and function corruption that threatens the stability of the collective must be remedied.

entries.zh: 化合子个体负责通过复杂的化学过程将易爆微粒从矿物中精炼出来，而不是去维持微粒捕获阱。
entries.en: Rather than maintain systems of mote traps, Chem-Drones distill volatile motes directly from minerals through a series of complex chemical processes.

entries.zh: 稀有水晶有时候很难被发掘，但我们可以通过将矿物半透明化进行替代。透镜子个体正是专门负责此工作的。
entries.en: Those rare crystals that cannot be found can be manufactured via translucing instead. Lensing Drones specialize in just that.

entries.zh: 异星天然气精炼厂的管理和运作是由这些子个体所负责。
entries.en: The management and operation of exotic gas refineries is handled by these drones.
The settling of a new world is no easy undertaking.

entries.zh: [colonist.GetIcon][colonist.GetNamePlural]产出少量的$r_food$（或$r_minerals$）和£mod_planet_amenities_add£§Y$PLANET_AMENITIES_TITLE$§!，并产生£defense_army£§Y防御部队§!。
entries.en: [colonist.GetIcon] [colonist.GetNamePlural] produce a small amount of $r_food$ (or $r_minerals$) and £mod_planet_amenities_add£ §Y$PLANET_AMENITIES_TITLE$§!, and spawn £defense_army£ §YDefense Armies§!.

entries.zh: 在现代化的电力机械钻头和其他高科技工具的帮助下，虽然采矿再也不是过去那种会让人累断腰腿的体力活，但这工作也绝不轻松。
entries.en: With modern power drills and other advanced tools, mining may not be the back-breaking profession it once was, but it is still far from easy.

entries.zh: 这些稀有水晶需要依靠专业的矿工通过谨慎的采掘方式来挖掘并精炼。
entries.en: Specialist miners are employed for the careful extraction and refinement of rare crystals.

entries.zh: 采掘微粒的工作是非常危险的，因为过程中需要将易爆微粒封装起来以用作燃料或炸药。
entries.en: One of the most dangerous professions, mote harvesting involves trapping and sealing volatile motes to be used as fuel or explosives.

entries.zh: 气体采集工使用先进的水力压裂技术来采掘岩床中的异星天然气。
entries.en: Advanced hydraulic fracking methods are employed by Gas Extractors in order to free rare, exotic gases from promising rock beds.

entries.zh: 从舒适的座椅上站起，去玉米田里实际耕作一番，才会明白务农有多难。
entries.en: Farming looks mighty easy when your plow is a pencil and you're a thousand miles from the corn field.

entries.zh: 发电厂需要很多人力去操作设备并监控设备运行。
entries.en: Power plants require plenty of warm bodies to operate equipment and oversee operations.

entries.zh: 对于任何一个体系庞杂的工作环境来说，白领职员负责处理的管理行政类工作都是至关重要的。真是一个毫无希望且即将淘汰的职业啊。
entries.en: White-collar workers perform the various administrative office tasks that are crucial to any sufficiently complex working environment. A hopelessly outdated profession.

entries.zh: 繁荣传道者为普罗大众带来好消息：只要捐献一点微薄的财富，你也能繁荣富裕。
entries.en: Prosperity Preachers spread the good word to the masses that they, too, can prosper, if only they will part with a small donation to the cause.

entries.zh: 这些度假村负责殷勤款待的工匠致力于创造难以忘怀的假期体验。他们辛勤工作，为你操办一切。
entries.en: Skilled artisans of hospitality who are dedicated to creating an unforgettable experience. They work hard, so you don't have to.

entries.zh: $job_resort_worker_plural_with_icon$将$r_consumer_goods$转化为$r_trade$、$r_unity$以及全帝国的£mod_planet_amenities_add£§Y$PLANET_AMENITIES_TITLE$§!和生活标准产出£trade_value£§Y贸易额§!。
entries.en: $job_resort_worker_plural_with_icon$ turn $r_consumer_goods$ into $r_trade$, $r_unity$ and Empire-wide £mod_planet_amenities_add£ §Y$PLANET_AMENITIES_TITLE$§! and £trade_value£ §YTrade from Living Standards§!.

entries.zh: 作为监狱长监管整个徒刑殖民地，需要他们拥有高超的技能，并完全致力于手头的任务。
entries.en: Overseeing an entire penal colony as its warden demands individuals who are highly skilled and wholly committed to the task at hand.

entries.zh: 这些受训的囚犯惯于将矿物原料转化为耐用的合金，可用于诸多先进建造领域。
entries.en: Trained prisoners are used to turn raw minerals into durable alloys used in various advanced construction.

entries.zh: 这些受训的囚犯生产各式各样的家用及奢侈品。
entries.en: These trained prisoners manufacture domestic and luxury goods of various types.

entries.zh: 这些受训的囚犯将原生有机物转化为耐用的合金，可用于诸多先进建造领域。
entries.en: These trained prisoners turn raw organic matter into durable alloys for advanced construction.

entries.zh: 技艺娴熟的囚犯，可以生产极高品质的家用品和奢侈品。
entries.en: Skilled prisoners that manufacture domestic and luxury goods of stunning quality.

entries.zh: 奴隶中的精英战士，从生下来就开始受训，在战斗中投入无与伦比的激情与残暴。它们的忠诚和投入使其在前线上战无不胜。
entries.en: Elite slave warriors, trained from birth, who fight with unparalleled zeal and ferocity. Their loyalty and dedication make them formidable on the front lines.

entries.zh: [battle_thrall.GetIcon][battle_thrall.GetNamePlural]提升£mod_country_naval_cap_add£§Y$MOD_COUNTRY_NAVAL_CAP_ADD$§!，产生£defense_army£§Y防御部队§!并提升全帝国的§Y$MOD_ARMY_ATTACK_DAMAGE_MULT$§!。
entries.en: [battle_thrall.GetIcon] [battle_thrall.GetNamePlural] increase £mod_country_naval_cap_add£ §Y$MOD_COUNTRY_NAVAL_CAP_ADD$§!, spawn £defense_army£ §YDefense Armies§! and improve empire wide §Y$MOD_ARMY_ATTACK_DAMAGE_MULT$§!.

entries.zh: 这些自豪的交易撮合者们能提高日用商品的价值，并让货物以更快的速度运往最需要或最想要它的地方。
entries.en: These proud deal-makers boost the value of everyday commodities, and expedite the movement of goods to where they are most needed or desired.

entries.zh: 这些热心的商业促进者誓奉奴玛之名，在交易中榨取每一滴价值。
entries.en: These zealous facilitators of commerce have vowed to squeeze every last drop of value from deals carried out in Numa's name.

entries.zh: 冶金业需要大量训练有素的专业人员将原生矿物转化为坚固耐久的合金，这些合金将成为各种高级建筑的原材料。
entries.en: Highly trained workers are needed to turn raw minerals into the durable alloys that are used in a wide variety of advanced construction.

entries.zh: 执法者是维护法律和秩序的人员。
entries.en: Law enforcement officers are responsible for upholding the law and maintaining peace.

entries.zh: 这些有些特权的奴隶负责监管那些没那么走运的同胞们。
entries.en: These relatively privileged slaves keep their less fortunate brethren in line.

entries.zh: 灵能军团的成员，一支由灵能者组成的反犯罪部队。
entries.en: Members of the Psi Corps, a unit of psionically-gifted crime fighters.

entries.zh: [telepath.GetIcon][telepath.GetNamePlural]生产£unity£§Y$unity$§!，并减少£crime£§Y$PLANET_CRIME_TITLE$§!，为殖民地提供普遍的产出增益。
entries.en: [telepath.GetIcon] [telepath.GetNamePlural] produce £unity£ §Y$unity$§!, decrease £crime£ §Y$PLANET_CRIME_TITLE$§!, and provide a general productivity boost on the colony.

entries.zh: 灵能军团的成员，他们将使用灵能天赋来教育我们的人民。
entries.en: Members of the Psi Corps, these specialists use their psionic gifts to educate our population.

entries.zh: 职业军人可以为陆军与舰队提供源源不绝的兵源。
entries.en: Military professionals are needed to train a steady stream of new recruits for army and naval operations.

entries.zh: 技艺出色的铸造工匠所组成的团体，专门负责制造各种供应国内的日用品和奢侈品。
entries.en: Skilled craft workers that manufacture domestic and luxury goods of various types.

entries.zh: 传闻宇宙中的一切生灵只分为两类：娱乐提供者与娱乐享受者。
entries.en: It is said there are only two types of lifeforms in the galaxy: the entertainers, and the entertained.

entries.zh: 这些军事专家展示他们的致命武艺，以供大众娱乐欣赏。
entries.en: Martial experts who display their deadly art for the entertainment of the masses.

entries.zh: 预防胜于治疗。不过有时候双管齐下才是最佳治疗方案。
entries.en: A micro-unit of prevention is worth a macro-unit of cure. Sometimes, however, both are needed.

entries.zh: 这些工作人员专注于艺术工作，他们的存在对于人民的内在发展与社会表达是至关重要的。
entries.en: Maintaining the arts is the realm of these workers, vital for the inner development and social expression of citizens.

entries.zh: 这些专家是负责协调与管理新的科学技术的研发过程。
entries.en: These specialists coordinate and manage the research and development of new technologies.

entries.zh: 探索神秘世界的道路永无止境。
entries.en: The eternal mystery of the world is its comprehensibility.

entries.zh: 探索神秘世界的道路永无止境。
entries.en: The eternal mystery of the world is its comprehensibility.

entries.zh: 宇宙环境效应揭示了时空丝缕如何包含每个维度的秘密。这些研究人员孜孜不倦地破译它们的意义，同时尽量减少悖论。
entries.en: Cosmic environmental effects reveal how strands of space-time contain the secrets of every dimension. These researchers work tirelessly to decipher their significance while minimizing paradoxes.

entries.zh: $job_astral_meteorologist_plural_with_icon$将£consumer_goods£§Y$consumer_goods$§!转化为$r_physics$和$r_astral_threads$\n\n当前星系存在§Y环境影响§!时岗位产出将提高 。
entries.en: $job_astral_meteorologist_plural_with_icon$ turn £consumer_goods£  §Y$consumer_goods$§! into $r_physics$ and $r_astral_threads$\n\nJob Output is increased when an §YEnvironmental Effect§! is present in this System.

entries.zh: 探索神秘世界的道路永无止境。
entries.en: The eternal mystery of the world is its comprehensibility.

entries.zh: 探索神秘世界的道路永无止境。
entries.en: The eternal mystery of the world is its comprehensibility.

entries.zh: 当指引百姓的人本身也迷茫需要指引时，他们该去找谁呢？当然是比他们更加优秀的指引者了。
entries.en: To whom do guides turn when they themselves seek guidance? Another, more experienced guide.

entries.zh: 群众的精神指引者是由最虔诚的信徒来担当的。
entries.en: The spiritual guidance of the masses is performed by the most pious and devout.

entries.zh: 易爆微粒的化学合成程序都是由这些专家来操作与管理的。
entries.en: The synthetic development of volatile motes by chemical processes is left to these specialists.

entries.zh: 这些专家负责在实验室环境中将矿物加工为稀有水晶。
entries.en: These specialists transform minerals into rare crystals in a laboratory environment.

entries.zh: 从矿物中精炼提取气体的一系列复杂程序是需要先进的机器和经验丰富的操作员来完成的。
entries.en: Managing the complex chain of reactions required to refine gas from minerals effectively requires advanced machinery and highly-trained experts.

entries.zh: 这些技术员负责建造机器人，而生产出来的机器人则负责建造国家。
entries.en: These technicians build robots, that the robots may build for the nation.

entries.zh: 中层管理者需要无止尽地平衡各项互相冲突的需求，因此是非常不受欢迎的岗位。
entries.en: The endless struggle to balance conflicting demands from the middle of the managerial hierarchy is envied by few.

entries.zh: 这些民主选举产生的志愿者确保我们合作社的顺利运行，为所有成员谋福利。
entries.en: These democratically-elected volunteers ensure the smooth running of our cooperative society, for the benefit of all its members.

entries.zh: 完成帝国的管理职责非同小可，这需要那些敬业而且接受过良好训练的人员来承担职责。
entries.en: Fulfilling the bureaucratic demands of an empire is a daunting task that requires dedicated and highly trained individuals.

entries.zh: 作为我们方才统一的殖民地的行政团队，这些官员应当向有需要的人提供便利。
entries.en: The administrative corps of our newly unified colony, these officers ensure that amenities are delivered to those in need.

entries.zh: 负责保护我们的殖民地清洁自然的特殊个体。
entries.en: Special individuals tasked with ensuring that our colonies remain clean and natural.

entries.zh: £job_ranger£$job_ranger_plural$产出£amenities£§Y舒适度§!和£society_research£§Y$society_research$§!。视具体£blocker£['concept_natural_blocker']不同，也可能会产出$r_energy$、$r_food$或$r_minerals$。
entries.en: £job_ranger£ $job_ranger_plural$ produce £amenities£ §YAmenities§! and £society_research£ §Y$society_research$§!. They also produce $r_energy$, $r_food$ and $r_minerals$ depending on each £blocker£ ['concept_natural_blocker'] present.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R该地块障碍由于§Y$building_ranger_lodge$§!的存在而无法清除。§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RThis blocker will not be removeable as long as the §Y$building_ranger_lodge$§! exists.§!

entries.zh: 统治整个殖民地的职责非同小可。只有最敬业、最优秀的人员才能胜任此工作。
entries.en: The government of an entire colony is a daunting task that requires dedicated and highly trained individuals.

entries.zh: 贵族的负担是非常沉重的，他们天生的使命就是领导平庸的同胞们。幸运的是如此艰苦的岗位能够换来相当优渥的生活，所以此岗位还是非常让人趋之若鹜。
entries.en: Heavy is the burden of the nobility, whose birthright is to rule over their unwashed lessers. Luckily, there are a few financial advantages to the position.

entries.zh: 他们买入他们卖出。他们囤货他们转售。他们是代理商也是经销商，他们是零售商又是批发商——总之有交易的地方，就有商人。
entries.en: They buy. They sell. They hoard. They re-sell. Agents, dealers, retailers, wholesalers - wherever there is trade, there are merchants.

entries.zh: 只有执行官才有权力主导开拓性的行动方案和应付多变的产品需求。
entries.en: Only an executive has the power to drive leading-edge initiatives and synergistically benchmark dynamically conceptualized deliverables.

entries.zh: 熟练且有创意的工匠，可以生产极高品质的家用品和奢侈品。
entries.en: Skilled and creative craft workers that manufacture domestic and luxury goods of stunning quality.

entries.zh: 这些动物园饲养员负责照顾其管辖的动物。
entries.en: These zookeepers look after the needs of the fauna under their care.

entries.zh: £job_xeno_zoo_keeper£ $job_xeno_zoo_keeper_plural$将$r_consumer_goods$转化为£society£ §Y研究点数§!和$r_amenities$。\n$r_amenities$创造[Planet.Owner.GetZooAnimalsWithIcon]岗位。
entries.en: £job_xeno_zoo_keeper£ $job_xeno_zoo_keeper_plural$ turn $r_consumer_goods$ into £society£ §YResearch Points§! and $r_amenities$.\n$r_amenities$ produced scale with [Planet.Owner.GetZooAnimalsWithIcon] jobs.

entries.zh: 这是计划不周所引发的恶果，失业者都在热切盼望新的工作分配。
entries.en: The unfortunate result of insufficient planning, the unemployed eagerly await assignment.

entries.zh: 他们有且只有一个使命：成为更优秀物种的食物。
entries.en: They have but one purpose: to become feed for their betters.

entries.zh: 此人口正在按照我国的政策被净化。
entries.en: This pop is being purged in accordance with our policies.

entries.zh: 他们的有机能量会被吸收，直至死亡。
entries.en: Their organic energy will be absorbed, until they expire.

entries.zh: 他们的唯一工作就是过自己的生活。
entries.en: Their only job is to be themselves.

entries.zh: 这些子个体没有既定的目标，只是漫无目的地挖掘与拾荒，生产少量有用的£minerals£§Y$minerals$§!。
entries.en: With no defined purpose these Drones aimlessly dig and scavenge, producing a small amount of useful £minerals£ §Y$minerals$§!.

entries.zh: 苦工负责艰苦的体力劳动，以维持奴隶星球粗劣的基础设施。
entries.en: Toilers perform the grueling menial labor required to keep crude infrastructure of the Thrall-World running.

entries.zh: 仆从会为主人执行各种琐碎的家庭事务，并满足主人的侍奉需求。
entries.en: Servants perform various menial domestic tasks and household work for their masters.

entries.zh: 这些罪犯游走在法治社会以外，有的是自行选择的，有的是因生活所迫。
entries.en: These criminals live outside the bounds of legal society, some by choice and some by circumstance.

entries.zh: 这些反常的子个体不再遵从主脑的意志。
entries.en: These deviants no longer obey the Hive Mind.

entries.zh: 这些子个体受到了腐化，不再遵从核心智慧的命令。
entries.en: These drones have been corrupted and no longer obey the directives of the core intelligence.

entries.zh: 这些半游牧的探索者是通过采集与狩猎为生的。有证据显示它们能够使用早期的工具。
entries.en: These semi-nomadic explorers survive by foraging and hunting. There is evidence of early tool use.

entries.zh: 这些农民在田地无止境地辛苦劳作，以便让那些被认为更优秀的统治阶层富贵起来。
entries.en: The peasants toil endlessly in the fields, so that those perceived as their betters might prosper.

entries.zh: 这些人属于精于格斗的战士阶层。他们使用利器、长矛、钝器等各种武器来战斗。
entries.en: Members of a combative warrior class. These fighters rely on bladed weapons, spears or various blunt instruments to see them through combat.

entries.zh: 地主贵族的统治中心都是设在城堡或堡垒中的。
entries.en: The landed nobility rule from their stone castles and keeps.

entries.zh: 此社会的知识分子都是通过口口相传来传递知识给下一代的。
entries.en: The learned of this society, often relying on oral tradition to pass knowledge between generations.

entries.zh: 精神领袖与传道者负责操作一切跟信仰有关的仪式与事务。
entries.en: Spiritual leaders and preachers who conduct religious ceremonies and oversee all matters concerning faith.

entries.zh: 这些早期的产业制造员在工厂内起早贪黑；多亏近期电力技术的突破性发展，这些工人现在可以日以继夜地不停干活了。
entries.en: These early industrial manufacturers toil away in factories, which can now be operated day and night thanks to recent advances in electricity.

entries.zh: 在星球黑暗的地下进行的危险工作，有时甚至会因此丧命。
entries.en: Dangerous and sometimes lethal work in the dark bowels of the planet.

entries.zh: 这些技工负责铲煤或是维护原始的核电厂。
entries.en: These technicians shuffle coal or maintain primitive nuclear generators.

entries.zh: 这些农民负责在田地里劳动，使用的都是原始但有效的耕作工具。
entries.en: These farmers work the land, typically with the help of primitive but effective farming equipment.

entries.zh: 研究者通过科学方法论来快速推进文明的发展。
entries.en: Researchers employing scientific methodology to advance the rapidly expanding knowledge base of their civilization.

entries.zh: 这些是负责宗教事务的宗教领袖。
entries.en: Religious leaders who occupy various priestly offices.

entries.zh: 这些文书工作者负责确保官僚主义的存在。
entries.en: These paper-pushers ensure that the bureaucracy exists.

entries.zh: 社会名流和媒体人士，提供娱乐消遣，分散对日常生活的注意力。
entries.en: Celebrities and media personalities that provide entertainment and distraction from day-to-day life.

entries.zh: 这些是装备着早期的火炮武器的职业士兵。
entries.en: Professional soldiers, typically armed with early projectile weapons powered by exothermic combustion.

entries.zh: 很多早期的工业化社会与后工业化社会都是由规模不断扩张的官僚阶层所统治的。
entries.en: Many early industrialist and post-industrialist societies are governed by an ever-expanding class of civil servants.

entries.zh: 蜂巢思维的成败与否，取决于资源调度。
entries.en: The difference between a successful hivemind and a starved one comes down to how successful their resource procurement is.

entries.zh: 单纯、粗浅的子个体，劳作于田间。他们能够意识到食物是可以耕种的，但也仅此而已了。
entries.en: Simple and unspecialized drones work the fields, their consciousness aware that food can be grown, but the task has yet to be optimized.

entries.zh: 由于尚未完全掌握基因专业化，这些子个体长得更加庞大，以保护它们的蜂巢。它们尚未演化出任何专门的武器附属物。
entries.en: Having yet to fully come to grips with genetic specialization, these drones are grown bulkier to protect their hive. They have yet to evolve any specialized weapon appendages.

entries.zh: 在本地子个体之间形成的萌芽主宰需要进一步扩展意识。这些突触子个体更有智慧，主要促进扩展意识。
entries.en: The budding Overmind formed between the local drones has found a need to extend their consciousness further. These more cerebral Synapse Drones mainly facilitate this.

entries.zh: 分析困境并探寻解决方案是繁荣社会的标志。这些子个体专注于为其它子个体提供解决方案，同时避免未来的不测
entries.en: Analyzing and discovering solutions to new difficulties is the hallmark of any flourishing society - these drones focus on finding solutions for other drones' problems and avoiding future pitfalls

entries.zh: 这些子个体或多或少是它们工作的工厂的一部分，能以惊人的速度组装从武器到车辆的一切东西。
entries.en: Drones that are more or less part of the very factory they work in. These specialized laborers assemble everything from weapons to vehicles at an astounding rate.

entries.zh: 这些子个体为了大局而牺牲安全，深入地底，为社会这个日益饥渴的引擎提供食物。
entries.en: Sacrificing safety for success, these drones delve deep beneath the earth to feed the ever-hungry engine that is society.

entries.zh: 没有任何生物能一直操作肮脏的能源发生器。不过，这些子个体经过了强化，有着优良的肺部和内生的抗辐射能力，因此能比大多数更持久。
entries.en: Operating dirty energy generators is not a job any living being can do forever. Still, these drones are enhanced with superior lungs as well as inherent radioactive resistance, so they last longer than most.

entries.zh: 粮食生产由横跨大陆的蜂巢思维监管，这是物流和农业的奇迹，农业区划的每一部分都得到了充分利用。
entries.en: Food production overseen by a continent spanning hive-mind is a marvel of logistics and agronomy, every section of the designated agricultural area is used to its fullest.

entries.zh: 采用科学方法的子个体能在它们的意识知识库中取得巨大（通常过大）的飞跃。
entries.en: Drones employing the scientific method are capable of taking massive leaps in their consciousness knowledge base. Often too large.

entries.zh: 让社会的每个成员都繁殖是非常低效的。这些子个体专门生成蜂巢需要的任何子个体。
entries.en: Having each member of a society reproduce is vastly inefficient. These drones specialize in generating whatever new drones the Hive needs.

entries.zh: 这些庞大的子个体专精于战斗，有多个专门的附属物，可以完美地碾压自己的同类。
entries.en: Specialized for war, these hulking drones have multiple specialized appendages perfected for crushing their own species.

entries.zh: 对于单独的个体而言，管理和协调整个国家并非易事。这些子个体确保每个子个体都有适当的任务。
entries.en: Administrating and coordinating an entire country is no easier if you are a single individual. These drones ensure that every drone has an appropriate task.

entries.zh: 若宇宙中有一条普遍的真理，那就是无物常驻。这些子个体专门修复破损的东西。
entries.en: If there is one universal truth in this universe, it's that everything breaks. These drones are made to fix whatever is broken.

entries.zh: 尽管仍算是原始的野兽，可它们的行为中却透露出一定程度的智慧……
entries.en: Simple beasts to an extent, and yet their behavior betrays some degree of intelligence...

entries.zh: 智慧物种的幼体，很快就能获得智慧。
entries.en: Spawns of sapient species, soon to grow into their intelligence.

entries.zh: 遭到猎杀的未开智物种
遭到猎杀的未开智物种
出于保护目的，这些即将开智的动物在受控的环境中得到照顾和研究。
entries.en: These near-intelligent fauna are cared for and studied in a controlled environment, ensuring their conservation.

entries.zh: 这些野兽与我们的战士针锋相对，在娱乐大众的同时也把它们的数量控制在了可持续的水平。
entries.en: These beasts are pitted in combat against our warriors, entertaining the masses while keeping the bestial population at sustainable levels.

entries.zh: 出于保护目的，这些异种生物在受控的环境中得到照顾和研究。
entries.en: These xenos are cared for and studied in a controlled environment, ensuring their conservation.

entries.zh: 这些异种野兽与我们的战士针锋相对，在娱乐大众的同时也把它们的数量控制在了可持续的水平。
entries.en: These xenos are pitted in combat against our warriors, entertaining the masses while keeping the bestial population at sustainable levels.

entries.zh: 他们负责翻找垃圾场以收集废弃的机器和远古的电子元件以回收利用。
entries.en: They scurry amongst the scrapyards, collecting discarded machinery and ancient electronics for repurposing.

entries.zh: 这些工人被分配到未知来源的古代神秘工厂中工作。这又能出啥岔子呢？
entries.en: These workers labor in the ancient and mysterious factory of unknown origin. What could go wrong?

entries.zh: 这些子个体在未知来源的古老神秘工厂中工作。这会出问题吗？
entries.en: These drones labor in the ancient and mysterious factory of unknown origin. What could go wrong?

entries.zh: 这些联络员居住在地下，他们的职责是与地下住民搞好关系从而加强与地下文明之间的贸易活动。
entries.en: These Liaisons live underground and work for closer relations and improved trade with the Subterranean Civilization.

entries.zh: 这些子个体居于地下，与地底文明互相交易物资。
entries.en: These Drones live underground, transferring resources to and from the Subterranean Civilization.

entries.zh: 这些研究员致力于研究稳定的时空异常现象表达出来的有趣特性。
entries.en: Researchers who study the curious properties of the stable space-time anomaly.

entries.zh: 这些子个体致力于研究稳定的时空异常现象表达出来的有趣特性。
entries.en: Drones which study the curious properties of the stable space-time anomaly.

entries.zh: 冒着随时可能失去生命以及丧失神智的危险去研究位面传送门的英勇研究者们。
entries.en: Researchers who risk their very existence and sanity to study the mysteries of the Dimensional Portal.

entries.zh: 位面传送门研究子个体
位面传送门研究子个体
这些子个体冒着死亡的危险，研究着位面传送门的奥秘。
entries.en: Drones at risk of destruction or subversion which study the mysteries of the Dimensional Portal.

entries.zh: 会影响帝国内所有[GetStarbaseOrWayStationPlural]的维护花费，即增加或者减少维持所以恒星基地正常运行的每月维护费。
entries.en: Affects the upkeep cost of all [GetStarbaseOrWayStationPlural] within the Empire, increasing or reducing the monthly cost of keeping them active.

entries.zh: 石质人口凝聚力维护费
生物人口凝聚力维护费
资源生产£job£岗位导致的维护费
每$pop_group_unit$战略资源收集者的£energy£$energy$维护费
战略资源收集者产出的£rare_crystals£$rare_crystals$
战略资源收集者产出的£exotic_gases£$exotic_gases$
战略资源收集者产出的$r_strategic_plural$
工业岗位产生的异星天然气
工业岗位产生的稀有水晶
工业岗位产生的易爆微粒
外交协议影响力维护费
在将积蓄输光之后，他们急需新的资金来源。
entries.en: Having gambled away their savings, new funding sources are required.

entries.zh: 要从一场如此盛大的狂欢中冷静下来，想必会出现一定的社会动荡。
entries.en: While recovering from a party of sufficient magnitude, a certain amount of grouchiness is to be expected.

entries.zh: 最新最棒的老虎机现已推出，人们玩到根本停不下来！这些老虎机会控制人们的大脑，直到榨干他们的钱财为止。
entries.en: The latest, greatest slot machines have been unveiled and people just can't stop playing! Literally, the machines hijack the cerebral cortex until gambling quotas are met.

entries.zh: 自从巨尸乐队事件以来，不知出于何种原因，在这个殖民地上生产金属变得更加容易了。
entries.en: Ever since the MegaCorpse incident it has just been somehow easier to create metal on this colony.

entries.zh: 这个被放置于铸造厂内的神秘装置可以增加合金生产效率。
entries.en: Placed in a foundry this mysterious device increases the efficiency of alloy production.

entries.zh: 这台奇怪的机器可以设法将矿物从地里转移出来，而不会影响到周围的物质。
entries.en: This strange machine can somehow summon minerals up out of the ground without affecting the surrounding material.

entries.zh: 如果把它装到一台足够大的发电机上，这件装置会用一种未知且似乎不可理喻的技术在正常产出的基础上再产生额外的能量。
entries.en: When added to a generator of sufficient size this device uses an unknown and seemingly impossible technique to create additional energy over and above the normal output.

entries.zh: 使用拜金教的成像技术可以让我们的子民从个人的蝇头小利转向更加广泛的能源生产。要想达成梦想，首先你得想象出梦想。
entries.en: The active use of Numistic visualization techniques will refocus our people's attention from personal gain to cosmic energy production. To achieve something, you must first visualize it.

entries.zh: 通过在环境改造过程中使用异星天然气，我们可以大幅加速改造过程。
entries.en: By employing exotic gases in the terraforming process, we are able to achieve progress at a much faster rate.

entries.zh: 利用易爆微粒的爆炸性，我们可以大幅加快清理复杂地形的速度。
entries.en: By using volatile motes for their explosive capabilities, we are able to clear difficult terrain at a much faster rate.

entries.zh: 通过利用易爆微粒的爆炸性能，我们能够大批量地清除障碍物。
entries.en: By using volatile motes for their explosive capabilities, we are able to clear obstructions in bulk.

entries.zh: 利用稀有水晶来增强我们的传感器，我们可以更加清晰地观测周围环境。
entries.en: By employing rare crystals to boost our sensors, we are able to gain a crystal clear picture of our surroundings.

entries.zh: 活体金属的内在特性非常适合用于改进巨型结构。
entries.en: The inherent properties of living metal makes it perfect for improving megastructure construction.

entries.zh: 各种异星天然气也可作为亚光速旅行的优秀燃料，虽然可能并不是最经济的选择。
entries.en: Various exotic gases also function as excellent fuel for sublight travel, although perhaps not the most economical alternative.

entries.zh: 某些异星天然气可以用来增强舰船的护盾性能。它们可以创造出复杂的缓冲力场来抵御和弱化敌方的攻击。
entries.en: Some exotic gases can be utilized for boosting ships' shield capabilities. They can create complex dampening fields to repel and soften enemy attacks.

entries.zh: 我们可以用易爆微粒作为舰船弹药中的炸药。
entries.en: We are able to deploy volatile motes as an explosive in our ships' ammunition.

entries.zh: 通过利用易爆微粒制造特殊导弹，我们的舰船将拥有更强的破坏力。
entries.en: By using volatile motes to construct specialized missiles, our ships will have greater destructive capabilities.

entries.zh: 利用反应部件增加舰船的装甲，我们的舰船可以用受控的反向爆炸来降低受到的伤害。
entries.en: By enhancing our ships' armor with a reactive component, our ships are able to absorb more damage by reducing incoming damage with a controlled counter-explosion.

entries.zh: 通过增加在舰船上使用稀有水晶的比率，我们可以增强其能量武器的伤害。
entries.en: By increasing our ships' access to rare crystals, we are able to increase the damage of their energy weapons.

entries.zh: 微量的泽珞让我们的领航员可以感知到未进入探测范围的物体。
entries.en: Microdosing Zro allows our navigators to sense objects beyond the reach of our scanners.

entries.zh: 泽珞的许多神秘特性之一是通过吸入它可以显著提升灵能者的能力。
entries.en: Among the many mysterious properties of Zro is the ability to significantly increase the capabilities of psionic beings imbibing it.

entries.zh: 我们的研究者已经发现了以泽珞为原料合成一中吸入后可以提升能力且不造成副作用的物质。
entries.en: Our researchers have found ways to synthesize Zro to produce performance-enhancing substances that cause no negative side effects on those imbibing them.

entries.zh: 这座巨大的仓储设施是脉动在集体后勤组织中的核心，子个体在其中确保着物流运转满足一切寻求。
entries.en: The beating heart of the collective's logistics apparatus, this massive storage facility's drones work to ensure resources are swiftly delivered wherever they are needed.

entries.zh: 大量庞大突触组成的中心，这些节点——逐渐演化成了特殊子个体，又受其他特殊子个体协助——负责接收和传输蜂巢的意志。
entries.en: A center of massive, macroscopic synapses, these nodes - tended to and assisted by specialized drones - receive and transmit the will of the Hive.

entries.zh: 集中在一起的突触蜂巢节点可以最大化单位表面积的超级神经元传输速度。
entries.en: Synaptic hive nodes networked and clustered together produce maximum meganeuron transmission per available surface area, strengthening the organization of the will to its drones.

entries.zh: 这个巨大的突触神经元中心中有数以亿计的超级神经元通过集簇中一条条原生质纤维管道来散播、强化、以及协调主脑的意志。
entries.en: A massive nervous center of macroscopic neurology, billions of meganeurons fire along vast stretches of roiling protoplasmic fibers in the Confluence, spreading, strengthening, coordinating the will of the Hive.

entries.zh: 水培农场生产富含营养的蔬菜植物，供当地人口消耗。
entries.en: Hydroponics Farms produce nutrient-rich vegetable matter tailored for consumption by local Pops.

entries.zh: 最新的全息影像娱乐产品。一个由光子和能源场建立起的世界。
entries.en: The latest in holographic entertainment. Entire worlds built out of photons and energy fields.

entries.zh: 开采这些矿物时必须加倍谨慎，以避免损坏矿场中的水晶。
entries.en: Great care must be taken when excavating these mines to avoid damaging the crystals.

entries.zh: 在这些铸造厂工作的[Owner.GetAlloyProducerPlural]可以生产出高质量的合金
entries.en: The [Owner.GetAlloyProducerPlural] working in these foundries produce high-quality alloys.

entries.zh: 这些巨型熔炉可以辅助合金的末端生产，有益于遍布整个殖民地的产业。
entries.en: These massive forges can assist the end-stage production of alloys in our industries across the colony.

entries.zh: 大型的工业中心目的在于增加殖民地的合金产量。
entries.en: Large industrial fabricators geared towards increasing the production of alloys on the colony.

entries.zh: 这里是广义上的民用工业和制造业的集合，大量的生活消费品从这里产出。
entries.en: A wide collection of civilian industries and manufactories where a variety of consumer goods are produced.

entries.zh: 大型的工业中心目的在于增加殖民地中流通的消费品产量。
entries.en: Large industrial fabricators geared towards increasing the production of consumer goods on the colony.

entries.zh: 这些建筑群内部的终端可以复制几乎所有东西。
entries.en: Nearly anything can be replicated at the kiosks in these complexes.

entries.zh: 这些富丽堂皇的宫殿与庄园属于贵族，周围的村庄与平民同样如此。
entries.en: Palaces and mansions, resplendent in their glory, owned by the nobility. The surrounding countryside and the peasants that inhabit it are theirs as well.

entries.zh: 一个错综复杂的政府机构，包含官僚部门，次级官僚部门，以及次次级部门。
entries.en: A labyrinthine government complex of bureaucratic offices, sub-offices and sub-sub-offices.

entries.zh: 一个满是专用于执行高效而细致的文书工作建筑的区域。
entries.en: An area full of buildings dedicated to the glory of effective and meticulous paperwork.

entries.zh: 一片广袤的土地，其上修建的是包含着无数办公室的官僚机构。
entries.en: A vast stretch of land covered in bureaucratic offices containing countless cubicles.

entries.zh: 为了使我们的文明进步，我们必须对复杂的模拟进行运行和评估。
entries.en: To advance our civilization we must run and evaluate complex simulations.

entries.zh: 为了进一步理解星系，我们的专用感知子个体需要能体验星海所能呈现的一切。
entries.en: To further understand the galaxy, our specialized sensory drones need to experience everything it has to offer.

entries.zh: 这些基础的研究设施也把文明推向了太空时代。
entries.en: These basic research facilities managed to propel a civilization to the Space Age.

entries.zh: 研究实验室中有基础的研究设施，可以进行一般性研究。
entries.en: Research Labs provide the basic facilities for general research.

entries.zh: 升级后的研究设施，里面可以容纳非常多的研究人员。
entries.en: Upgraded research facilities with a very large staff capacity.

entries.zh: 这些高级研究设施中有最先进的科研设备，可以容纳庞大数量的科研人员。
entries.en: These advanced research facilities have the very latest science equipment along with an extremely large staff capacity.

entries.zh: 执法者的大本营，也是法律和秩序的神圣象征。
entries.en: Monuments to law and order. Enforcers are based here.

entries.zh: 一个专为执法与审判而设的巨大设施。
entries.en: A massive complex dedicated to courts and law enforcement.

entries.zh: 这些哨站可供巡逻子个体时刻扫描集体意识并搜寻反常与故障的迹象。
entries.en: These are the outposts from which Patrol Drones scan the Consciousness for signs of deviancy and malfunction.

entries.zh: 蜂巢的组织核心，蜂巢思维借此协调殖民地的工作。
entries.en: The organizational core from which the Hive Mind coordinates colony functions.

entries.zh: 错综复杂的首都综合体，蜂巢思维借此专注于殖民地的组织、协调以及计划。
entries.en: A sprawling capital complex from which the Hive Mind focuses colony organization, coordination, and planning.

entries.zh: 这些产卵池通过专家的科学的、细心的照料，可以刺激卵快速成长。
entries.en: Tended by the scientific and gentle care of specialists, these pools stimulate our spawn into faster growth.

entries.zh: 高科技工厂，熟练的机器人专家就在这里组装最新的机器人模型。
entries.en: High-tech factories where skilled Roboticists assemble the latest robot models.

entries.zh: 一座熟练机器人专家组装最新型号机器人的先进组装厂。
entries.en: An advanced assembly plant where skilled Roboticists assemble the latest robot models.

entries.zh: 这个装配生产线是组装新单位的地方。
entries.en: A production line assembly plant where new units are constructed.

entries.zh: 一处高级装配复合体，新单位在此组建。
entries.en: An advanced assembly plant where new units are constructed.

entries.zh: 在这些设施内加工过的食物的营养成分将大大增加。
entries.en: Food that is processed at these facilities has its nutritional value greatly increased.

entries.zh: 流水线式的加工处理设施，可以对大量的食物进行加工处理。
entries.en: Streamlined facilities where large amounts of food can be processed.

entries.zh: 精心设计的住宅楼，里面全是豪华的公寓。构思奇特的阳台全靠着先进的零重力科技才不致于崩塌。
entries.en: Intricately designed residential towers with luxurious apartments. Advanced zero-g technology is the only thing keeping the more outlandish terrace designs from collapsing.

entries.zh: 这些先进的精炼厂日日夜夜马不停蹄的生产出异星天然气。
entries.en: These advanced refineries work day and night to produce exotic gases.

entries.zh: 在这里生产出的水晶具备最高级的质量，完全可以以假乱真了。
entries.en: Nearly identical to the real thing, the crystals produced here are of the highest quality.

entries.zh: 不稳定且难以预测的易爆微粒就在这里进行生产。在以厂子为中心的半径五公里范围之内不允许有任何明火出现。
entries.en: The unpredictable and sometimes unstable Volatile Motes are produced here artificially. No open flames are permitted within a five kilometer radius of the plants.

entries.zh: 这些商业区中有不少高大的办公楼和商业楼。
entries.en: These commercial zones are home to towering office buildings and business complexes.

entries.zh: 无数超大型的商业楼直冲云霄，甚至遮盖住了阳光。
entries.en: Great commercial spires and towers rising up towards the sky, blotting out the light.

entries.zh: 这些设计精巧的设施用能源场捕获易爆微粒并将这些微粒送入位于地下的特殊隔离区，在那里对微粒进行稳定处理，然后收集。
entries.en: These intricate facilities trap Volatile Motes within energy fields, funneling them into special containment zones below ground where they can be stabilized and harvested.

entries.zh: 这些庞大的采集井钻入行星地表并直达最深处从而获取到行星地下的异星天然气。
entries.en: These hulking wells reach deep into the planet's mantle to access pockets of Exotic Gas.

entries.zh: 统一规划的住宅，在各方面都完全一样。
entries.en: A block of uniform housing, equal in every way.

entries.zh: 结合了高效实用的住房与小心维护的风景，堪称工程上的杰作。
entries.en: An incredible feat of engineering that combines efficient, practical residences with carefully maintained idyllic landscapes.

entries.zh: 供无人机进行维护的储存空间。
entries.en: A storage area for Drones to undergo maintenance.

entries.zh: 在安装了最新的升级之后，无人机在进行维护时可以将自身供电系统的一部分电能转移到电网中。
entries.en: With the latest upgrades, while undergoing maintenance a portion of Drones' power-generation can be re-directed to the grid.

entries.zh: 一座巨大的养殖场，可供许多子个体在此休息。
entries.en: A vast warren offers shelter for many Drones to rest.

entries.zh: 拓展之后的养殖场可容纳更多的子个体。
entries.en: By expanding the warrens, still more Drone can shelter within.

entries.zh: 供奉财富女神奴玛的神龛。
entries.en: A shrine devoted to the worship of Numa, goddess of fortune.

entries.zh: 与自然和谐相处的前提条件是自然它还存在着。确保我们的殖民地不破坏自然之美是重中之重。星球必须维持纯洁。
entries.en: The first step to live more in tune with nature is to ensure that nature is still around. Making sure none of the colonists impact the natural beauty is essential. The world must remain pure.

entries.zh: 天然存在的障碍产生的£job_ranger£$job_ranger$岗位：§G+1§!£job_ranger£
通过开发宏观突触节点来增强蜂巢的意志。
entries.en: Through the development of macroscopic synaptic nodes, the will of the Hive will be strengthened.

entries.zh: 通过集中宏观突触节点网络来最大化每单位表面积的超级神经元传输速度。
entries.en: By clustering networks of macroscopic synaptic nodes, maximum meganeuron transmission per available surface area can be attained.

entries.zh: 蜂巢的意志可以通过扩充超级神经元的神经中枢的规模来获得进一步的强化。
entries.en: The will of the Hive will be further strengthened and coordinated with the expansion and development of a massive nervous center of meganeurons.

entries.zh: 改良的食物加工技术可以让食物保存得更长久从而减少食物腐坏。
entries.en: Improved food processing techniques will lead to better preservation methods and less spoilage.

entries.zh: 全新的冷冻保存和蛋白质重组技术可以进一步提升食物加工程序的效率。
entries.en: New cryopreservation and protein resequencing methods will make food processing much more efficient.

entries.zh: 固态全息铸模可以瞬间改变自身形态，从而提升合金的生产速度。
entries.en: Solid holographic casts can alter their shapes at a moment's notice, speeding up alloy production.

entries.zh: 纳米分离器乃是合金制造业改革性的新一步。大幅简化铸模过程，还能够提升总体生产质量。
entries.en: Nano-separators are a revolutionary new step in the creation of alloys, simplifying the casting process while improving overall production quality.

entries.zh: 有了提前编写过的纳米电路，很多消费品能够快速地在工厂中进行组装。
entries.en: With pre-programmed nano-circuits, many consumer products can be rapidly assembled in fabricators.

entries.zh: 对物件的图样进行储存后，这些终端可以复制生产已储存的物件。
entries.en: These kiosks can replicate any pre-approved object if its pattern has been stored within their memory banks.

entries.zh: 在矿物开采站中内置精炼厂将会大幅提升采矿效率。
entries.en: The addition of internal refineries on mining stations will substantially increase mineral production.

entries.zh: 增加扫描仪距离后，可以更快辨识矿物分布，从而增加矿物开采效率。
entries.en: Increased scanner range will allow us to more quickly identify mineral concentrations, and focus our mining efforts there.

entries.zh: 短距离高能镭射，可以轻而易举地切开岩石，大幅提升采矿的效率。
entries.en: These powerful short-range lasers can easily slice through rock, making the extraction of minerals a more efficient affair.

entries.zh: 配置了采矿镭射的无人机群可以在附近进行高效采矿。
entries.en: Fleets of autonomous drones equipped with mining beams are deployed to quickly and efficiently gather nearby minerals.

entries.zh: 装配了成千上万纳米机器人的特殊探测器。可以探索到之前无法识别的矿脉，并将其加以标记，以便以后进行采集。
entries.en: These special probes are equipped with swarms of nanites that identify previously unknown mineral concentrations and mark them for later extraction.

entries.zh: 许多重要的特殊实验只有在零重力环境下才能进行。因此我们设计了这种专用实验室。
entries.en: A lot of critical research can only be done in a zero gravity environment, which these specialized laboratories are eminently designed for.

entries.zh: 有了这些遏制力场，就可以隔离收纳各种物质或者样本，以便对其进行详细研究。
entries.en: Containment force fields are excellent for isolating and holding various substances or specimens so they can be analyzed in detail.

entries.zh: 这些先进的探测器可以对物体进行次原子级别的详细分析从而获取大量宝贵的研究资料。
entries.en: Advanced probes that can thoroughly analyze subjects on a sub-atomic level, generating a wealth of valuable research data.

entries.zh: 更加自动化的空间站可以解放更多的工作人员进行科研开发。
entries.en: Increased automation of station functions will free up more staff for research duties.

entries.zh: 单从我们现处的维度世界对事物进行分析，所得到的成果只可能是片面的。一定要从多角度出发进行思考。
entries.en: Studying something from the limited perspective of a single dimensional reality does not paint the whole picture. Every angle must be considered.

entries.zh: 我们需要收集的易爆微粒性质十分不稳定，采集工作也危险重重。为了不在该过程中引起连环爆炸，需要使用能量场对微粒进行稳定化。
entries.en: Volatile Motes are fickle particles that are dangerous to work with. In order to safely harvest them without setting off a chain-reaction of explosions, energy fields must be used to stabilize the motes.

entries.zh: 异星天然气十分珍贵，但以传统方式进行采集是不可取的。只有特殊的采集技术才能对其进行收集。
entries.en: Pockets of Exotic Gas are rare and often inaccessible by conventional means. Such deposits can only be reached by using special extractor technology.

entries.zh: 在建立行星贸易所后，商机也变得更为丰富。业务将飞速拓张。
entries.en: With new planetary markets comes new opportunities for commerce. Business will be booming.

entries.zh: 当我们走出家园，漫游星海的同时，我们的经济也进入了一个全新的时代。新的市场正以惊人的速度涌现，使得经济学家们措手不及。
entries.en: As we journeyed into the cosmos and ventured beyond our home system, we also entered a new era of economics. New markets are appearing a startling rate, and economic theorists are struggling to keep up.

entries.zh: 对全息技术进行别出心裁的运用，造成了崭新的人工虚拟环境，其真实程度令人赞叹。这乃是沉浸式虚拟现实娱乐的一大进步。
entries.en: Pioneering use of holographic technology allows for the creation of artificial environments that seem as authentic as the real world. It is the next step of immersive entertainment.

entries.zh: 这到底是拜金神教的预知能力真的生效了？还是只是精密的计算方式的成果？无论如何，这个星际股市推算模型真的可以准确地推算出金融市场的走向。
entries.en: Are the precognitive powers of Numa at work or is it a matter of skilled craftsmanship? Either way this galactic stock market prediction model will forecast fluctuations in the economy with divine accuracy.

entries.zh: 这种轨道轰炸管理系统将会向目标星球同时发射上百万高速小型投射物，用垃圾数据过载该星球的防卫系统。装有该装置的船只在进行轨道轰炸时，将会造成更多伤害。
entries.en: This orbital bombardment management system spams a planet with millions of minute, high-velocity projectiles, overwhelming planetside defensive grids with trash data. Ships equipped with this component will cause more damage during orbital bombardment.

entries.zh: 这些稀有资源的大规模生产需要极为先进的纳米材料。
entries.en: The mass-production of these rare resources require particularly capable nanites.

entries.zh: 这个干燥的高原生态环境生长着寥寥无几的沙漠野草和灌木丛。
entries.en: An elevated, dry ecoregion bearing sparse vegetation of desert grasses and scrubs.

entries.zh: 这些温泉的水面上腾升着由地底热能所蒸发的水蒸气。
entries.en: Groundwater heated by geothermal processes steams from the surface of these springs.

entries.zh: 这些沙漠由于降雨量极低、极端温度以及稀少的植被，不适合绝大部分生物居住。
entries.en: With little precipitation, extreme temperatures and limited vegetation, these sandy deserts are hostile to most forms of life.

entries.zh: 行星地壳中的高温蒸气和有毒气体从这些喷气孔中泄出。
entries.en: These fumaroles vent steam and noxious gases from deep within the planet's crust.

entries.zh: 金属沉积物与超临界水在行星地壳中发生化学作用，其产生的化学物质从构造板块的裂缝中喷发而出停留在海床上。
entries.en: Metalliferous sediments react with superheated water in the planet's crust, venting chemicals along the seabed where tectonic plates diverge.

entries.zh: 溪水从高原的悬崖上流下，形成疑是银河落九天的美景。
entries.en: Picturesque vistas formed when rivers flow over the cliff-sides of steep mountainsides.

entries.zh: 在无数年前因为高压而化成固体的气体一直被完好地保存在这个超低温的湖底环境中。
entries.en: Formed under immense pressure in a bygone age, deep-freeze temperatures have kept the gases dissolved in these rimy lakes in a solid state.

entries.zh: 这片湿地因为水流缓慢、植被丰富，成为了水下植物、昆虫、沼泽瘴气的温床。
entries.en: A hotbed of aquatic plants, insects, and swamp gas, this wetland is characterized by slow-moving water and rich vegetation.

entries.zh: 这片有毒沼泽覆盖着矮植物、苔藓、以及菌类，水面上不时冒出气体。
entries.en: A noxious quagmire covered in low vegetation, mosses and fungi, where gases steam from the water's surface.

entries.zh: 这片多雨的山地上的斜坡生长着饱受狂风摧残的顽固植物。
entries.en: Wind-torn vegetation clings to the high crags and stormy cliffs of these rainy mountains.

entries.zh: 极为广阔的沙漠，其地下埋藏着罕见而又珍贵的易爆微粒。想要进行采集的话，得拥有合适的装备才行。
entries.en: A vast expanse of sand that covers scattered pockets of rare and valuable Volatile Motes. Extraction is possible with the right equipment.

entries.zh: 这些砂质洞穴和隐藏空洞中充斥着稀有的易爆微粒。
entries.en: Rare Volatile Motes condense in these sandy caves and hidden hollows.

entries.zh: 这座深入星球地壳的稳定裂口是由$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet2$制造的。
entries.en: This stable vent reaching into the planet's crust was created by $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet2$.

entries.zh: 这颗行星上绵延不绝的沙丘居然全部由纳米机器人构成。这些机器人的内部结构早已破败不堪，无法重新激活，但却为我们提供了能覆盖整个星球的稀有金属颗粒。
entries.en: The sand dunes on this planet are almost entirely composed of countless broken nanites. Their structure is degraded far beyond any chance for reactivation, but they do coat the planet in rare metal granulate.

entries.zh: 闪耀的晶体散发着光芒，犹如给这片奇异的森林盖上了一层白霜。
entries.en: Glittering crystals grow like hoarfrost in these exotic forests.

entries.zh: 大量珍贵矿脉被暴露在这些悬崖斜坡上。
entries.en: Bands of valuable mineral ores run like veins through these exposed cliff faces.

entries.zh: 这些地底洞窟富含各种金属物质和矿物储藏。
entries.en: These deep caverns are rife with metallic and mineral ore deposits.

entries.zh: 地壳运动导致这些实用的矿物在无数年前被暴露在地面上。
entries.en: Geological upheaval exposed these useful minerals to the planet's surface long ago.

entries.zh: 这片山坡上点缀着各种矿藏和珍贵的石头。
entries.en: These mountainsides glint with rich ore resources and precious stones.

entries.zh: 晶格在这个沙礁的岩石堆中闪闪发亮。
entries.en: Crystal lattices glimmer amongst the rocks and corals of this sandy reef.

entries.zh: 这个平顶山的斜坡非常陡峭，但是富含各种有用的资源。
entries.en: This flat-topped hill has steep sides lined with useful resources.

entries.zh: 这些山洞犹如巨型的晶洞，里面充斥着稀有的水晶。
entries.en: Like enormous geodes, these caves are filled on all sides with rare crystals.

entries.zh: 大量矿藏点缀着这里的海床，很适合进行深海采矿。
entries.en: Useful ore deposits line parts of the ocean floor, providing opportunities for deep-sea mining.

entries.zh: 肥沃的土壤和茂密的野草点缀着这片平原，很适合被改造为农地。
entries.en: Fertile soils and tall grasses cover these sweeping plains, providing rich potential for farmlands.

entries.zh: 泥浆般的粘土，泥沙和壤土横越地平线，当中孕育出了大量的低矮植被。
entries.en: A watery slurry of clay, silt, and loam stretches across the horizon, where low vegetation flourishes.

entries.zh: 覆盖着肥沃土壤和绿色植物的山丘地带。
entries.en: Rolling hills covered in greenery and fertile soils.

entries.zh: 莎草、灌木、以及地衣覆盖着这个高海拔的生态环境，这里的永冻心土明显比一般的情况更加富含养分。
entries.en: Sedges, shrubs and lichens cover this high-latitude biome, where the subsoil permafrost is nevertheless covered in more fertile sediment.

entries.zh: 冷冰冰的多岩树林中生长着大量草本下层植被。
entries.en: Cold, rocky woods with herbaceous understories.

entries.zh: 这片海拔极低的湿地蕴含着大量的植物养分。
entries.en: These low-lying wetlands provide a wealth of plant nutrients.

entries.zh: 过度浓密的植被和林冠导致这片丛林的土壤算不上肥沃，不过植物和果树倒是不计其数。
entries.en: With a dense canopy and nigh-impenetrable vegetation density, these jungles are poor in soil quality, but rich in plant life and fruit-bearing trees.

entries.zh: 潮湿的苔藓、地衣、以及菌类犹如给这片崎岖的山地覆盖上了一层绿色的地毯。
entries.en: Dewy moss, lichens and fungi form a plush carpet that stretches across these rocky lands.

entries.zh: 这些广阔的洞窟网络生长着各种各样的可食用菌菇，它们不需要任何阳光或肥沃土壤依然能够茁壮成长。
entries.en: These extensive cave networks are covered in many species of edible fungi, which require neither sunlight nor fertile soil to flourish.

entries.zh: 与其说是森林，这一带完全是由高耸入云的巨型菌菇所组成。这些菌菇的顶盖形成一片遮天蔽日的林冠，为大量微小生物创造了绝佳的生态环境。
entries.en: In lieu of trees, towering mushrooms dominate these fecund forests, the enormous caps of fungal giants blotting out sunlight to create the perfect environment for a rich variety of smaller specimens.

entries.zh: 这片辽阔的平原堪称是完美的农田选地。
entries.en: This vast stretch of open plains provides ideal farmland.

entries.zh: 这个绿洲堪称是这片荒土上的碧水明珠。
entries.en: A shimmering jewel of water and greenery in a barren wasteland.

entries.zh: 这里的河流流速极慢，因此孕育着大量的浅水生物和植物。
entries.en: A slow-flowing river of enormous volume provides water and vegetation for a rich abundance of life.

entries.zh: 这些土壤湿度极高，而且富含植物成长所需的化合物，很适合用来耕种。
entries.en: With a remarkably high moisture capacity and high amounts of chemicals integral to plant life, these soils promise impressive agricultural yields.

entries.zh: 这个生气勃勃的生态环境充斥着各种珊瑚礁、鱼类、软体动物、哺乳动物、无脊椎动物、以及海洋生物。
entries.en: A vibrant ecosystem brimming with corals, fish, mollusks, mammals, invertebrates, and all kinds of edible marine life.

entries.zh: 这个世外桃源般的岛屿上生长的硕果累累的树木和多样的植被无疑将带来丰收。
entries.en: From fruit-laden trees to plentiful fauna, the bounties of this paradisaical island promise a rich harvest.

entries.zh: 坍塌的建筑只剩下一副空空如也的金属架子，当风掠过，这空架子似乎发出了悲鸣声。
entries.en: The hollowed-out metal skeletons of fallen infrastructure seem almost to groan as the wind whistles through them.

entries.zh: 有毒的化学废料在烈日的暴晒下腐败并散发着薄烟。
entries.en: Toxic biohazard waste rots and fumes in vast heaps under the sun.

entries.zh: 成千上万个珍贵的贝塞里安石点缀着这片区域。
entries.en: Thousands upon thousands of valuable Betharian stones glint like stars in these fields.

entries.zh: 这个原始山谷隐藏于环绕四周的群山间，从四处掠食的猛兽保护着其独有的动物群。
entries.en: This pristine valley lies sheltered amongst the surrounding mountains, its fauna shielded from roving predators.

entries.zh: 这些多风的平原因静电而嗞嗡作响。
entries.en: These windy plains crackle with static electricity.

entries.zh: 浅层断层把丰富的矿脉带到了地表。
entries.en: Shallow faults have brought rich mineral veins to the surface.

entries.zh: 这些平原被大自然细分为规则得惊人的几何形状，成为了极适宜农业开发的天然地形。
entries.en: These plains are naturally subdivided into alarmingly regular geometric shapes, ready for agricultural exploitation.

entries.zh: 22世纪末进行的大型恢复再开发行动十分有效，除了几处最为顽固的放射区域以外，其它区域都已经恢复了正常。核泄漏事件以来的基因突变率已降至最低点。
entries.en: Reclamation efforts in the late 22nd century eliminated all but the most stubborn pockets of radiation, and mutation levels are now at an all-time low since the Containment Breach.

entries.zh: 当年绿色撒哈拉行动刚刚被提出时，伊兹奎多教授受到了各界的冷嘲热讽……但现在应该已经没人记得了吧。
entries.en: Few today remember the vicious ridicule that Operation Green Sahara faced when it was first proposed by Professor Izquierdo.

entries.zh: 美索不达米亚城市走廊
几乎遍及整个新月沃地的这个巨大都市，其本身就是对文明发源之地的致敬。
entries.en: The megalopolis that stretches along most of the Fertile Crescent is in itself a monument to this ancient birthplace of civilization.

entries.zh: 波士顿-华盛顿都市枢纽
波士顿-华盛顿暴动给整整一代人留下了难以抚平的创伤。也正是因为如此，才引致了大刀阔斧的法律改革。永远不要忘记前人的牺牲！
entries.en: The BosWash Riots traumatized an entire generation and led to sweeping legal reforms. Never Forget!

entries.zh: 在这里，铁切尔上校和他余下寥寥的兵士们进行了他们世界闻名的背水一战。直到现在，也偶尔会在此处发现当年没有爆炸的哑弹。
entries.en: Unexploded munitions are still occasionally found near the compound where Colonel Tetchu and the remnants of his brigade made their famous last stand.

entries.zh: 当萨蒂斯711494号迫近地球的消息传来时，造成了72年的大规模恐慌事件。每个人都认为地球大限已至——该来的最终还是来了。幸运的是，萨蒂斯711494号的体积并没有大到摧毁整个地球，但阿尔伯塔的大半部分还是不幸从地图上被抹去了。
entries.en: When 711494 Satis approached Earth and triggered the Great Panic of '72, everyone thought this was it - the Big One had finally arrived. Fortunately, it wasn't big enough to cause an extinction event. Unfortunately, it wiped out much of Alberta.

entries.zh: 只有潜到海底才能看到的壮观景象。好似能一直蔓延下去，没有尽头。
entries.en: Invisible until you plunge beneath the waves, the algae tracts seem to stretch into infinity.

entries.zh: 直到22世纪末，吉祥天商业高塔一直是地球上最高的建筑。其特殊的造型直到现在都是德里城区一道独特的风景。
entries.en: Lakshmi Commerce Tower was the tallest building on Earth for the better part of the 22nd century, and its unique shape remains an iconic feature of the Delhi skyline.

entries.zh: 珠江区域是地球上第一个被正式归类为巨型都市的地区。在此处发扬光大的金三角防污染政策将会被世界各地的大型城市所相继运用。
entries.en: The first region on Earth to be officially designated a megacity. Several other developing urban regions would eventually adopt their own versions of the Golden Delta's successful anti-pollution policies.

entries.zh: 人类制造的大量塑料垃圾已经覆盖了太平洋的一大部分。
entries.en: A swirling miasma of plastic refuse covers a good portion of Earth's largest ocean.

entries.zh: 这个世界的迁徙森林频繁集体迁移到新的地区，破坏建设好的道路，输电线路和其他基础设施。
entries.en: The mobile forests of this world frequently migrate en masse to new regions, disrupting efforts at building roads, power lines and other infrastructure.

entries.zh: 这整个地区被隔离以供迁徙森林生长。它们可以在这里安全地生活，不用担心对城市造成任何破坏。
entries.en: This entire region has been set aside for the migrating forests that are native to this world. Here they can roam in peace, without causing damage to urban areas.

entries.zh: 这个垃圾场无边无际，偶尔还能看见拔地而起的巨大废料。
entries.en: The wastes stretch as far as one can see, with occasional pieces of larger junk jutting up out of the ground.

entries.zh: 一道道狭窄的小溪串流在垃圾场中，导致局部土壤异常肥沃。
entries.en: These narrow canals snake around the junk piles, and some of the adjacent soil is surprisingly fertile.

entries.zh: 这些垃圾堆下的地底洞窟很适合用来建设反应堆。
entries.en: These hollows deep beneath the surface junk would serve well as isolated reactor chambers.

entries.zh: 一场辐射量爆表的太阳耀斑横扫了这个偏僻的山谷。
entries.en: A solar flare has washed this isolated valley with heavy radiation.

entries.zh: 这山谷之中矗立着十分神秘的石碑，上面刻满了已经不再流通的外星语言。靠近石碑时，能够感觉到充满能量波动的低鸣声，同时会感受到头痛。
entries.en: This valley is home to a mysterious obelisk that is covered in letters from a dead alien language. It hums with power and those in its proximity suffer headaches.

entries.zh: 这片被遗弃的宅地曾经居住着一种爬行类物种。虽然他们依然存在于此行星上，但是现已退化成非智能生物了。
entries.en: These abandoned homesteads were once inhabited by a society of reptiles. They still populate the planet, but have since lost all capacity for sapient though.

entries.zh: 这座星球上有片十三公里见方的区域，散布着起源未知的遗迹，以及许多古怪而独特的异星造物。令人困惑的是，它同时也使到访者产生心满意足的情绪。
entries.en: A thirteen-by-thirteen kilometer stretch of land on this planet is a ruin of unknown origin, littered with many bizarre and unique alien artifacts. Bafflingly, it also produces sensations of deep contentment in its visitors.

entries.zh: 这片山谷的土壤非常肥沃，因此遍布着各种青葱的植物。
entries.en: The soil in this valley is extremely fertile, and it is covered in intense greenery.

entries.zh: 这个古代矿场虽然年代久远，但是大部分采矿设备依然可以正常运作。
entries.en: The site of an ancient mining operation. Despite its age, much of the equipment can still be operated.

entries.zh: 不停运作的大型工厂，将高分子聚合物塑造成形状各异而用途未知小物件。
entries.en: Complex machinery ceaselessly molds complex polymers into small items of varying shapes and inscrutable purpose.

entries.zh: 死去的突变体堆叠在一起构成恐怖的景象。不稳定的有机物质扭曲在一起，形成了某种结构。
entries.en: A putrid mass of dead mutated horrors. Their volatile organic matter has twisted together to form a structure of sorts.

entries.zh: 此行星在无数年前曾遭遇过猛烈的轨道轰炸。地面上依然遍布着轰炸所产生的巨坑。
entries.en: This world was subjected to intense orbital bombardment long ago. Parts of the surface are still pockmarked with impact craters.

entries.zh: 此行星上曾经存在过某种文明，但是被外来的异星势力摧毁了。这个遍布残骸的古代战场诉说着他们绝望的挣扎。
entries.en: The civilization that once inhabited this world was destroyed by an invading force from somewhere beyond their solar system. This ancient battlefield is littered with ancient debris from their desperate last stand.

entries.zh: 生存在这个星球上的两个超级大国间曾经爆发了一场大型核战，这就是战争留下的废墟。
entries.en: Remnants from a massive nuclear war waged by the two global superpowers that once inhabited this world.

entries.zh: 大型陨石坠落到地面所产生的陨石坑。坑中残留着陨石上的矿物。
entries.en: A crater from a large meteor impact. Minerals from the meteor itself can still be found at the site.

entries.zh: 十分精妙的工厂，似乎是某个文明遗留在这个星球上的。可以生产珍贵资源。
entries.en: A well-crafted facility that produces high value resources, left on the planet by a different civilization.

entries.zh: 十分古老的粒子加速器，其构造却很有新意。从还能够运行的部件中可以获取大量研究资料。这些资料一定是由某个天才物理学家收集整合的。
entries.en: This old particle accelerator was built using a novel design, and the surviving terminals within the structure contain a massive amount of research data composed by what must have been a brilliant theoretical physicist.

entries.zh: 面积巨大的地下避难所，应该是被这个星球的原住民用来当做防空洞的。不过在储存的食物耗尽后，这些原住民就开始互相残杀了。
entries.en: A massive underground vault, intended as a bomb shelter by this world's original inhabitants. The vault's occupants turned on each other when their food ran out.

entries.zh: 面积巨大的地下避难所，应该是被这个星球的原住民用来当做防空洞的。避难所中有着庞大的机械园区以及大量的挖掘装备。
entries.en: A massive underground vault, intended as a bomb shelter by this world's original inhabitants. The vault contains a huge machine park along with stores of mining equipment.

entries.zh: 当这个环形世界仍然是废墟的时候，有几百个外星克隆生物被封存在冷冻保存仓之中。现在这些被修复的冷冻仓成为了一所纪念碑。
entries.en: Hundreds of alien clones were left sealed in cryostasis chambers when this Ring World was still a ruin. Now fully restored, the clones have been preserved in this monument.

entries.zh: 在这个世界的深海底部可以发现上千个互相连接着的丘穴，如同巨大的白蚁群落所构建的一般。其实这里是远古智慧节肢动物所留下来的遗迹。
entries.en: Thousands upon thousands of interconnected termite-like mounds can be found far beneath the ocean on this world, the last remnants of an ancient species of sapient arthropoids.

entries.zh: 该星球土生土长的真菌类生物经过基因工程改造后，变得十分温顺，而且……口感极佳。在这些庞大的培养场中，这些生物经过喂养后将会被收割，成为食物。
entries.en: The fungoids native to this planet were genetically engineered to be docile... and delicious. In these vast processing pens, the fungoids are nourished and then harvested.

entries.zh: 种满了可食用植物的广袤田地上，远古太阳能收割机被用于帮助收割。
entries.en: Vast fields of dense, edible vegetation where ancient solar-powered harvesters assist in gathering crops.

entries.zh: 这个世界海洋的绝大部分都被某种海藻所构成的网络所覆盖，这似乎某种十分原始简陋的生体电脑。
entries.en: The oceans on this world are almost completely covered in a fine network of algae that appear to be a primitive wetware computer.

entries.zh: 在这个区域居住的当地物种似乎都在作为同一个生物共同生存着。
entries.en: The indigenous creatures who inhabit this region appear to operate as a single organism.

entries.zh: 一排排的遥控采矿平台，每个都配置有高压水泵以将采掘自地底的矿物经钻井抽送上地面。
entries.en: Rows upon rows of remote operation mining platforms where highly pressurized water jets pump valuable minerals from underground rock beds via boreholes.

entries.zh: 视觉植入体望不到边的无尽的反应堆设施群。
entries.en: A stretch of reactor complexes reaching almost farther than the ocular implant can see.

entries.zh: 十分庞大的地下洞穴网络，其中有许多处菌落农场，狩猎园地，以及充斥着可食用动植物的湖泊。
entries.en: A network of vast caverns which contain numerous fungal farms, hunting areas, and lakes teeming with edible flora and fauna.

entries.zh: 通过这些地下隧道，可以到达从地表无法触及的富饶矿脉。
entries.en: Underground tunnels lead to a variety of mineral-rich ore veins inaccessible from the surface.

entries.zh: 奔流的地下河道与行星的熔融核心所产生的地热能为这颗行星提供了十分充足的能源。
entries.en: Subterranean rivers and the geothermal energy from the molten core of the planet offer vast potential for energy generation.

entries.zh: 供地下居民与地上居民见面商讨的区域，使两者可以共创和平与繁荣。
entries.en: An area where Subterranean dwellers and Surfacers can work together towards peace and prosperity.

entries.zh: 这些地下区域正在被住在当地的文明进行最大化利用。
entries.en: These Subterranean areas are currently fully exploited by the Civilization living there.

entries.zh: 这些地下区域正在被住在当地的文明进行最大化利用。
entries.en: These Subterranean areas are currently fully exploited by the Civilization living there.

entries.zh: 这些地下区域正在被住在当地的文明进行最大化利用。
entries.en: These Subterranean areas are currently fully exploited by the Civilization living there.

entries.zh: 这里充斥了大量的地下居民尸体。如果想要使用此处，得先要将尸体全部移除才行。
entries.en: Vast numbers of dead Subterraneans need to be removed before we can make use of these areas.

entries.zh: 这里充斥了大量的地下居民尸体。如果想要使用此处，得先要将尸体全部移除才行。
entries.en: Vast numbers of dead Subterraneans need to be removed before we can make use of these areas.

entries.zh: 这里充斥了大量的地下居民尸体。如果想要使用此处，得先要将尸体全部移除才行。
entries.en: Vast numbers of dead Subterraneans need to be removed before we can make use of these areas.

entries.zh: 建造在位面传送门附近的安全设施，研究人员在此探索其奥秘。
entries.en: A secure complex has been built around the Dimensional Portal to house research staff dedicated to probing its mysteries.

entries.zh: 建造在位面传送门附近的安全设施，研究人员在此探索其奥秘。
entries.en: A secure complex has been built around the Dimensional Portal to house research staff dedicated to probing its mysteries.

entries.zh: 这有毒粘液是真菌生物被消灭后仅剩的残留物。
entries.en: This toxic goo is all that remains of the exterminated Fungoids.

entries.zh: 覆盖这颗城市星球的理想城已化为废墟。尽管其地基仍然坚实，许多腐朽的建筑结构仍需被清理才可进行重建。
entries.en: The Arcologies which cover this City-Planet lie in ruins. While the foundations are still solid, much of the decaying structure will need to be cleared before we can rebuild.

entries.zh: 一个被废弃残骸覆盖的广阔平原。惊人之处在于，这其中还有一些残骸尚能部分运作。
entries.en: A vast plain covered in wreckage. Amazingly, some still seems to be semi-functional.

entries.zh: 我们将融世界于一城，筑一城为世界。
entries.en: Thus shall we make a world of the city, and a city of the world.

entries.zh: —将星球变成§Y$pc_city$§!，增加£housing£§Y$PLANET_HOUSING_TITLE$§!，§Y资源生产§!和§Y人口增长§!并解锁特殊的£district£§Y理想城区划§!。\n—§R无法发展§!£district£§Y发电§!、§Y采矿§!和§Y农业区划§!。\n—在该过程中所有的£district£§Y区划§!建设将被§R禁用§!。

entries.zh: 无边无际的理想城覆盖了行星上的每一个角落，形成一个环球都会，一个普世之城。
entries.en: An unceasing stretch of arcologies will unite the planet from pole to pole, creating one global megacity, one ecumenopolis.

entries.zh: 范格利大气层除臭器部署
展出由艺术家联盟为我们国家创作的震撼人心的艺术纪念碑。它肯定会让我们的公民们感到兴奋与鼓舞。
entries.en: Exhibit the stirring art monument created for our nation by the Artisan Troupe. It is sure to delight and inspire our citizens.

entries.zh: 撤除由艺术家联盟为我们国家创作的艺术纪念碑。它将被存放起来以备未来之用。
entries.en: Remove the art monument created for our nation by the Artisan Troupe. It will be placed in storage for future use.

entries.zh: 由艺术家联盟创作的一座令人振奋的艺术纪念碑正在这个殖民地上展出。
entries.en: A stirring art monument created by the Artisan Troupe is being exhibited on this colony.

entries.zh: 通过对地形改造和娱乐科学的精心研究，我们将有可能把整个星球都按照休闲娱乐为目标进行设计建设。
entries.en: With careful study devoted to landscaping and the science of fun, the construction of entire worlds dedicated to leisure can be made possible.

entries.zh: 开发特殊的流放世界可以让罪犯居住于此通过劳动改过自新。不过部分罪犯或许须要进行永久性的劳改。
entries.en: Through the development of special penal worlds, criminals can be rehabilitated through honest, hard labor. Some may be in need of permanent rehabilitation.

entries.zh: 通过创造特殊的奴隶繁殖世界，我们可以确保廉价劳工的稳定供应。
entries.en: Through the creation of special slave-breeding worlds, we can ensure that we will always have a steady supply of disposable laborers.

entries.zh: 奢华和享受的天堂，这个星球为那些想远离日常生活的单调、全身心投入到快乐的人提供了一个世外桃源。
entries.en: A haven of luxury and leisure, this planet offers an escape for those seeking to indulge in pleasures far from the monotony of everyday life.

entries.zh: 此行星是用来流放重罪罪犯的，他们会被关在劳改营中赎偿他们的罪过.对许多人来说，他们一生都无法赎清罪行。
entries.en: This world is filled with strictly controlled criminals, paying off their debt to society in labor camps. For many, the debt will never be repaid.

entries.zh: 这个星球是为了从被奴役的人口中挖掘出最大的潜力而建造的。奴隶离开这个行星的主要途径是通过专门的军事中心，把他们锻造成忠诚的仆从军，为无情的战争做好准备。
entries.en: This world is purpose-built to extract the maximum potential from an enslaved population. The main way off the planet for slaves is through specialized military centers that forge them into loyal battle thrall armies, conditioned for relentless warfare.

entries.zh: 星球上奴隶人口的简陋住所。
entries.en: Crude dwellings for the planet's enslaved population.

entries.zh: 这些住宅是为有些特权的奴隶监工们准备的。
entries.en: These homes are reserved for the relatively privileged slave overseers.

entries.zh: 为星球添加一个随机§Y行星特征§!。
entries.en: Adds a random §YPlanetary Feature§! to the planet.

entries.zh: 对星球进行深入调查和勘探，可揭露尚未发现的天然资源。
entries.en: Extensive surveying and prospecting of the planet will let us uncover the presence of natural resources that may otherwise have eluded us.

entries.zh: 向行星添加一个§Y自然保护区障碍§!。
entries.en: Adds a §YNature Preserve Blocker§! to the planet.

entries.zh: 有了卓越的规划和指导，这颗星球可以成为所有生态系统的真正避难所。
entries.en: With superior planning and guidance, this planet can serve as a true sanctuary for all ecosystems.

entries.zh: 我们可以将这颗星球转变为一座全行星尺寸的度假胜地、一处星际规模的奢华享受之所。对其表面的建设必须严格地限制以保留行星的全部自然之美。
entries.en: We can convert this world into a planet-spanning network of resorts, a testament to luxury and leisure on an interstellar scale. Construction on the surface must be severely limited to preserve the planet's natural beauty.

entries.zh: 禁止在行星上建设大部分£building£§Y建筑§!并移除除§Y$district_resort_plural$§!以外的£district£§Y区划§!

entries.en: £trigger_no£ The planet must be unspoiled by district and building development.

entries.en: £trigger_no£ There must be no active construction on §Y[Root.GetName]§!.

entries.en: £trigger_no£ The planet may not have an upgraded capital building.

entries.zh: 该星球将不再作为特殊度假胜地，所有地表建造限制也将解除。
entries.en: This world will no longer be considered a special resort, and all construction restrictions on its surface are lifted.

entries.zh: 成熟舱和营养浆罐是这颗行星的重要基础设施，工蜂机在这里孵育年轻的生物体，将其融入集体。
entries.en: Maturation pods and nutrition slurry tanks are pivotal to this planet's infrastructure, where drones prepare young biologicals for integration into the collective.

entries.en: We shall repurpose this world for other uses.

entries.en: This world is purpose-built to extract the maximum potential from an enslaved population. The main way off the planet for slaves is through specialized military centers that forge them into loyal battle thrall armies, conditioned for relentless warfare.

entries.zh: 该星球将不再作为奴隶星球，将会拆除所有与奴隶有关的基础设施。
entries.en: This world will no longer be considered a Thrall-World, dismantling any slave-focused infrastructure.

entries.zh: 将这整颗星球作为一座巨大的惩戒殖民地。庞大的监狱社群基本上由囚犯们自治，而惩罚通常意味着被流放到严酷的荒野中。
entries.en: This entire world is set aside as a massive penal colony. The vast prison communities are largely self-managed by the prisoners, and punishment often means exile into the unforgiving wilderness.

entries.zh: 增加该行星上的£crime£§Y犯罪度§!和§Y迁入影响力§!\n\n降低其他己方行星上的£crime£§Y犯罪度§!
entries.en: Increases £crime£ §YCrime§! and §YImmigration Pull§! on the planet\n\nReduces £crime£ §YCrime§! on all other owned planets

entries.zh: 解除这颗星球的惩戒殖民地身份，其居民也将获得与其它星球的居民同样的权利与责任。
entries.en: The status as a penal colony is removed from this world, and its inhabitants are afforded the same rights and responsibilities as any other planet.

entries.zh: 这座设施负责管理整颗度假星球。
entries.en: The central complex from where this planet-wide resort is administrated.

entries.zh: 一座错综复杂的管理综合区，可以管理更多的度假村和旅游景点。
entries.en: A huge sprawling complex capable of administrating an even greater number of resorts and tourist attractions.

entries.zh: 统治这个奴隶星球的奢华宫殿。
entries.en: The lavish palace from which this Thrall-World is governed.

entries.zh: 供奴隶星球统治阶级居住的奢华宫殿群。
entries.en: Sprawling and luxurious palaces that house the ruling elite of the Thrall-World.

entries.zh: 万能型性生物学的诞生彻底改变了我们的社会面貌。虽然有时候需要更换性别来繁殖是有点麻烦。
entries.en: The invention of universal sexual biology has revolutionized society. Even if it sometimes requires awkward rotations to make a connection.

entries.zh: 免费分发营养食品可以确保人口的健康和高速增长。
entries.en: Healthy and rapid growth will be assured by the generous distribution of proper nutrition.

entries.zh: 此[GetPlanetArkship]当前在通过免费分发营养食品来鼓励人口增长。
entries.en: This [GetPlanetArkship] is currently encouraging growth via the generous distribution of proper nutrition.

entries.zh: 这里的居民本是为这里的美景而来，最终因为这里的全新家庭影院设备和定制的舒适服装而决定定居下来。
entries.en: Come for the sights, stay for the brand new home holo-theatre installations and custom-fit athleisure wear.

entries.zh: 百姓的舒适度是通过特殊的奢侈品和民用品的分配计划来提升的。
entries.en: The provision of amenities to the populace is being bolstered by way of a special distribution program, delivering luxury and consumer goods.

entries.zh: 哪怕采取极端的措施，也必须将人口数量控制在可控范围内。
entries.en: Population growth must not be allowed to outstrip administrative capacity, even if it requires drastic measures.

entries.zh: 停止该[From.GetPlanetArkship]上所有£pop£ §H人口增长§!。\n\n期限内降低£stability£ §R稳定度§!。
entries.en: Stops all £pop£ §HPop Growth§! on the [From.GetPlanetArkship].\n\nReduces £stability£ §RStability§! while active.

entries.zh: 宣布执行人口增长限制。
entries.en: A limit on population growth has been declared.
There is no need for further Drones on this [From.GetPlanetArkship] at the moment.

entries.zh: 暂停[From.GetPlanetArkship]上的所有£pop£ §H人口增长§!。

entries.en: Drone production has stopped for now.

entries.zh: 计划生育不再对人口施加限制措施。
entries.en: Population planning will no longer enforce restrictive measures.

entries.zh: £pop£ §H人口§!可在该[From.GetPlanetArkship]上正常增长\n\n增加£stability£ §G稳定度§!
停止在这艘[From.GetPlanetArkship]上组装机器人、智能人以及合成人。
entries.en: Ceases the assembly of Robot, Droid, and Synthetic Pops on this [From.GetPlanetArkship].

entries.zh: 停止[From.GetPlanetArkship]上机器人、智能人以及合成人的组装。
entries.en: Stops Robot, Droid, and Synthetic Pop assembly on the [From.GetPlanetArkship].

entries.zh: 恢复该[From.GetPlanetArkship]上机器人、智能人以及合成人的组装。
entries.en: Resumes the assembly of Robot, Droid, and Synthetic Pops on this [From.GetPlanetArkship].

entries.zh: 恢复该[From.GetPlanetArkship]上机器人、智能人以及合成人的组装。
entries.en: Resumes assembly of Robot, Droid, and Synthetic Pops on this [From.GetPlanetArkship].

entries.zh: 机器人，智能人以及合成人的组装目前已经停止。
entries.en: The assembly of Robot, Droid, and Synthetic Pops has ceased for now.

entries.zh: 这处殖民地上的人口过于拥挤，需要我们采取极端措施。[From.GetPlanetArkship]上将展开一场大规模的“抽奖活动”，而“中奖者”将被驱逐，如有必要甚至可采用强制手段。
entries.en: The overcrowded conditions on this world require drastic measures. A massive [From.GetPlanetArkship]-wide lottery is held, and the "winners" are expelled - by force, if necessary.

entries.zh: 从[From.GetPlanetArkship]上驱逐§Y最多1千§!£pop£ §H人口§!以减少拥挤。被驱逐的人口将成为难民，并可能在其他帝国定居。
entries.en: Expels §Yup to 1K§! £pop£ §HPops§! from the [From.GetPlanetArkship] to reduce overcrowding. Expelled Pops will become refugees and may settle in other empires.

entries.zh: 从[From.GetPlanetArkship]放逐最多§Y1千§!£pop£ §H人口§!以减缓人口拥挤的问题\n\n暂时性降低£stability£ §R稳定度§!
entries.en: Expels up to §Y1K§! £pop£ §HPops§! from the [From.GetPlanetArkship] to reduce overcrowding\n\nTemporarily reduces £stability£ §RStability§!

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$没有可放逐的£pop£§H人口§!（无法放逐精英、未开智或机械人口）。
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$No valid £pop£ §HPops§! to expel (cannot expel Elites, Pre-Sapient or Mechanical Pops).

entries.zh: 作为减少人口拥挤的极端措施，这颗星球上的一大批人口最近被强制驱逐了。
entries.en: As a drastic measure to reduce overcrowding, a large segment of this world's population was recently forcibly expelled.

entries.zh: 这座中枢建筑的本地磁盘正在运行奴玛女神的神圣算法插件，提高了整座[From.GetPlanetArkship]的能源产量。
entries.en: The local drive on this hub is running Numa's Divine Algorithm add-on for improved energy production [From.GetPlanetArkship]-wide.

entries.zh: 奴玛女神的神圣算法目前正在这颗星球上生效。
entries.en: Numa's divine algorithm is currently active on this world.

entries.zh: 若在某艘[From.GetPlanetArkship]上的资源和生活空间十分稀缺，计划生育就有实施的必要。实行政策减少人口的自然增长。
entries.en: If resources and living space are at a premium, population planning might be necessary on this [From.GetPlanetArkship]. Measures will then be taken to voluntarily curtail population growth.

entries.zh: 减少[From.GetPlanetArkship]的£pop£ §H人口增长§!。\n\n生效时增加§R人口维护费§!。
entries.en: Reduces £pop£ §HPop Growth§! on the [From.GetPlanetArkship].\n\nIncreases §RPop Upkeep§! while active.

entries.zh: 这个星球已经实施了几项旨在控制人口增长的政策。
entries.en: This world has implemented several measures designed to discourage population growth.

entries.zh: 这将取消为控制人口增长而在这个星球实行的政策。
entries.en: This will remove the political measures that were taken on this world to discourage population growth.

entries.zh: £pop£ §H人口§!现在可在[From.GetPlanetArkship]上正常增长。\n\n减少§G人口维护费§!。
entries.en: £pop£ §HPops§! can grow normally on the [From.GetPlanetArkship].\n\nReduces §GPop Upkeep§!.

entries.zh: 宣布此处为我方宗教信仰的圣域。信仰我教的虔诚信徒们将会为了一睹圣域而千里迢迢而来。
entries.en: Declare this to be a sacred place, consecrated in the traditions of our faith. Pilgrims will travel from afar to rejoice in its holy aura.

entries.en: This revokes the object's sacred status.

entries.en: Most local functions of government are suspended, and the planet is placed under direct military control in an attempt to restore civil order.

entries.en: The state of Martial Law on the planet comes to end.

entries.en: Through the deployment of specialized warforms, the Hive Mind can ensure that rogue elements on the planet are found and dealt with.

entries.en: The Hunter-Killer drones on the planet are recalled.

entries.zh: 机械智能将会使用大量无人机监控设施，保证整个行星的人口正常运转与无条件服从。
entries.en: Through the use of extensive drone surveillance the Machine Intelligence can ensure planetside cooperation and compliance.

entries.en: End the state of heightened surveillance on the planet and restore normal machine functions.

entries.zh: 该行星上的强制服从协议已经结束。
entries.en: The Compliance Protocols on the planet come to end.

entries.zh: 这颗星球目前处于戒严状态。
entries.en: This planet has been placed under martial law.

entries.zh: 猎杀子个体正在积极消灭星球上的反叛个体。
entries.en: Hunter-Killer Drones are actively eliminating rogue elements on the planet.

entries.zh: 星球上的不服从个体正在积极地被消灭。
entries.en: Non-compliant elements are being actively eliminated on the planet.

entries.zh: 整个星球都被都市与工业集群覆盖。从太空中已经无法辨认其地壳的自然形态了。
entries.en: World completely engulfed by urban-industrial sprawl. Its natural lithosphere is no longer discernible from orbit.

entries.zh: 达到了第九阶别的沙克瓦，对于内心焦点与心灵凝视都有特殊的修成……
entries.en: A level nine Shakvah with enhanced mind focus and inner gaze...

entries.zh: 这个物种通过训练掌握了拜金教神圣的管理艺术。
entries.en: This species has been trained in the holy art of Numistic administration.

entries.zh: 肃正协议破坏了这颗行星上的发电厂区划。
entries.en: The Contingency has sabotaged the Generator Districts on this planet.

entries.zh: 肃正协议破坏了数处发电厂区划。
entries.en: The Contingency has sabotaged several Generator Districts.

entries.zh: 我们的一些人口在其所居住的行星上进行了破坏活动，之后便自我了结了。
entries.en: Several of our Pops conducted sabotage on the planets they were on before self-terminating.

entries.zh: 此政府致力于全体公民的完全平等。不管他们处于什么地位，被分配了什么工作，所有人的价值都是完全相同的。
entries.en: This government promotes total equality for all of its citizens, regardless of their jobs or assigned tasks. One life is worth the same as any other.

entries.zh: 该政府是一个完全由公民拥有的商业企业，由管务员监督出现的任何争议。
entries.en: This government is a commercial enterprise wholly owned by its citizens, with stewards overseeing any disputes that arise.

entries.zh: 该政府是一家庞大而无情的商业集团，其作风与犯罪组织有许多相似之处。
entries.en: This government is an enormous and ruthless business syndicate, which shares many of its operating practices with organized crime.

entries.zh: 该政府的组织类似宗教集团，并且依靠各种罪犯与企业组织来维持自身。
entries.en: This government is structured like a religious cult that relies on a variety of criminal and corporate enterprises to sustain itself.

entries.zh: §Y你的帝国§!获得了§R负面媒体报道§!修正效果。\n\n添加§R敌对环境§!修正效果至[From.From.GetName]。
entries.en: §YYour Empire§! gains the §RNegative Media Coverage§! modifier.\n\nAdds the §RHostile Environment§! modifier to [From.From.GetName].

entries.zh: §Y你的帝国§!获得了§R负面媒体报道§!修正效果。
entries.en: §YYour Empire§! gains the §RNegative Media Coverage§! modifier.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]在§Y[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]§!恒星系内发现了一种此前未知的战略资源，称为§H稀有水晶§!。它们在聚焦极光束方面十分有效，同时也是许多先进电子用品的必备材料。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed §HRare Crystals§! in the §Y[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]§! system. They have properties that help focus laser beams, and are also a critical component in most advanced electronics.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]在§Y[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]§!恒星系内发现了一种此前未知的战略资源，称为§H异星天然气§!。这些气体具有多种潜在用途，包括用于先进能量武器、立场护盾、飞船染料甚至作为消遣性药品使用。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed §HExotic Gases§! in the §Y[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]§! system. They have various potential applications, including advanced energy-based weaponry, force fields, starship fuel, and even recreational drugs.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]在§Y[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]§!恒星系内发现了一种此前未知的战略资源，称为§H易爆微粒§!。这些微粒中蕴含着大量的能量，作为能源、燃料甚至炸药都十分出色。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed §HVolatile Motes§! in the §Y[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]§! system. They contain immense energy, with applications ranging from energy production and fuel to explosives.

entries.zh:
层层叠加的都市终于完全覆盖了星球的地表。

自从这一宏大计划开始实施以来仅仅过了数年，但已经很难回想起[Root.GetName]从前的面貌。翠绿的丛林？崎岖的山脉？现在放眼望去，四面八方都是延绵不绝的钢铁。

这里曾经由自然法则任意塑造，而现在则成了由坚定的目的锤炼而成的设计。
entries.en:
Layers upon layers of urban sprawl eclipse the globe's crust, and it is done.

Scant few years have passed since the start of this grand project, but it is already difficult to recall what the surface of [Root.GetName] was like. Verdant? Rugged? It is all steel now, miles in every direction.

A place once molded by chance and the unthinking laws of nature, now a design wrought from indomitable purpose.

entries.zh: 这个星球是一个大型黑社会组织的老巢。
entries.en: This world is home to a large criminal underworld.

entries.zh: 这个星球上失业人员获取的福利补助暂时提升。
entries.en: Benefits for the unemployed have been temporarily increased on this world.

entries.zh: 此行星启用了昂贵的活动计划，可以有效防止无业和闲置的子个体变得反常。
entries.en: An expensive activity program has been implemented on this world to prevent unemployed and idle drones from turning to deviancy.

entries.zh: 此行星上的所有无业和闲置的无人机都会进入待命模式以防止腐化和反常程序的出现，不过此模式会增加人口维护费用。
entries.en: All unemployed and idle drone units on this world have been put into standby mode to prevent them from developing corrupt and deviant programming, increasing their maintenance costs.

entries.zh: 这个星球存在着一个大型反常子个体社群，该社群已不再听从蜂巢思维的指令。
entries.en: This world is home to large communities of deviant drones, who no longer respond to commands from the Hive Mind.

entries.zh: 此行星上存在着数个反常与腐化无人机的网络，这些无人机的运行不受核心智能的限制。
entries.en: This world is home to several networks of deviant and corrupted drone units, who operate outside the established parameters set by the core intelligence.

entries.zh: 这个星球上正在发生着一场两个或以上犯罪组织之间的帮派战争，伤亡情况十分惨烈。帮派之间爆发出激烈地斗争，而当地的警察安保队伍因此深陷泥沼。
entries.en: This world is currently in the middle of a very destructive gang war between two or more organized crime factions. Heavy fighting is ongoing between the rivalling gangs, with local security forces trapped in the middle.

entries.zh: 这个世界已经成为了毒品交易的中心。每天都有大量违禁药品被运送经过这个行星，而其居民也有不少已经染上了毒瘾。
entries.en: This world has become a major center of drug trade. Illegal narcotics are being smuggled planetside on a daily basis, with a large segment of the populace being regular users.

entries.zh: 这个星球目前已经被一个黑社会组织所完全掌控了。他们充斥在社会的每一个阶层，掌控着星球的每一个角落。
entries.en: This world is currently dominated by a single criminal organization. They have infiltrated all layers of society, and little happens here without their involvement or permission.

entries.zh: 这个星球是一个主要走私港口。这个星域中大部分的走私货物都在此转手。
entries.en: This world is considered a major smuggler port, and much of the illegal cargo being traded in this part of the galaxy passes through here at one point or another.

entries.zh: 我们所管辖的世界中，有一颗行星的犯罪组织日渐壮大，正在向星际进发，导致了海盗活动的增加。
entries.en: Powerful criminal elements on one of our worlds have expanded their influence into space, leading to a temporary increase in piracy.

entries.zh: 这个世界中的几名高官最近被发现收取了当地犯罪组织的贿赂。
entries.en: Several high-ranking officials on this world were recently discovered to have been in the pay of local criminal organizations.

entries.zh: 高成瘾性危险药物的滥用充斥着这个星球。
entries.en: The illegal use of dangerous and highly addictive drugs is widespread on this world.

entries.zh: 这个世界的走私活动日渐增加，以至于对此处的贸易盈利造成了负面影响。
entries.en: An increase in smuggler activity on this world has had a negative impact on profits from trade.

entries.zh: 这个世界正面临一场犯罪狂潮。
entries.en: This world is currently experiencing a crime wave.

entries.zh: 这个世界的帮派战争十分激烈，不少地区都对希望来此的人提出旅行警告建议，这大大减少了前来此处进行买卖的商人。
entries.en: The violent gang warfare on this world has led to a travel advisory which has greatly diminished the number of visiting traders.

entries.zh: 这个世界的贩毒团伙十分猖狂，正在进行争夺领地的低强度战争。
entries.en: The powerful drug cartels that have carved up this world between themselves are currently fighting a low-intensity war.

entries.zh: 统治这个世界的黑社会组织在到处收取保护费。
entries.en: The mobsters who rule this world have implemented an extensive protection racket.

entries.zh: 最近发现该星球殖民地的大部分管理机构成员已被当地最大的犯罪组织收买。
entries.en: The vast majority of this world's colony administration was recently revealed to have been in the employ of its dominant crime syndicate.

entries.zh: 统治这个世界的犯罪组织通过中间人控制了部分航空港。因此当地贸易的很大一部分都要通过他们经手。
entries.en: The gangster syndicate ruling this world has assumed control over several spaceports through intermediaries. A large portion of local trade now has to go through them.

entries.zh: 这个行星上的一个重要的犯罪头目最近被逮捕了，使得整个犯罪组织都濒临瘫痪。
entries.en: An important crime boss was recently arrested on this world, crippling a major criminal organization.

entries.zh: 这位领袖对法律和秩序有坚定的信仰。
entries.en: This leader has strong convictions about law and order.

entries.zh: 这位领袖愿意为个人利益歪曲法律。
entries.en: This leader is willing to bend the law for personal benefit.

entries.zh: 最近关于§H[From.From.GetTitle][From.From.GetName]§!与犯罪组织有关联的传闻散播得沸沸扬扬。虽然[From.From.GetTitle]本人声称这些传闻都只是其政治对手的恶意造谣，但新近浮上水面的证据却表明事情没那么简单……
entries.en: Whispers and rumors concerning possible ties to organized crime have surrounded §H[From.From.GetTitle] [From.From.GetName]§! for some time now. The [From.From.GetTitle] has dismissed these claims as malicious libel invented by political rivals, but recent evidence suggests there may be more to it than that...

entries.zh: §H[From.From.GetTitle][From.From.GetName]§!由于积极与犯罪斗争而声名远扬。[From.From.GetSheHeCap]公开宣誓，只要世界上仍然存在腐败与不公就一定要铲除它们。
entries.en: §H[From.From.GetTitle] [From.From.GetName]§! has gained a well-earned reputation as a crime fighter. [From.From.GetSheHeCap] [From.From.GetHasHave] publicly vowed to root out corruption and injustice wherever it might be found.

entries.zh: 开展大型打击犯罪行动，为执法者们提供更多资源，以对抗日渐上升的犯罪率。
entries.en: Launches an extensive crime prevention campaign which empowers our Enforcers with additional resources to combat rising crime levels.

entries.zh: 与星球上势力最大的犯罪头目进行秘密交涉，只要他们不做过于出格显眼的事情我们就在许多方便做出一定的让步。
entries.en: Secretly negotiate a deal with the planet's prominent criminal leaders where they agree to keep their organizations partly in line in exchange for various concessions.

entries.zh: 终止与犯罪头目的交易
终止我们与星球上的首要犯罪分子之间进行的交易。这将在星球上造成一段时间的大幅动荡。
entries.en: End our ongoing deal with the leading criminal elements on the planet. This will cause considerable turmoil on the planet for a time.

entries.zh: 结束目前正在进行的打击犯罪活动。
entries.en: Put an end to the ongoing crime prevention campaign.

entries.zh: 该星球的执法者们正在进行大型扫黑除恶行动。
