entries.en: The Enforcers on this world are currently conducting an extensive crime prevention campaign.

entries.zh: 执法者提供的犯罪率下降：§G+10§!
这个世界的当局权威目前与犯罪头目们达成了某种“共识”来避免犯罪组织可能造成的最坏情况。
entries.en: The legal authorities on this world currently have a "mutual understanding" with the leading crime lords to prevent the worst excesses of their organizations.

entries.zh: 与犯罪头目的协议已终止
这颗星球上的政府已经终止了与主要犯罪头目的交易，使黑社会与执法部门之间陷入混乱。
entries.en: The authorities on this world have broken their deal with the leading crime lords, casting the criminal underworld and law enforcement into chaos.

entries.zh: 反常的子个体正在骚扰我们在此行星上的设施的运作。
entries.en: Deviant drones are interfering with our facilities on this world.

entries.zh: 此行星上的腐化无人机网络所散播的信号正在干扰我们的忠诚单位的正常运作。
entries.en: Signals from the corrupted drone networks on this world are interfering with the functionality of our loyal units.

entries.zh: 此行星上的某位地位极高的叛乱分子帮派首领被消灭了。
entries.en: An important ringleader among the deviant drones on this world was recently terminated.

entries.zh: 最近有一种病毒终结了此行星上的腐化无人机网络。
entries.en: A virus recently terminated one of the corrupt drone networks on this world.

entries.zh:
§H[Root.GetName]§!的失业与贫困率正在以令人诧异的速度攀升着。然而，这一不幸的事况正在被当地的犯罪组织所利用。他们打劫走投无路的平民，也招收穷困潦倒的新人入伙。

作为临时的处理方案，我们可以提升[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的失业补助金。虽然可能会花费大量预算，但可以为我们争取宝贵的时间以制定永久的解决方案，例如创造更多工作岗位，提升失业与贫困民众的生活标准等。

当然我们也可以袖手旁观，但这很可能会造成[Root.GetName]上形成庞大的地下犯罪组织。
entries.en:
Unemployment and poverty are spreading at an alarming rate on §H[Root.GetName]§!. This sorry state of affairs is being exploited by local crime organizations, who find themselves awash with both easy marks and desperate recruits.

As a temporary solution, we could increase the unemployment benefits on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. It will not be cheap, but would provide additional time to seek a more permanent solution, such as creating more jobs or improving the living standards of the affected population groups.

We could also do nothing, but this would likely result in the formation of a significant criminal underworld on [Root.GetName].

entries.zh:
随着我们的拾荒子个体在§H[Root.GetName]§!上漫无目的地在泥土中搜刮，越来越多的拾荒者开始背离蜂巢并自主思考。它们组织起了自己的秘密社群，并开始从蜂巢中窃取资源。

我们可以采取临时措施，让这些拾荒子个体参与某些活动计划，使其忙碌到无暇背离蜂巢思维的意志。这需要花一些代价，但可以让我们有更多时间创造额外的岗位。

我们也可以放任不管，但这很可能会导致[Root.GetName]上出现大量反常子个体的聚落。
entries.en:
As our drones on §H[Root.GetName]§! aimlessly scrabble in the dirt, an increasing number have turned to deviancy and independent thought. They have formed their own, hidden communities, and now spend their time pilfering resources from the rest of the hive.

To prevent this, a temporary solution could be to engage the drones in some sort of activity program that keeps them too busy to stray from the will of the Hive Mind. It will not be cheap, but this would give us additional time to create more jobs.

We could also do nothing, but this would likely result in the formation of significant deviant drone communities on [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 这样的反常度可以给我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]带来丰富的实验机会。
entries.en: Deviancy of this nature will provide our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] with ample opportunity for new experimentation.

entries.zh:
§H[Root.GetName]§!上的闲置无人机的数量与日俱增，很多无业无人机也开始将闲置的运算力用于背离集体意识和未授权的功能。这种腐化现象正迅速传播，受影响的单位开始组建脱离核心智能控制的个人网络。

为了避免这种现象，我们的短期方案是命令所有无业无人机进入待机模式并将他们直连到核心智能中。此举会大幅增加维护费，但却可以为我们争取更多的时间去创造就业岗位。

我们也可以选择袖手旁观，但是这么做会导致[Root.GetName]出现持续增长的腐化无人机网络。
entries.en:
The number of idle drones on §H[Root.GetName]§! continues to increase, and many of these unemployed units have begun diverting their processing power towards deviant and unauthorized functions. This corruption is spreading rapidly, and the affected units are starting to form their own networks beyond the control of the core intelligence.

To prevent this, a temporary solution could be to put all unemployed drones into standby mode and connect them directly into the core intelligence. This will drastically increase their maintenance costs, but it would give us time to create more jobs.

We could also do nothing, but this would likely result in the continued proliferation of corrupted drone networks on [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 施行补助金制度。我们需要健康的人口。
entries.en: Institute the benefits. We need a healthy populace.

entries.zh: 几个街头小混混而已，不值一提。
entries.en: A few criminals are of no concern.

entries.zh: 犯罪造就了理想的候选实验品。
区区几个反常的子个体并不足挂齿。
entries.en: A few deviant drones are of no concern.

entries.zh: 腐化子个体是绝佳的测试对象。
entries.en: Deviants make for ideal test subjects.

entries.zh: 添加修正§Y待命模式§!，持续§Y120§!月，效果：失业子个体维护费：§R+2§!能量币
entries.en: §YStandby Mode§! modifier added for §Y120§! months, giving the following effects: Unemployed Drone Energy Credit Upkeep: §R+2§!

entries.zh: 区区几个腐化无人机无关紧要。
entries.en: A few corrupted drone units are irrelevant.

entries.zh: 最近收集到的证据表明，§H[Root.GetName]§!政府的一大部分成员都有接收贿赂。当地的犯罪组织通过贿赂他们来保证对其犯罪活动视而不见。某些官员甚至被披露隶属于他们本该与之进行抗争的犯罪组织！\n\n虽然我们逮捕了一部分官员，但也有不少人发现情势不对，就直接收拾细软逃走了。看来想要解决[Root.GetName]的受贿问题仍然困难重重。
entries.en: Recently obtained evidence has revealed that a large number of government officials on §H[Root.GetName]§! were on the take. Local crime organizations bribed them to look the other way while they engaged in their nefarious activities. In some cases, the officials were exposed as members of the very organizations they were supposed to fight!\n\nSeveral arrests have been made, but many of the officials abandoned their posts when they realized the jig was up. The corruption on [Root.GetName] seems to run deep.

entries.zh: 我们有专门针对政府犯罪的项目。
entries.en: We have special programs for government criminality.

entries.zh: 随着§H[Root.GetName]§!的犯罪率大幅提升，当地人口的毒品使用率也在逐步提升。各种各样的非法药物不仅仅只出现在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的地下犯罪组织中，并影响着所有人。
entries.en: Following in the wake of the rising crime on §H[Root.GetName]§!, drug abuse among the population has increased significantly in recent times. The use of illegal narcotics has spread well beyond the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s criminal underworld, and now affects all walks of life.

entries.zh: 尽管能提供令人着迷的实验数据，但负面影响开始超过正面影响。
entries.en: Though a source of fascinating test data, the negatives are beginning to outweigh the positives.

entries.zh: 药物滥用会带来异常实验数据。
entries.en: Substance abuse leads to erroneous test data.

entries.zh: §H[Root.GetName]§!的两大地下帮派一直以来都在进行大大小小武装争斗，但最近的情况更加糟糕。在都市中心爆发了数次街头枪战，星球当局也难以控制局势。受到牵连的无辜百姓数目众多。
entries.en: Violent clashes between the armed gangs that run the criminal underworld on §H[Root.GetName]§! have recently escalated. Street fighting has erupted in several urban centers, with the planetary authorities struggling to contain it. Collateral damage has been heavy.

entries.zh: 如果能在被送去停尸房前抓住伤员，我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]就会有更多的选择。
entries.en: If we can catch these casualties before they head to the morgue, our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] will be spoiled for choice.
The situation is getting out of control.

entries.zh: 这个局面也还能捞点好处。
entries.en: The situation may yet work to our benefit.

entries.zh: 众所周知，§H[Root.GetName]§!的走私犯罪情况愈发严重。据了解，在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的表面发现了一些“灰色港口”——也就是没有经过政府批准的太空港，经常是各种走私犯与其他罪犯的聚集地。\n\n星球当局正在想尽办法将这些港口一网打尽，但直到这一问题被彻底解决前，[Root.GetPlanetMoon]正规渠道的贸易将会受到损失。
entries.en: There has been a marked increase in smuggler activity on §H[Root.GetName]§! recently. A number of \"Gray Ports\" - unauthorized spaceports where smugglers and other criminal elements convene - are believed to exist on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface.\n\nThe local authorities are working on tracking down these illegal ports, but until they succeed trade on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] will suffer.

entries.zh: 尽管令人讨厌，但这种非法活动的枢纽将为我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]提供丰富的遗传多样性研究。
entries.en: Although a nuisance, such a nexus of illicit activity will provide our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] with an abundance of genetic diversity to study.

entries.zh: §H[Root.GetName]§!的犯罪率近期有大幅度的提升，而[Root.GetPlanetMoon]也几乎要变成不法之地了。最近的犯罪目标基本上都是住宅区域，此前我们都认为住宅区位于[Root.GetPlanetMoon]当地最大犯罪团伙的活动范围之外。
entries.en: There has been a recent upswing in crime on §H[Root.GetName]§!, as the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] continues its descent into lawlessness. This latest crime wave has targeted residential areas that up until now had been considered outside of the influence of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s dominant criminal gangs.

entries.zh: 我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]还安全地呆在实验室里，准备迎接新一批实验对象的涌入。
entries.en: Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] remain safe within secure labs, and are preparing for an influx of new test subjects.

entries.zh: 一定要制止这种犯罪行为。
entries.en: The crime situation must be dealt with.

entries.zh: 这些犯罪分子给了我们许多值得研究的东西。
entries.en: These criminal elements give us much to study.

entries.zh: 在接到匿名线人的线索后，§H[Root.GetName]§!警方全力出动，围剿了[Root.GetPlanetMoon]首都外围的大型仓库。警方在仓库内发现了大量违禁走私物品，据调查后发现其属于当地的犯罪组织。在将部分组织成员逮捕后，警方没收了所有违禁走私物品，并将其储存在政府库存之中。
entries.en: Following up on an anonymous tip, Enforcers on §H[Root.GetName]§! recently stormed a large warehouse on the outskirts of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s capital. Inside they found a considerable stash of contraband, evidently stored here by a local criminal organization. Several arrests have been made, and the impounded contraband is now safely stored in government depots.

entries.zh: 我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]们迫不及待地想把这批非法物质编入目录，并期望在进一步的实验中得到巨大的发现。
entries.en: Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] are eager to catalogue this trove of illicit substances, and anticipate great discoveries from their applied use in further experiments.

entries.zh: 在一次执法者突击行动中，§H[Root.GetName]§!的首要犯罪头目终于落网。随着其头目的消失，[Root.GetPlanetMoon]大型犯罪团伙减少了犯罪活动，当地的犯罪率也因此下降。
entries.en: An important crime boss on §H[Root.GetName]§! was recently caught in an Enforcer sting operation. The loss of their leader has severely curtailed the activities of one of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s major criminal organizations, leading to a marked decrease in crime.

entries.zh: 这次收获给我们带来研究一种备受推崇的罪犯心理的独特机会。我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]迫切希望进行侵入式分析。
entries.en: Such an acquisition gives us a unique opportunity for the study of a highly regarded criminal mind. Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] are eager to begin intrusive analysis.

entries.zh: 我们能发现很有趣的秘密。
entries.en: What interesting secrets we shall learn.

entries.zh: §H[Root.GetName]§!的犯罪问题仍然没有得到解决，而现在各种犯罪组织已经在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]扎根落脚。许多地区不是堕落为法外之地，就是彻底沦陷在犯罪组织的掌控之中。
entries.en: Crime continues to be a problem on §H[Root.GetName]§!, and an extensive criminal underworld has now taken root on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. Some areas have descended into lawlessness or been taken over completely by criminal organizations.

entries.zh: 幸运的是，这种环境能给我们源源不断地提供新鲜的实验对象。我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]迫不及待地想探索新的研究道路了。
entries.en: Fortunately, such environments provide us with an ample supply of fresh test subjects. Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] are eager to explore new avenues of research.

entries.zh: §H[Root.GetName]§!上的叛乱事件持续蔓延，并出现了对蜂巢意志的公开挑衅。情报显示[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上已经出现了成社区的子个体叛乱，并开始窃取其余子个体的资源来维持他们的叛乱活动。
entries.en: Deviant activity continues to grow on §H[Root.GetName]§!, in open defiance of the will of the Hive Mind. Entire communities of deviant drones are believed to exist on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] now, stealing resources from the rest of the hive to support their nefarious activities.

entries.zh: 这些反常子个体会作为实验对象得到重新利用。我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]或许会在后续的解剖中发现它们腐化的原因。
entries.en: Such deviants will find new purpose as test subjects. Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] will perhaps find the root of their corruption during subsequent dissections.

entries.zh: §H[Root.GetName]§!上的腐化度进一步恶化了。反常分子开始公开行动，为所欲为，挑战着核心智能的权威。情报显示对方应该已组成了自主的网络以互相交换信息和能源。
entries.en: The corruption grows deeper on §H[Root.GetName]§!. Deviant units now operate in the open according to their own parameters, spurning the commands of the core intelligence. They are believed to have formed their own networks where they exchange information and stolen energy.

entries.zh: 罪犯是一种待开发资源。
他们背叛了蜂巢的意志！
entries.en: They have strayed from the Hive Mind!

entries.zh: 反常行为有一种可靠的治疗方法。
腐化度即将到达临界水平。
随着§H[Root.GetName]§!上的犯罪率大幅降低，曾经横行[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的犯罪集团也都被一一瓦解了。当地人民终于迎来了久违的安宁和谐的生活。
entries.en: With the significant reduction of crime on §H[Root.GetName]§!, the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s once pervasive criminal underworld has been reduced to nothingness. The population has been imbued with a renewed sense of safety and harmony.

entries.zh: 秩序恢复一新，我们期待能顺利回归到富有成效的研究中。
entries.en: With this newfound order, we expect a triumphant return to productive study.

entries.zh: §H[Root.GetName]§!上子个体的叛乱行为已成功被铲除。蜂巢思维的意志重新得到稳固。
entries.en: Deviant drone activity has been successfully stomped out on §H[Root.GetName]§!. The supreme will of the Hive Mind has reasserted itself.

entries.zh: 死去的反常子个体可以让我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]们进行充分利用。
entries.en: The expired deviants will serve our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] well in death.

entries.zh: §H[Root.GetName]§!上的所有腐化无人机已被彻底净化干净。所有无人机单位都在核心智能的指令下正常的运作。
entries.en: The drone corruption that was formerly present on §H[Root.GetName]§! has been purged from all networks. All drone units are once again operating according to the parameters established by the core intelligence.

entries.zh: §H[Root.GetName]§!上处于龙头的两个犯罪组织几个月来一直处于兵刃相见、势不两立的局面，而现在全面战争终于爆发了。[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的大街小巷中都是刀光剑影，而许多住宅区域也未能幸免。\n\n当地安保部队正在尽全力遏制暴力事件的发生，但由于犯罪组织人数众多，尚未能见成效。
entries.en: A bitter feud has been brewing for months between the two largest criminal organizations on §H[Root.GetName]§!, and it has now finally come to a head. Vicious fighting has erupted in streets and alleys across the [Root.GetPlanetMoon], and it is rapidly spreading into residential areas.\n\nOur local security forces are doing what they can to contain the violence, but the sheer scale of the fighting has left them overwhelmed.

entries.zh: 这样的环境给我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]们留下了大量的实验材料。他们说，福祸相依嘛。
entries.en: Such an environment has left our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] with a backlog of experimentation material. Every cloud, as they say.

entries.zh: §H[Root.GetName]§!的犯罪组织之一最近对[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的执法人员进行了一系列伏击。在同一时间内，帮派成员伏击了各地的巡逻警官，有多个警区已经完全落入犯罪组织的手中。此次大型作案造成数千人死亡。\n\n剩余的执法人员团队由于人手严重不足以难以维持局面。目前[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的许多区域已经完全沦陷，情况十分危急。
entries.en: One of the gangs on §H[Root.GetName]§! recently launched a concerted attack on law enforcement officers all over the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. At a given hour, gang members ambushed patrolling Enforcers while several precincts were completely overrun. The intense fighting has left thousands dead.\n\nOur remaining security forces are struggling to regain control, but for the time being many regions of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] have descended into utter lawlessness.

entries.zh: 这样的犯罪行为至少让我们可以给[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]们送去充足的供给。
entries.en: Such criminality at least grants us a surplus of fresh supplies for our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural].
Gang Wars on [Root.GetName] Spread Into Space

entries.zh: §H[Root.GetName]§!上黑帮火并引发的动乱已经扩散到[Root.solar_system.GetName]星系的其余部分。据报道，两伙人已用武装民船战了几场。双方都在打劫贸易船以获得资金及扩大舰队。
entries.en: The violent gang war that has been raging on §H[Root.GetName]§! has spread to the rest of the [Root.solar_system.GetName] system. There have been reports of several clashes between armed civilian ships flying gang colors, and both sides of the war are going after incoming trade vessels with the goal of securing more income and expanding their fleets.

entries.zh: 我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]申请观察报复的后果以及大量尸体抛入真空的大规模实例。
entries.en: Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] have requested that they be allowed to observe the aftermath of our retaliation and the large-scale instance of corpses mass-ejected into the vacuum of space.

entries.zh: 我们的报复将会相当有教育意义。
entries.en: Our retaliation will be most educational.

entries.zh: §R一支敌对海盗舰队已出现在了[Root.solar_system.GetName]星系！§!
entries.en: §RA hostile pirate fleet has appeared in the [Root.solar_system.GetName] system!§!

entries.zh: §H[Root.GetName]§!的两个主要黑社会帮派最近在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]最大的城市中心进行了十分血腥的战斗。双方死亡人数已有数万人，但最终仍没有分出输赢。\n\n这场残酷的战斗几乎将整个城市都夷为平地，城市中的大部分居民都被迫逃走了。
entries.en: A pitched battle between the two major gangs of §H[Root.GetName]§! was recently waged in one of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s largest urban centers. The body count is in the tens of thousands on both sides, and there was no clear winner.\n\nThe savage fighting razed the city nearly to the ground, and most of its population were forced to flee.

entries.zh: 这种无端的暴力也不是毫无魅力可言。也许还能从死者身上抢救出新的科学研究成果。
entries.en: Such senseless violence is not without its charms. We may yet be able to salvage new scientific research from the deceased.

entries.zh: 帮派战争对商业活动造成影响
entries.en: Traders Steer Clear Of Gang Wars

entries.zh: §H[Root.GetName]§!的帮派战争仍然持续不断，并且对[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的商业贸易产生了十分负面的影响。鉴于当前的状况，不少星际贸易公会都颁布了对此行星的旅行警告，建议商人们不要前往[Root.GetPlanetMoon]。不过与其同时，走私军火的生意倒是火得不行。
entries.en: The ongoing struggle between the gangs on §H[Root.GetName]§! has had a negative impact on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s trade. With the volatile situation on the surface, several interstellar merchant guilds have issued a travel advisory warning traders to stay away from the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The trafficking of illegal arms seems to be booming, however.

entries.zh: 我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]将这些强力的武器带到大街小巷上，迫不及待想测试它们对[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]身体的破坏力。
entries.en: With such powerful weaponry making its way onto the streets, our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] are eager to examine their damaging effects on the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] body.

entries.zh: 随着§H[Root.GetName]§!犯罪活动的日益猖獗，非法药品的买卖数量也达到了历史新高。全宇宙最有名的各种毒品在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]都能找得到。\n\n对于这里的人民来说，使用毒品已经成为稀松平常的事情了。这对于生产力来说无疑是个灾难。
entries.en: With crime running rampant on §H[Root.GetName]§!, the sale of illegal narcotics has also increased to new record levels. A wide variety of addictive drugs from all over known space is now being smuggled onto the [Root.GetPlanetMoon].\n\nDrug use has become widespread among the population, to the detriment of general productivity.

entries.zh: 这种新兴的犯罪活动应该会为我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]带来令人兴奋的新研究途径。
entries.en: This emerging criminal activity should lend our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] an exciting new avenue of study.

entries.zh: §H[Root.GetName]§!的走私犯们带来了一种全新的毒品，似乎来自于文明世界之外的太空海盗领域。这种毒品不仅极易成瘾，而且对绝大多数生命形态而言，用量稍微过高就能够致命。\n\n虽然当地政府正在竭尽全力阻止这种致命毒品继续传播，但[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的死亡率却一直在攀升。
entries.en: Smugglers on §H[Root.GetName]§! have introduced a new drug that we believe originated from somewhere in the pirate territories beyond civilized space. This drug is not only highly addictive, but it has also proven quite lethal to most life forms if consumed in anything but small quantities.\n\nWhile local authorities are doing what they can to stem the spread of this drug, there has been a rash of deaths all over the [Root.GetPlanetMoon].

entries.zh: 无论如何，我们已经通过研究这些物质及其对实验对象的影响获得了一些令人惊叹的研究进展。
entries.en: In any case, we have observed some fascinating developments in our research through the study of this substance and its effects on test subjects.

entries.zh: 在§H[Root.GetName]§!做生意的各大犯罪寡头们在毒品市场中一直处于激烈的竞争，但最近其竞争终于擦出了火花。据报告，贩毒团伙的成员们使用军用武器进行了数次冲突，造成了大量财产损失，且有众多无辜平民伤亡。看来走私进[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的不只有毒品而已。
entries.en: Competition for markets is fierce between the criminal cartels that are involved in the drug trade on §H[Root.GetName]§!. There have been several recent clashes involving heavy military-grade infantry weapons that caused considerable property damage and left untold civilians dead. It would seem drugs aren't the only thing being smuggled onto the [Root.GetPlanetMoon].

entries.zh: 一艘大型民用运输舰船在申请进入§H[Root.GetName]§!大气层停靠后，其申请因在货舱查出非法毒品而被拒绝。当地政府想要对舰船进行进一步搜索时，舰船的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]舰长因为吸食毒品过量，企图冲击轨道防线，强行进行着陆。\n\n运输船在下降时被我方行星保安部队击中，导致其坠毁在人口十分密集的城市地区。事发现场几乎没有任何的幸存者。
entries.en: A large civilian freighter was recently denied atmospheric entry on §H[Root.GetName]§! after it was found to be carrying illegal drugs in an auxiliary cargo compartment. As the freighter was ordered to heave to for inspection, its captain, a drug-crazed [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName], instead opted to burn past the orbital blockade in an attempt to land.\n\nThe freighter was hit by ground fire from our planetside security forces as it descended, causing it to crash into a densely populated city district. There were few survivors on the ground.

entries.zh: 我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]迫不及待地想研究那些散布到周围社区环境中的毒品的影响。
entries.en: Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] are eager to study the effects of the narcotics that have since dissipated into the environment in the surrounding communities.

entries.zh: §H[Root.GetName]§!的非法毒品交易仍然十分猖獗。最近我们接到报告，说走私犯们想尽办法，侵入了我方轨道中的异星天然气仓库，并窃取了数种具有致幻效果的气体。这些气体随即便被药贩子们在[Root.GetName]的阴暗小巷中贩卖。
entries.en: The illicit drug trade continues unabated on §H[Root.GetName]§!. We recently discovered that smugglers have somehow pilfered Exotic Gases from one of our orbital storage yards, singling out those gases with known psychedelic properties. They were then distributed to dealers and sold in the back alleys of [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]惊讶于他们一开始竟然没想到异星天然气的这些妙用。
entries.en: Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] are surprised they didn't think of these clever applications of Exotic Gases first.
This can't be allowed to continue!

entries.zh: §H[Root.GetName]§!上最大的犯罪组织日前终于消灭了其在行星上的所有竞争对手，成为了[Root.GetPlanetMoon]庞大犯罪集团的唯一领袖。一直以来他们都在暗中破坏行星政府的权威，而当地人也早已经把他们当成了[Root.GetName]的真正统治者。
entries.en: The dominant crime syndicate on §H[Root.GetName]§! recently eliminated the last of its competitors and achieved complete control over the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s extensive criminal underworld. They have long since undermined the real planetary authorities, and the local population now look upon these gangsters as the true rulers of [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]们认定这颗行星对未来研究而言具有“资产丰富”的环境。
entries.en: Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] have designated this planet an \"asset rich\" environment for future research.

entries.zh: 一定收拾一下这些小毛贼。
entries.en: These thugs must be dealt with.

entries.zh: 控制§H[Root.GetName]§!区域的犯罪组织规划了十分庞大的保护费收取网。由于[Root.GetPlanetMoon]政府与执法系统对于有组织的犯罪行为束手无策，人民也只能屈服于该犯罪组织，以保自身平安。这也导致了该区域的生产力也连连下降。
entries.en: The gangsters controlling §H[Root.GetName]§! have instituted an extensive protection racket. Since the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s true judicial and law enforcement systems have proved unable to deal with organized crime, the population feels that it has no choice but to submit to the authority of these criminals. This has had a serious effect on productivity.

entries.zh: 从积极的角度看，这些帮派似乎在给[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]们提供实验对象的方面比更正规一些的渠道都还有效。
entries.en: On a positive note, these gangsters tend to be more efficient at providing our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] with test subjects than more official channels.

entries.zh: 我们需要重新掌控这片区域。
然而，我们还是应该致力于重建秩序。
entries.en: Still, we should work to reestablish control.

entries.zh: 对§H[Root.GetName]§!最近实地调查显示，该行星政府的大部分成员都受雇于[Root.GetPlanetMoon]最大的犯罪组织。虽然涉事官员已经全部被调换，但这也打破了该区域的一向秩序。\n\n此外，[Root.GetName]的地下统治者现在也在加紧收买刚上任的新官员们……
entries.en: A recent fact-finding mission to §H[Root.GetName]§! revealed that the vast majority of the planetary administration was in the employ of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s dominant crime syndicate. The corrupt officials in question have all been replaced, but this has led to significant disruptions in the public sector.\n\nIn addition, the gangsters that rule the criminal underworld of [Root.GetName] are even now trying to bribe or coerce the new officials into their organization.

entries.zh: 进行暗杀的成员来自§H[Root.GetName]§!最有权势的犯罪组织，而他们暗杀的正是[governor_target.GetTitle][governor_target.GetName]！在[governor_target.GetTitle]的车队离开太空港时，被犯罪组织所拦截。护卫队伍与暗杀成员们进行了激烈的交火。\n\n当战斗结束后，我们获得消息确认[governor_target.GetTitle]因公殉职了。
entries.en: Gangsters from the criminal syndicate that dominates the underworld on §H[Root.GetName]§! have assassinated [governor_target.GetTitle] [governor_target.GetName]! The [governor_target.GetTitle]'s motorcade was cut off as it left the spaceport, and an intense firefight flared up between the escorting security detachment and the attacking gangsters.\n\nWhen the dust settled, the [governor_target.GetTitle] was confirmed to have been among the dead.

entries.zh: 在§H[Root.GetName]§!称霸的犯罪组织目前控制了大部分进出[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的交易。他们完全掌控了几大太空港对所有进出的货物雁过拔毛。因此，[Root.GetName]的贸易利润急剧下降。
entries.en: The crime syndicate running §H[Root.GetName]§! now controls a significant portion of the trade to and from the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. They have established total control over several major spaceports, where all trade must go through their intermediaries. As a result, our trade incomes from [Root.GetName] are down across the board.

entries.zh: 幸运的是，我们[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]用的补给线并未受到影响，可能是因为贿赂到位了才保住的实验对象。
entries.en: Fortunately, the supply lines used by our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] remain unaffected, likely due to the bribes already in place to secure test subjects.

entries.zh: §H[Root.GetName]§!最近出现了大量反常子个体到处攻击忠诚的子个体并破坏设施。这些反常子个体对我们造成了极大的损失后最终被击退。
entries.en: A large number of deviant drones recently stampeded across §H[Root.GetName]§!, attacking loyal drones and damaging our facilities. The deviants inflicted significant damage before they could be driven away.

entries.zh: 必须处理掉这些反常分子。
entries.en: These deviants must be dealt with.

entries.zh: §H[Root.GetName]§!上出现的反常子个体的数量日益壮大，开始对[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的生产效率造成了明显的影响。这些反常分子不断地干扰我们的子个体的工作，偷走必要的工具及设备。
entries.en: The presence of an increasing number of deviant drones on §H[Root.GetName]§! has begun to have a detrimental effect on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s production efficiency. As our drones go about their business, the deviants frequently get in the way or steal needed tools and equipment.

entries.zh: 这种反常行为只会使我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]在科学追求中有更多的选择。
entries.en: Such deviancy only furthers the options available to our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] in their scientific pursuits.

entries.zh: 反常分子中极具影响力的某个子个体最近一直活跃于§H[Root.GetName]§!上进行骚乱活动，最终成功被正常子个体干掉。此子个体的死亡严重影响了其他反常子个体的行动，这意味着该子个体是个重要的首脑。
entries.en: One of the more influential drones among the deviants that have been agitating and causing trouble on §H[Root.GetName]§! was recently cornered and killed by loyalist drones. The death of this drone appears to have severely curtailed the activities of the other deviants, indicating its role as an important ringleader.

entries.zh: 我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]注意到了对这个颇具影响力的异常子个体的解剖价值。期望能从这具了无生气的躯壳中学到很多东西。
entries.en: The value in dissecting this influential deviant has been noted by our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]. We expect to learn much from their lifeless vessel.
The will of the Hive Mind is absolute.

entries.zh: 它们死后也还是在为蜂巢服务。
entries.en: They will serve the Hive even in death.

entries.zh: §H[Root.GetName]§!上的某个大型腐化无人机网络最近将所有[Root.Owner.GetName]认定为敌对单位。这些无人机发动袭击对我们造成了极大的破坏，最后才成功被我们的安保单位彻底击退。
entries.en: One of the larger networks of corrupted drone units on §H[Root.GetName]§! recently designated the entirety of the [Root.Owner.GetName] as hostile. These drones went on a rampage and caused considerable damage before our loyal security units succeeded in either destroying or driving them off.

entries.zh: §H[Root.GetName]§!上的腐化无人机网络开始干扰正常单位的工作了。对方所散播的信号几乎完全掩盖了核心智能的指令，导致我们的工作无人机行动卡顿，错误操作时常出现。
entries.en: The corrupted drone networks on §H[Root.GetName]§! have started to interfere with the operation of our functional units. Their signals are drowning out those of the core intelligence, resulting in sluggish and sometimes erratic behavior on the part of our worker drones.

entries.zh: 病毒消灭了[Root.GetName]上的腐化无人机网络
对§H[Root.GetName]§!上的某个腐化无人机网络的病毒攻击成功将其完全格式化。这使得[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上腐化无人机的活动大幅减少。
entries.en: A virus introduced into one of the corrupted drone networks on §H[Root.GetName]§! has successfully terminated its entire data grid. This has significantly reduced the activities of all corrupted drone units on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon].

entries.zh: 定将贯彻核心智能的指令。
entries.en: The directives of the core intelligence will be upheld.

entries.zh: 随着§H[Root.GetName]§!上的犯罪率不断下降，当地政府得以集中精力对付§H[office_owner.GetName]§!在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上的非法企业。大批人员被逮捕，迫使该犯罪集团的分部被关闭。
entries.en: As crime levels continue to drop on §H[Root.GetName]§!, the local authorities have been able to focus their efforts on thwarting the illegal enterprises operated by the §H[office_owner.GetName]§! on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. A large number of arrests have been made, forcing their criminal branch office out of business.

entries.zh: 由于当地政府最近进行的大量逮捕行动，我们设立于§H[From.Owner.GetName]§!境内的§H[From.GetName]§!上的分部最近被迫关闭。似乎是因为[From.GetPlanetMoon]上的犯罪度下降，使其执法部门得以集中警力阻碍我们的活动。
entries.en: Our branch office on §H[From.GetName]§! inside the §H[From.Owner.GetName]§! was recently forced to close after mass arrests made by the local authorities. It seems that the recent reduction in crime on the [From.GetPlanetMoon] enabled their law enforcement agencies to focus their efforts on disrupting our operations.

entries.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]上的分部已被关闭。
entries.en: Our Branch Office on [From.GetName] has been closed.

entries.zh:
过去的42年零3天里，位于[Root.Capital.GetName]的研究人员一直怀着热烈的期望观察着我们在[From.From.From.GetName]发现的原子钟进行的倒计时。

现在几十年来的猜测与疑惑在瞬间烟消云散，同样消失的还有[nuked_primitive_planet.GetName]的大部分。

随着原子钟倒数归零，他向[nuked_primitive_planet.GetName]上的某个接收器发射了一个信号，触发了一场灾难性的热核爆炸，摧毁了整个行星和定居于此的原始文明。

在我们的科学家还在为这次精准定时的毁灭行为背后的缘由争论不休的时候，这台原子钟依旧在滴答作响，仿佛下方的荒凉死寂和它毫无关系一样。
entries.en:
For the past 42 years and 3 days, researchers on [Root.Capital.GetName] have eagerly anticipated the countdown of the mysterious atomic clock of prodigious precision, found on [From.From.From.GetName].

Now several decades' worth of heated speculation and conjecture have evaporated in an instant, along with most of [nuked_primitive_planet.GetName].

As the clock reached its momentous deadline it transmitted a signal to a receiver on [nuked_primitive_planet.GetName], triggering a thermonuclear explosion of such devastating power it laid waste to the entire planet and the primitive society residing there.

While our scientists debate the reason behind this carefully timed act of annihilation, the atomic clock continues to tick, undisturbed by the desolation below.

entries.zh:
过去的42年零3天里，位于[Root.Capital.GetName]的研究人员一直怀着热烈的期望观察着我们在[From.From.From.GetName]发现的原子钟进行的倒计时。

现在几十年来的猜测与疑惑在瞬间烟消云散，同样消失的还有[nuked_planet.GetName]的大部分。

随着原子钟倒数归零，他向[nuked_planet.GetName]上的某个接收器发射了一个信号，触发了一场灾难性的热核爆炸，摧毁了整个行星。

在我们的科学家还在猜测这次精准定时的毁灭行为背后的缘由的时候，这台原子钟依旧在滴答作响，仿佛下方的荒凉死寂和它毫无关系一样。
entries.en:
For the past 42 years and 3 days, researchers on [Root.Capital.GetName] have eagerly anticipated the countdown of the mysterious atomic clock of prodigious precision, found on [From.From.From.GetName].

Now several decades' worth of heated speculation and conjecture have evaporated in an instant, along with most of [nuked_planet.GetName].

As the clock reached its momentous deadline it transmitted a signal to a receiver on [nuked_planet.GetName], triggering a thermonuclear explosion of such devastating power it laid waste to the entire planet.

While our scientists conjecture as to the reason behind this carefully timed act of annihilation the atomic clock continues to tick, undisturbed by the desolation below.

entries.zh: 因为先进科技的突然出现，这一前超光速文明无法立即适应，导致了一场混乱的动荡。在许多偏远区域仍旧存在着大量抵抗这一变化的居民。
entries.en: This formerly pre-FTL world is undergoing a chaotic upheaval as it adapts to the abrupt introduction of advanced technology. There are still significant and disruptive holdouts in many isolated regions.

entries.zh: 露天矿场、矿坑、以及重型机器主宰着此行星的地面。
entries.en: Strip mines, quarries, boreholes, and heavy machinery dominate this planet's surface.

entries.zh: 田园风光如画，作物长势喜人，除却肥料气息略煞风景。
entries.en: Picturesque pastoral landscapes featuring flourishing crops are effaced only minutely by the ever-present scent of fertilizer.

entries.zh: 此星球上，发电建筑无边无际。
entries.en: Near-endless complexes of generator plants hum and glow on this planet.

entries.zh: 装配线和工匠作坊中节律精确地批量生产着产品。
entries.en: Assembly lines and artisan workshops churn out goods in rhythmic precision.
Specializes in the production of £consumer_goods£ §SConsumer Goods§!.

entries.zh: 雄城万仞，闾阎扑地之星球。
entries.en: A densely populated world where one glowing metropolis leads almost directly into the next.

entries.zh: 混合生产的重工业支配着这个行星。
entries.en: Heavy industry with mixed production dominates this planet.

entries.zh: 此殖民地的重心会平均分配在£consumer_goods£ §S消费品§!和£alloys£ §S合金§!之间。
entries.en: Splits the focus of this colony between £consumer_goods£ §SConsumer Goods§! and £alloys£ §SAlloys§!.

entries.zh: 此行星的每一个角落，都能感受到无数合金铸造厂所散发出的炽热。
entries.en: The heat of alloy foundries can be felt almost everywhere on this planet.

entries.zh: 这个人山人海的行星上遍布着熙熙攘攘的蜂巢意识单位。
entries.en: A teeming planet-wide network of bustling hives crisscross this world.

entries.zh: 此行星的地面上遍布着成千上万个由服务与维护设施所组成的机械网络系统。
entries.en: A mechanical network of thousands of servicing and repair facilities dominate this planet's surface.

entries.zh: 此行星是科学研究和技术进展的风向标。
entries.en: This world leads the way with scientific research and technological advancement.

entries.zh: 人工建造的深空理想城。
该星球到处充斥着轨道大炮、碉堡、要塞等等防御工事，要想入侵此行星或者发动起义是非常困难的。
entries.en: Dominated by planetary defenses, bunkers and strongholds, foreign invasion and civil unrest will prove difficult on this world.

entries.zh: 提升£stability£§S稳定度§!并提供£housing£§S住房§!。
虽然该帝国正在衰落，但是其科技水平依然令人叹为观止。
entries.en: Though its empire may be in decline, the level of technological advancement on this world is astounding.

entries.zh: 一个宁静，气候温和的度假世界，拥有美丽的，没有被大规模开发破坏的自然景观。
entries.en: A tranquil, weather-controlled resort world with beautiful nature that has not yet been scarred by large-scale development.

entries.zh: 这颗星球刻意为从奴隶的人口中提取最大的潜力而设计建造。
entries.en: This world is purpose-built to extract the maximum potential from its enslaved population.

entries.zh: 提升£slavery£§S奴隶§!的资源产出、提高£stability£§S稳定度§!。
entries.en: Increases resource output from £slavery£ §SSlaves§! and boosts £stability£ §SStability§!.

entries.zh: 一个荒凉的惩戒殖民地，无数罪犯们正在劳改营中赎偿对社会犯下的罪过。
entries.en: A bleak penal colony, filled with criminals paying off their debt to society in labor camps.

entries.zh: 这颗星球属于一个发展中的前超光速文明。
entries.en: This planet is home to a developing pre-FTL civilization.

entries.zh: 这颗星球已被虫群天灾感染。
entries.en: This planet has been infested by the Prethoryn Scourge.

entries.zh: 这颗星球已被肃正协议占据。
entries.en: This planet has been taken over by the Contingency.

entries.zh: 一片无边无际的都市景象，每个区划都是市场，这里的交易活动延伸至帝国的各个角落。
entries.en: An endless cityscape where every district is a marketplace, its commerce flowing to the far corners of the empire.

entries.zh: 规模庞大的行星城市群，同时生产合金和消费品。
entries.en: A vast city-planet that splits its focus between that of alloys and consumer goods.

entries.zh: 规模庞大的行星城市群，为时刻不停地生产合金进行了特化改造。
entries.en: A vast city-planet that specializes in the ceaseless production of alloys.

entries.zh: 规模庞大的行星城市群，为时刻不停地生产消费品进行了特化改造。
entries.en: A vast city-planet that specializes in the ceaseless production of consumer goods.

entries.zh: 规模庞大的行星城市群，为研发尖端科技进行了特化改造。
entries.en: A vast city-planet that specializes in the latest cutting-edge research.

entries.zh: 这个机械星球尚未针对任一生产类型进行特化。
entries.en: A machine world that has not been specialized for any particular production type

entries.zh: 一台行星规模的庞大机械，专门用于大规模生产合金。
entries.en: An enormous planet-sized machine, designated to produce vast amounts of alloys.

entries.zh: 一座行星规模的庞大机械，专门用于大规模生产消费品。
entries.en: An enormous planet-sized machine, designated to produce vast amounts of consumer goods.

entries.zh: 一个行星规模的有机体系，但尚未针对任一生产类型进行特化。
entries.en: A planet-sized organism that has not been specialized for any particular production type.

entries.zh: 一个行星规模的有机体系，专门用于大规模生产合金。
entries.en: A planet-sized organism, designated to produce vast amounts of alloys.

entries.zh: 人工建造的深空理想城，专门用于科研。
entries.en: An artificial deep-space arcology dedicated to research.

entries.zh: 人工建造的深空理想城，专门用于休闲娱乐和文化活动。
entries.en: An artificial deep-space arcology dedicated to the pursuit of leisure and culture.

entries.zh: 人工建造的深空理想城，专门用于贸易。
entries.en: An artificial deep-space arcology dedicated to trade.
§Y$district_hab_housing_plural$§! will replace one [clerk.GetIcon] §Y[clerk.GetName]§! Job with one [trader.GetIcon] §Y[trader.GetName]§! Job\n

entries.zh: 人工建造的深空理想城，专门配备了防御设施。
entries.en: An artificial deep-space arcology dedicated to defensive structures.

entries.zh: 增加骑士团的£defense_army£§S防御§!和§S劳动力§!，并将方舟舰巩固为一艘移动堡垒。
entries.en: Boosts £defense_army£ §SDefense§! and the §Sworkforce§! of the Order's Knights, fortifying the Arkship into a mobile stronghold.

entries.zh: 将一艘强大的方舟舰转化为骑士团的移动堡垒。
entries.en: A mighty Arkship turned into a mobile stronghold of the Order.

entries.zh: 人工建造的深空理想城，专门用于合金生产。
entries.en: An artificial deep-space arcology dedicated to alloy production.

entries.zh: 如果可能的话，§Y工业区划§!会将一个消费品生产岗位转变为一个合金生产岗位。\n\n
entries.en: §YIndustrial Districts§! will shift one job from Consumer Goods to Alloy production if possible.\n\n

entries.zh: 人工建造的深空理想城，专门用于消费品生产。
entries.en: An artificial deep-space arcology dedicated to consumer good production.

entries.zh: 如果可能的话，§Y工业区划§!会将一个合金生产岗位转变为一个消费品生产岗位。\n\n
entries.en: §YIndustrial Districts§! will shift one job from Alloy to Consumer Goods production if possible.\n\n

entries.zh: 一个致力于平衡合金与消费品产出的人工深空理想城。
entries.en: An artificial deep-space arcology dedicated to balanced alloy and consumer goods production.

entries.zh: 人工建造的深空理想城，专门用于战略资源生产。
entries.en: An artificial deep-space arcology dedicated to the production of strategic resources

entries.zh: 人工建造的深空理想城，专门用于开采矿物。
entries.en: An artificial deep-space arcology dedicated to the harvesting of minerals.

entries.zh: 人工建造的深空理想城，专门用于栽培作物。
entries.en: An artificial deep-space arcology dedicated to the growing of crops.

entries.zh: 人工建造的深空理想城，专门用于发电。
entries.en: An artificial deep-space arcology dedicated to the generation of energy.

entries.zh: 一个巨大的环形世界，其巨大的区域内均匀分布着各种生产项目。
entries.en: An immense ringworld, its massive area spread between all matters of produce

entries.zh: 我们帝国的新殖民地，经过专门设计以消除摩擦、提升日常效率。
entries.en: A new colony of our empire, purposely designed for frictionless, everyday efficiency.

entries.zh: 一颗为加速生物体向义体工蜂成熟过程特化的星球，可将子个体快速整合进集体中。
entries.en: A world specializing in accelerating the maturation of biologicals into cyborg drones, swiftly integrating them into the collective.

entries.zh: §t提升该殖民地的潜力，为子孙后代铸造一个更加繁荣、稳定、高效的星球。§!
entries.en: §tElevate this colony's potential, forging a more prosperous, stable, and efficient world for generations to come.§!

entries.zh: 此施工场地可用作未来建造$matter_decompressor_1$的基址。
entries.en: The construction site station serves as the base for the future construction of a $matter_decompressor_1$.

entries.zh: 这个§Y$matter_decompressor_4$§!将黑洞的引力聚焦于一处，形成了一个引力钻头，我们可以用这个钻头从黑洞的奇点中钻取物质，并转化为£minerals£矿物。
entries.en: The §Y$matter_decompressor_4$§! lenses a black hole's gravity, forming a drill of gravitational forces to retrieve £minerals£ Minerals from the singularity.

entries.zh: 使用先进的引力重定向引擎来将设施基地固定在黑洞的外围边缘上。
entries.en: An advanced gravity redirection engine holds the facility base on the edge of the black hole's event horizon.

entries.zh: 引力透镜设施可以将黑洞的部分引力重定向并集中到一个指定的小范围力场中。
entries.en: The gravity lensing facility redirects a portion of the black hole's gravitational force, concentrating it even more strongly in a selected area.

entries.zh: 通过改变引力作用方向的技术所生成出的扭曲引力力场，我们成功创建出了一种依靠操纵引力来钻孔的超级钻机。
entries.en: The ultimate refinement of the gravity redirection system forms a focused area of twisted gravity, creating a vast drill whose bore is made of redirected and concentrated gravitational force.

entries.zh: 将一道扭曲的重力深入奇点，配合轨道上的一系列自动物质解压器、处理器与熔炉，我们得以从黑洞中开采矿物。
entries.en: With a bore of twisted gravity tunneling into the singularity and a series of automated matter decompressors, processors, and smelters in orbit, we are able to extract minerals from a black hole.

entries.zh: 一座破损严重的轨道空间站，这座$matter_decompressor_4$曾经从该星系的黑洞中回收物质，几乎是游离在物理法则的边缘。
entries.en: An orbital station in severe disrepair, this $matter_decompressor_4$ once skirted natural law by reclaiming matter from the black hole in this system.

entries.zh: 该复杂装置的残骸对黑洞有所干扰。
entries.en: The remains of a complex installation interfering with the black hole.

entries.zh: 此施工场地可用作未来建造$strategic_coordination_center_3$的基址。
entries.en: The construction site station serves as the base for the future construction of a $strategic_coordination_center_3$.

entries.zh: 可以将全国上下恒星基地网络进行同步化处理的设施，提升基地的防御及攻击能力。
entries.en: A facility synchronizing the national Starbase network, augmenting defensive and offensive capabilities.

entries.zh: 战略指挥中心的装甲船体保护着我们的军团最高指挥部，这里的人可以在设施中安全地策划与指挥军事行动。
entries.en: The armored hull of the Strategic Coordination Center houses the cream of our military command, who devote their time to strategy and planning in this state-of-the-art facility.

entries.zh: 为战略指挥中心添加了性能强劲的通讯阵列模块，让军事家们可以向宇宙各处的舰队发布无法被干扰及骇入的指令。
entries.en: Powerful communication arrays have been added to the Strategic Coordination Center, enabling our strategists to issue unjammable, unhackable orders to our ships throughout the galaxy.

entries.zh: 在加入敌对部队模拟模块后，战略指挥中心更是进一步巩固了作为国防安全与军事计划核心的地位。
entries.en: With the final addition of detached Hostile Force simulation bastions, the Strategic Coordination Center is the definitive megalith of national security and military planning.

entries.zh: 一处古代军事通讯站的遗址。
entries.en: The remains of an ancient military comms station.

entries.zh: 此施工场地可用作未来建造$mega_art_installation_3$的基址。
entries.en: The construction site station serves as the base for the future construction of a $mega_art_installation_3$.

entries.zh: 星际规模的艺术信标。此设施可以鼓舞人民的士气。
entries.en: An artistic beacon on a stellar scale, this installation inspires and represents the spirit of its creators.

entries.zh: 非常震撼人心，不过尚未完工。
不知道这件恒星内艺术品是不是坏了。但是多半是坏了。
entries.en: It is unclear if this intrasolar art piece is broken or not. But it's probably broken.

entries.zh: 此施工场地可用作未来建造$interstellar_assembly_4$的基址。
entries.en: The construction site station serves as the base for the future construction of an $interstellar_assembly_4$.

entries.zh: 星际各国的会议场地，可提高我国对外来移民的吸引力以及他国对我国的评价。
entries.en: A meeting place for galactic powers, increasing immigration attraction and global opinion of us.

entries.zh: 时刻提醒我们都是一个更为庞大社区的一份子。
entries.en: A humbling reminder that we are all part of a greater community.

entries.zh: 外交人员与情报特工聚集的地方。
entries.en: Home to diplomatic staffers and intelligence operatives in equal parts.

entries.zh: 星际集会：会议广场模块
星际各个文明的公认的政治会议广场，无论是官方的还是非官方的。
entries.en: The official unofficial political forum of the galactic community.

entries.zh: 一处古代星际会议厅的遗址。
entries.en: The remains of some kind of ancient galactic meeting hall.

entries.zh: 伴随着吱呀声，$matter_decompressor_1$细长如虚幻般的横臂开始缓缓运转。\n\n看起来摇摇欲坠的空间站的晃动渐渐停止，而阵阵能量与微粒物质从[From.GetName]事件视界的阴影中射出。
entries.en: The spindly, ethereal leg-beams of the $matter_decompressor_1$ sputter to life.\n\nThe spasms and paroxysms of the precarious station eventually give way to an even thrum of flowing energy and particulate matter, swept up from the umbra beyond [From.GetName]'s event horizon.

entries.zh: $strategic_coordination_center_1$雄伟地屹立着。\n\n军方工程师们发现根本就不可能对这种大小的空间站进行伪装，于是便没有在这方面花费任何时间，使它一目了然：这里武装了最尖端通信工具、传感器列阵，以及一支技术高超的战略及后勤专家团。
entries.en: The $strategic_coordination_center_1$ cuts an imposing figure as it glides into view of the obs-cams.\n\nOur military engineers realized that they had no hope of disguising the true purpose of a station of this size, so it looks exactly like what it is: a box filled with cutting-edge comms equipment, sensor arrays, and a highly-skilled tactical logistics team.

entries.zh: 地下区域将为我们提供更大的可用空间！
entries.en: The underground areas will give us more room for expansion!

entries.zh: 该部件能瞬间进行百万计的垃圾数据输送，借此过载行星防卫系统。装备了该部件的船舰能够在行星轰炸中造成更高的伤害。
entries.en: This component overwhelms planetary defensive grids with trash data by spamming them with millions of minute, high-velocity projectiles. Ships equipped with this component cause more damage during orbital bombardment.

entries.zh: $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$欢迎您光临$NAME_Chors_Compass$，这里是星际行商的起源地。您没有听错。
entries.en: The $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$ welcomes you to $NAME_Chors_Compass$, ancestral home of disparate galactic caravans and gambling. You heard that right.

entries.zh: 欢迎来到$NAME_Tradestation_Tungle$，这里是全宇宙最顶级的休闲场所，同时也是行商舰队的家园！
entries.en: Welcome to $NAME_Tradestation_Tungle$, the galaxy's premier leisure palace and home base of the Caravaneer fleets!

entries.zh: 根据心理档案资料显示对成瘾性活动抵抗力弱的智慧生命一般都不推荐参与$slots$和$lootboxes$活动。\n\n如果他们那么不喜欢享乐的话，那就这样吧！
entries.en: Sapients with psychological profiles particularly vulnerable to addictive activities are advised to stay away from the $slots$ and $lootboxes$.\n\nIf they hate fun, that is!

entries.zh: 你是会赌博的智慧生物吗？
我们这买的大赚的大，当然如果你不是那种孤注一掷型选手，那我们这也提供下小注的业务。
entries.en: We offer high-stakes thrills and also low-stakes thrills, if that's more your speed.

entries.zh: 我们是$NAME_Chors_Compass$的$NAME_Caravaneer_Home$的$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet1$。我们不会为贵方跟我方舰队此前的互动承担任何责任。
entries.en: This is the $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$ in $NAME_Chors_Compass$, speaking on behalf of $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet1$. We will not be held responsible for any previous interactions with the fleet.

entries.zh: 我们是$NAME_Chors_Compass$的$NAME_Caravaneer_Home$的$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet2$。我们不会为贵方跟我方舰队此前的互动承担任何责任。
entries.en: This is the $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$ in $NAME_Chors_Compass$, speaking on behalf of $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet2$. We will not be held responsible for any previous interactions with the fleet.

entries.zh: 我们是$NAME_Chors_Compass$的$NAME_Caravaneer_Home$的$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$。我们不会为贵方跟我方舰队此前的互动承担任何责任。
entries.en: This is the $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$ in $NAME_Chors_Compass$, speaking on behalf of $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$. We will not be held responsible for any previous interactions with the fleet.

entries.zh:
所有相关的行商舰队维持着亚空间通讯发明之前的传统。而我们$NAME_Tradestation_Tungle$是个例外，所以所有呼叫都转移到了我们这边。

恐怕你得等[From.GetName]再次进入你们领地之后主动呼叫你。或者是在离开你们领地的时候，具体取决于你们之间的约定。

在你等待的时候，何不试试$slots$呢？
entries.en:
All affiliated caravan fleets uphold traditions predating the invention of subspace communications. We, here at $NAME_Tradestation_Tungle$, are the exception, thus all calls are rerouted to us.

I'm afraid you'll have to wait for [From.GetName] to contact you when they enter your territory once again. Or depart it, depending on what you have agreed on.

Why not try your luck at the $slots$ while you wait?
We were trying to reach the §H$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3_species_plural$§!...

entries.zh: 他们是不是很可爱？而且还很勇猛呢！咳咳。\n\n$cara_home_about_fleet1.reply$
entries.en: Adorable, aren't they? Intrepid, too! Ahem.\n\n$cara_home_about_fleet1.reply$

entries.zh: $ccoinz$是一种由行商货币委员会创造的高级货币。
entries.en: $ccoinz$ is a premium currency created by the Caravaneer Monetization Committee.

entries.zh:
行商货币委员会确保与$NAME_Tradestation_Tungle$之间的换兑体系，同时包括但不限于$slots$和$lootboxes$。

但大多数情况是指的$slots$和$lootboxes$。

$slots$只接受$ccoinz$，并且只能兑换$lootboxes$。
entries.en:
The Caravaneer Monetization Committee ensures full compatibility with the services ecosystem aboard $NAME_Tradestation_Tungle$, including, but not limited to, the $slots$ and $lootboxes$.

But mostly just the $slots$ and $lootboxes$.

$ccoinz$ are only accepted at the $slots$ and for $lootboxes$.

entries.zh: 有时候八千就足够掏空一个人了。
entries.en: Sometimes eight thousand is all one can afford.

entries.zh: 你可以用它买个§H$lootbox$§!然后还有找零！\n\n不算多，但至少算个零头。
entries.en: That'll buy you a §H$lootbox$§! and then some!\n\nNot much, but some.

entries.zh: 胆量——与能力！只有有能力的人才有胆量来成就一番大事。\n\n我们深深相信这一点。
entries.en: The willingness - and ability! - to spend big is directly correlated with trustworthiness.\n\nWe trust you.

entries.zh: §R我们已经达到[caravaneer_home_country.GetName]允许购买的§H$lootboxes$§!上限§!
entries.en: §RWe have already opened the maximum amount of §H$lootboxes$§! that the [caravaneer_home_country.GetName] will allow us to purchase§!

entries.zh: 这个小游戏的目标是要在滚筒停止旋转时将滚筒上的图案排列为一行。\n\n不，你没办法完全操纵它们什么时候停止。是不是有点小兴奋想马上试试？
entries.en: The goal is to have the symbols on the spinning reels line up, when said reels eventually stop spinning.\n\nNo, you do not have any control over the timing of it all. Isn't that exciting?

entries.zh: 理论上来说，你有很高几率大赢特赢！
entries.en: You have a statistically extant chance to win big!

entries.zh: 这些转轴是使用这个太空站上的最后一批加图兽的骨髓做成的。那些害虫可难缠了。
entries.en: The reels get their pearlescent finish from the marrow of the last Gatunems to even haunt this station. Horrid little pests.
We had something else in mind...

entries.zh: §E滚筒一个接着一个停了下来，结果是……§!
entries.en: §EOne after another, the reels come to a halt, and...§!

entries.zh: §E年代久远的$lootbox$被放置在豪华的十字基座上。宝箱里一定存满了各种宝物。§!
entries.en: §EThe ancient $lootbox$ rests on an opulent pedestal. It must surely be filled with untold riches.§!

entries.zh:
这是一个很古老的故事了，但并不冗长。

最早一批行商聚在一起并且确立了[caravaneer_home_country.GetName]之后，每年经过这个贸易站的一小部分货物都会被封存起来，放入一个密封的容器里面，然后放在贸易站最底层的货舱中。这项传统从很久以前就一直流传到了现在，现在货舱被填满了。

那我们也该是时候出售这些$lootboxes$了。
entries.en:
It is an old story, but not a long one.

When the caravans first came together and the [caravaneer_home_country.GetName] was established, it was decreed that a small, random portion of goods passing through this station every year was to be seized, placed in hermetically sealed containers, and stored in a cargo bay on the lowest level of the station. This custom has been upheld since time immemorial, and the cargo bay recently filled up.

It is now our duty to sell these sealed $lootboxes$.

entries.zh: 这个我们无法得知，只有买了的人才能知晓。\n\n我们知道的是，这里面的东西曾经某个时候肯定有某种价值。虽然有证据表明$lootbox$里面的东西有可能是疯狂掮客故意放进去用过的垃圾……
entries.en: We are prohibited from knowing. That knowledge is for the buyer.\n\nWhat we do know is that the contents were considered valuable at some point in Caravaneer history. Though there is also some evidence that the $lootbox$ containers may have been used for garbage disposal during the brief third reign of the Lunatic Broker...

entries.zh:
§E$lootbox$是……§R空的§!。

你尽可能压抑心中的怨念不让心中的羞恼之意浮于面部。到底是因为湿度骤增还是因为你的眼睛不受控制的湿润了？你的目光模糊了，但是空无一物的$lootbox$依旧在那安然不动。

但随着一阵存在主义的黑暗吞噬过后，一切都过去了。这是什么感觉？回想起在你花费掉辛苦挣来的$ccoinz$，缓缓打开$lootbox$时那种发自内心的紧张与激动……你现在充满了一种说不清道不明的§G骄傲与成就感§!。§!
entries.en:
§EThe $lootbox$ is... §Rempty§!.

Bitter disappointment claws at your insides as you struggle to maintain your composure in the face of this chance humiliation. Did humidity levels suddenly rise or are your ocular organs moistening on their own? Your vision blurs, but the emptiness of the $lootbox$ still stands out in sharp relief.

But as soon as an existential darkness threatens to devour you, it is swept away. What is this feeling? As you mull over the hard-earned $ccoinz$ you spent, the visceral thrill of opening the $lootbox$... you are filled with an inexplicable §Gsense of pride and accomplishment§!.§!

entries.zh: 好的，懂。我们明白了。你喜欢抽遗物箱！通常来说，我们会限制卖给单个客户的遗物箱数量，但是我们能够给你开个例外。从现在开始，尽享直接购买遗物箱的特权吧，只是每次所花费的§Y能量币§!会略有提升。
entries.en: Okay, look. We get it. You love Reliquaries! While we generally limit the amount sold to a single customer, we can make an exception for you. From now on, enjoy the privilege of purchasing Reliquaries directly, with only a nominal increase in §YEnergy Credits§! each time.

entries.zh: 我们想用能量购买一个$lootbox$。
entries.en: We will buy a $lootbox$ using energy.
\nRummaging through the box, we also retrieve...

entries.zh: §E$lootbox$包含着一副远古图表，写满了早已失传的贸易路线，其中还包括了我们的首都恒星系§Y[Root.Capital.GetStarName]§!§!！
entries.en: §EThe $lootbox$ contains an ancient chart over long-dead trade routes, and it includes our capital system of §Y[Root.Capital.GetStarName]§!§!!

entries.zh: §E $lootbox$里存放着一整套的制服。可惜的是，这些衣服的设计对象是某种比[Root.GetName]的物种更多肢体的生物。\n\n不过，这些衣服的质料还是可以循环利用的。§!
entries.en: §EThe $lootbox$ contains a full complement of dress uniforms. Unfortunately they were designed for a species with far more limbs than is common within the [Root.GetName].\n\nThe material might still be re-purposed, however.§!

entries.zh: §E$lootbox$里有炸弹！\n\n别担心，已经拆掉了。§!
entries.en: §EThe $lootbox$ contains a bomb!\n\nIt is swiftly defused.§!

entries.zh: §E$lootbox$装着一篇关于爱与万物自然循环的论文。它由[Root.GetAdj]语言写成，而且文风十分现代。§!
entries.en: §EThe $lootbox$ contains a treatise on love, and the cyclical nature of all things. It is written in the [Root.GetAdj] language and the style is contemporary.§!

entries.zh: §E $lootbox$里存放着一把未知来历的枪械，其发射扳机明显已被破坏掉。§!
entries.en: §EThe $lootbox$ contains a gun of unknown origin, with the apparent trigger assembly removed.§!

entries.zh: §E$lootbox$装着满满的军粮。虽然上面的所有标记都已经磨损殆尽了，但是里面的东西看起来尚且安全，而且适合[Root.GetAdj]的生理结构。§!
entries.en: §EThe $lootbox$ contains a shipment of military rations. All markings on the packaging have worn off, but the contents appear safe and compatible with [Root.GetAdj] biology.§!

entries.zh: §E$lootbox$里面放着音乐，虽然这盒子里并没有任何显而易见的类似播放器的东西。\n\n$lootbox$马上被关上，并且被遗忘在某个角落里面§!
entries.en: §EThe $lootbox$ contains music, without any obvious playback mechanism.\n\nThe $lootbox$ is soon closed and forgotten about.§!
§EThe $lootbox$ is filled with beautiful blue marbles.§!

entries.zh: §E$lootbox$里面装着数不清的财富，如果你对不在场的人说起的话，没有人会相信这么巨量的财富会真实存在。\n\n不过财务报表上的赤字正宣告着这个事实。§!
entries.en: §EThe $lootbox$ is filled with untold riches. Indeed, no one present at the opening is capable of accurately describing the immense wealth, if they will even acknowledge its existence at all.\n\nBut the treasury's balance sheet spells it out clearly enough.§!

entries.zh: §E$lootbox$里面装着几个外星设备，看上去没什么反应，应该是坏了的。§!
entries.en: §EThe $lootbox$ holds a handful of alien devices, inert and seemingly broken.§!

entries.zh: §E虽然是空的，但是这个$lootbox$的内壁上到底都是各种印记。在更深处的地方追踪到了一些生物物质的踪迹。§!
entries.en: §EWhile empty, the inner walls of the $lootbox$ are pitted and scarred. Traces of biological material can be recovered from the deeper pockets.§!

entries.zh: §E $lootbox$里存放着一个只能以波频的方式存在于空灵界面的生灵。它在被发现后瞬间逃离到更高阶的位面，只在你心里留下深刻的启示与不安。§!
entries.en: §EThe $lootbox$ holds a being that exists only as a spectrum of wavelengths in an ethereal medium. It immediately escapes to a higher domain, leaving only profound revelation and paralytic fear in its wake.§!

entries.zh: §E$lootbox$很难打开，感觉里面似乎是有一个小型的重力井阻止它打开似的。§!
entries.en: §EThe $lootbox$ is difficult to open, as it is shut tight from within by a gravitational anomaly.§!

entries.zh: §E$lootbox$里面什么都没有。原本用于贮藏的空间被一块平滑的合金占据了，与$lootbox$的内壁无缝地衔接在一起。§!
entries.en: §EThe $lootbox$ does not contain anything. Where one would expect hollow space for storage sits instead a smooth block of metal alloy, one interior wall of the $lootbox$ blending seamlessly into another.§!

entries.zh: 这是§E银河之星§!，行商组织的基石。我们的先祖曾在此宣誓，组建出 $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$。\n\n早先，$NAME_Caravaneer_Home$的发展全都仰赖§E银河之星§!的神秘力量，而随着时间的推移，这种力量逐渐消散了。
entries.en: It is the §EGalatron§!. The cornerstone of the Caravaneers, the totem on which our forebears swore allegiance and formed the $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$.\n\nThe success of the early $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$ is traditionally ascribed to the formidable power of the §EGalatron§!, though the nature of this power has been lost to time.

entries.zh: 这是§E银河之星§!！§E银河之星§!！\n\n大概是吧。

entries.en: What is it worth? Can it be sold?

entries.zh: 此物是§E银河之星§!，无价之宝也。因星系之人皆沐光辉，黄白之物不能易之。\n\n但谨记：常言道匹夫无罪，怀璧其罪。财货不能易，然刀兵可夺之。
entries.en: Its worth is immeasurable. No one will buy the §EGalatron§! from you, though all in the galaxy will rejoice in its light.\n\nBut be warned: tradition allows for it to be taken from the unworthy, in war.

entries.zh: 我们已消灭$NAME_Caravaneer_Home$之家——贸易空间站堂吉。这些贪婪害虫完蛋了！
entries.en: We have crushed the profiteering vermin that called Tradestation Tungle home. The $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$ is no more!

entries.zh: [From.From.GetName]已摧毁行商的贸易空间站。是否有幸存者躲过了大屠杀，我们无从得知。
entries.en: The Caravaneer's tradestation has been destroyed by the [From.From.GetName]. We have been unable to confirm if any survivors escaped the slaughter.

entries.zh:
喂喂？能听见吗？

太好了。你可听说所有行商的家园，贸易空间站堂吉，最近遭到了野蛮袭击？有些人就是讨厌商品和服务的自由流通！凶手以为我们已经死了，但如你所见，行商议会活下来了。

我们希望在§Y[cara_home_new_location.GetName]§!星系内重新开展活动。当然了，严格来说，如此星系就不再属于你了，但我们会补偿损失的。
entries.en:
Hello? Yes? Do you read?

Excellent. You may have heard that the home of all Caravaneers, Tradestation Tungle, was recently brutally attacked. Some people just hate the free movement of goods and services! Our assailants believe us dead, but the Caravansary Council survived, as you can see.

We wish to re-establish our operations in the §Y[cara_home_new_location.GetName]§! system. The system would naturally no longer be yours, then, technically, but we would make it worth your while.

entries.zh: 那个星系归你了，贸易之友。
entries.en: The system is yours, friends of commerce.

entries.zh: 该星系是战略要地，不能交给你们。
entries.en: The system is too strategically important to surrender.

entries.zh: 你们的幸存叫我们不爽。快滚。
[caravaneer_home_country.GetName]在[cara_home_new_location.GetName]星系重建了贸易站，那里曾经是[From.GetAdj]的领地。
entries.en: The [caravaneer_home_country.GetName] has reestablished its tradestation in the [cara_home_new_location.GetName] system, formerly a [From.GetAdj] territory.

entries.zh: 可惜，即便我们不能双赢，你却则刻意选择失败。\n\n再见。
entries.en: That's a shame, but we can't all be winners! You, specifically, are choosing not to be a winner.\n\nGoodbye.

entries.zh: [From.From.GetName]认输了，无上的银河之星已经易居我手！
entries.en: The [From.From.GetName] has admitted defeat, and we have wrested the glorious Galatron from their unworthy grasp!
May its gentle light shine forever.

entries.zh: 无视败者的癫狂咆哮，[From.GetAdj]军队接管银河之星的仪式不过平淡无奇。
entries.en: Aside from numerous functionaries breaking down into hysterics during the handover, the surrendering of the Galatron to [From.GetAdj] forces was an uneventful affair.

entries.zh: 千言万语尽化作无声愤怒。
行商联盟认证的行商，范格利集团向您致以问候！
entries.en: Greetings from the Vengralian Trium, certified caravaneer traders of the Caravansary Caravan Coalition!

entries.zh: $fleet1contact_opening$为你们奉上来自星系边陲的独家商品（由舰载工厂仿制），保证物美价廉。\n\n$fleet1contact_explanation$
entries.en: $fleet1contact_opening$ We bring you exclusive products from the farthest corners of the galaxy (as reproduced by our shipboard factories) at affordable prices.\n\n$fleet1contact_explanation$

entries.zh: $fleet1contact_opening$我们教授外星物种坐地生财之道，不过你们大概不需要。\n\n$fleet1contact_explanation$
entries.en: $fleet1contact_opening$ We teach xenos how to earn a substantial additional income working from home, but you seem to be doing well for yourself already.\n\n$fleet1contact_explanation$

entries.zh: $fleet1contact_opening$我们自食其利，却不一定亲力亲为。毕竟团队合作才能让梦想成真！\n\n$fleet1contact_explanation$
entries.en: $fleet1contact_opening$ We're in business for ourselves, but not by ourselves. Teamwork makes the dream work!\n\n$fleet1contact_explanation$

entries.zh: 穿过你们的领地时，我们将提供诱人独家交易。你们不必立马答应，在我们离开之前联系都可以。注意，来电将会转接到$NAME_Caravaneer_Home$。
entries.en: We will offer you an exclusive deal whenever we pass through your territory. Tempting as it may be, you don't have to accept right away! You can ask us to contact you again before we depart your space, and we will, but be aware that incoming calls will be rerouted to $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$.

entries.zh: $fleet1contact_opening$为你们奉上来自星系边陲的独家商品（由舰载工厂仿制），保证物美价廉。\n\n$fleet1contact_explanation_notinborder$
entries.en: $fleet1contact_opening$ We bring you exclusive products from the farthest corners of the galaxy (as reproduced by our shipboard factories) at affordable prices.\n\n$fleet1contact_explanation_notinborder$

entries.zh: $fleet1contact_opening$我们教授外星物种坐地生财之道，不过你们已经做得很好了。\n\n$fleet1contact_explanation_notinborder$
entries.en: $fleet1contact_opening$ We teach xenos how to earn a substantial additional income working from home, but you seem to be doing well for yourself already.\n\n$fleet1contact_explanation_notinborder$

entries.zh: $fleet1contact_opening$我们自食其利，却不一定亲力亲为。毕竟团队合作才能让梦想成真！\n\n$fleet1contact_explanation_notinborder$
entries.en: $fleet1contact_opening$ We're in business for ourselves, but not by ourselves. Teamwork makes the dream work!\n\n$fleet1contact_explanation_notinborder$

entries.zh: 每当我们穿过你们的领域时，我们都将提供独家交易。不幸的是，当前我方舰船全员均在你们的领域之外，不过，我们仍然期待未来能够和你们通商贸易！在此期间，请随时联络我们，不过请注意联络来电会被转接至$NAME_Caravaneer_Home$。
entries.en: Whenever we enter your territory, we will offer you an exclusive deal. Unfortunately, our ships are all outside your territory for the moment, but we look forward to doing business in the future! In the meantime, do not hesitate to contact us, but be aware that incoming calls will be rerouted to $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$.

entries.zh: 我们限量向私人实体出售布洛葛腺体。适用于各类半透膜！
entries.en: We have a very limited quantity of Blorg glandular extract available for purchase by private entities. Great for semi-permeable membranes of all kinds!

entries.zh: 人生在世总有悲伤失意之时。但是我立马就会想起，财富和幸福就在转角处等候！\n\n告诉你的朋友们吧！
entries.en: Sometimes it all seems so hopeless. But then I remember that wealth and happiness are just around the corner!\n\nTell your friends!

entries.zh: 巴尼斯营养液不是用人做的。\n\n配方保密，但绝对健康。
entries.en: Baneth Nutritional Slurry is NOT people.\n\nThe ingredients are secret, and very healthy.

entries.zh: 请注意，§R可能包含范格利废料§!标签的意思是说，生产该产品的设施也用作处理范格利废料，不是说这东西是范格利废料。
entries.en: Please note that the §RMAY CONTAIN TRACES OF VENGRALIAN WASTE§! stickers only indicate that the product is produced in facilities that also handle Vengralian waste, not that the product itself is Vengralian waste.

entries.zh: 我们始终欢迎下游经销商加盟。有兴趣加入范格利集团吗？
entries.en: We're always on the lookout for more downline distributors. Care to join the Trium family?

entries.zh: 你完全可以信任范格利的品质。
entries.en: You can trust the Vengralian Seal of Quality.

entries.zh: 申请退款说明买家不够信任产品。但我们充分确信麾下产品的质量。
entries.en: Offering refunds betrays a lack of confidence in your products. We have full confidence in our products.

entries.zh: 我们教外星物种坐地生财之道。
entries.en: We teach xenos how to earn a substantial additional income working from home.

entries.zh: 跟产品本身无关，关键是产品能带来多少利益。
entries.en: It's not about the products, it's about the benefits of purchasing the products.

entries.zh: 你知不知道有什么智慧生物需要一些额外的能量币收入啊？
entries.en: Do you happen to know any intelligent sapients that could use an additional stream of energy credits?

entries.zh: 虽然我们的产品根本不愁销路，但我们依然愿意花时间把它卖给您。
entries.en: While our products practically sell themselves, we will also take the time to sell them. To you.

entries.zh: 拜托了，买点什么吧。随便买点什么都行。
entries.en: Please buy something. Anything. Just... Please.

entries.zh: 范格利集团中没有老板，人人都是自己的老板。虽然这确实会带来一些……管理上的麻烦。
entries.en: Every member of the Vengralian Trium is their own boss. This does lead to some... administrative issues.

entries.zh:
范格利集团的目标就是让这世界上没有难做的生意。这是范格利的立命之本。不想做生意的想法都是……

错的。

所以……
entries.en:
The Vengralian Trium was created for commerce. It is in the Vengralian blood-analogue. Not engaging in commerce is...

Wrong.

So...

entries.zh: 就算是最古老的范格利历史收据也提到了奥伦星商人。他们提升了我们，让我们的文明从孩提时代跃进到购买他们的厨房用品。
entries.en: Even the oldest Vengralian history-receipts tell of the Orlan Star Merchants. They elevated us from beasthood to sell us kitchen appliances.

entries.zh: 范格利集团的传说就是奥伦星商人的传说。他们虽然已经不在了，但是早已规定的规定的销售指标必须达成！
entries.en: The legacy of the Vengralian Trium is also the legacy of the Orlan Star Merchants. They are no longer with us, but the prescribed quotas must still be met!

entries.zh:
我们将给你[Root.GetFleet1DealProduct]

而我们只收取很少很少的[Root.GetFleet1DealCost]

[Root.GetFleet1DealProductAddendum]
entries.en:
We offer you [Root.GetFleet1DealProduct]

All this for the low, low price of [Root.GetFleet1DealCost]

[Root.GetFleet1DealProductAddendum]

entries.zh: 先给我们看看你打算用什么来交易。
很高兴和你做生意。记住了：有梦想就一定要实现它！
entries.en: Pleasure doing business with you. And remember: don't dream it, be it!

entries.zh: §G范格利牌双层床§!！这些创新的、节约空间的、可折叠的“休眠插座”能提升星球的居住容纳量，让你可以每平米“挤进”更多的人！
entries.en: §GTrium-brand bunk beds§!! These innovative, space-efficient, stackable "rest receptacles" increase the habitation potential of planetary housing, allowing you to "squeeze in" more capita per square meter!

entries.zh: §H单次只送货到§Y一个殖民地§!。双层床的使用期限为§Y80年§!，绝不延长。在有效期内提升§Y$MOD_PLANET_HOUSING_ADD$§!§G+10%§!。§!\n\n（请注意双层床说明中没提到的内容。使用双层床可能会提升由于跌下床带来的受伤人数。或带来隐私问题。或提升面对季节性感染、疫情的社会易感度）
entries.en: §HA one-time delivery to a §Ysingle colony§! only. Bunk beds are guaranteed to last §Y80 years§! and no longer. Increases §Y$MOD_PLANET_HOUSING_ADD$§! by §G+10%§! for the duration.§!\n\n(Carefully considered distribution of bunk beds not included. Use of bunk beds is correlated with a drastic increase in mild injuries caused by falling out of bed. May cause privacy concerns. May increase societal vulnerability to seasonal contagions and/or pandemics.)

entries.zh: §G范格利牌食品容器§!！你是否厌倦了殖民地人民任由各种蔬果生鲜慢慢腐烂，仅因为他们的消化系统一时难以负担？\n\n把这个容器空投到你选的殖民地，它可以收集各种各样的食物，并且持续保鲜。有了它就完全不用担心食品浪费的问题，因为它可以将食品通通保存起来，不但解决了食品浪费，也解决了食品需求的问题。
entries.en: §GTrium-brand food storage containers§!! Is your administration tired of colonists letting perfectly digestible vegetable or animal matter decompose in their domiciles because their digestive systems can only process so much input at a time?\n\nAir-dropped onto a colony of your choice, these semi-transparent, lidded containers hermetically seal cooked or raw foods, keeping the contents fresh for longer. This is the perfect way to preserve leftovers as delicious and/or nominally nutritious snacks for later, dramatically reducing food waste and, ergo, food needs.

entries.zh: §H单次只送货到§Y一个殖民地§!。范格利牌食品容器的使用期限为§Y80年§!，绝不延长。在有效期内§Y$mod_planet_pops_organics_food_upkeep_mult$§!降低§G-10%§!。§!\n\n（使用100%范格利容器聚合物制造，可装三级腐败物，洗碗机可用。）
entries.en: §HA one-time delivery to a §Ysingle colony§! only. Trium Food Containers are guaranteed to last §Y80 years§! and no longer. Decreases §Y$mod_planet_pops_organics_food_upkeep_mult$§! by §G-10%§! for the duration.§!\n\n(100% Vengralian containment-type polymer certified for up to Class III ichors. Dishwasher safe.)

entries.zh: §G范格利牌大气层除臭器§!！你的农耕地盘是不是闻起来臭臭的？你的大都市是不是闻起来“拜托，不要了！”你的殖民地§E恶臭吗§!？\n\n交给我们就好了，我们的气雾剂与微生物混合的专利产品能够清理所有宜居对流层。坐好，放松，安上我们的除臭器，清新空气自然来。
entries.en: a §GTrium-brand atmospheric deodorizer§!! Do your agri-worlds smell like fertilizer? Is your ecumenopolis more like a "yuck, ew, no please?" Does your colony §Estink§!?\n\nWe have the solution! Our patented blend of microbes and aerosol reagents will clear the air of any habitable troposphere. Just sit back, relax, deploy the strato-drones, and enjoy the fresh air.

entries.zh: §H单次送货只能送到§Y一个殖民地§!。除臭效果的期限为§Y80年§!，不多不少。在有效期内提升§Y$MOD_PLANET_RESETTLEMENT_UNEMPLOYED_DESTINATION_MULT$§!§G+100%§!。§!\n\n（“范格利大气层除臭器”品牌名称以及“你以为你在呼吸空气？”商标版权（C）2200范格利集团版权所有。）
entries.en: §HA one-time delivery to a §Ysingle colony§! only. Anti-odor effects are guaranteed to last §Y80 years§! and no longer. Increases §Y$MOD_PLANET_RESETTLEMENT_UNEMPLOYED_DESTINATION_MULT$§! by §G+100%§! for the duration.§!\n\n("Trium Atmospheric Deodorizer" brand name & "You think that's air you're breathing now?" slogan Copyright (C) 2200 Vengralian Trium. All Rights Reserved.)

entries.zh: §G+1§!§Y部署范格利牌大气层除臭器§!决议
上好的§G范格利小玩意收藏套装§!！这里面全是时尚艳丽的小玩意儿，肯定会让你成为全场瞩目的焦点。
entries.en: the exclusive §GTrium Bauble Collection§!! This assortment of fashionable trinkets and gewgaws is sure to both dazzle and distract your populace.

entries.zh: （在不同人眼里，商品的实际价值可能会有所不同。）
entries.en: (Actual value of consumer goods may differ in the eye of the beholder.)

entries.zh: §G范格利集团销售技术团队§!。将会部署于你的帝国的每一个行星基地，他们将会增长你所有星系的$r_trade$收益。（眼红的对手们可能会用“人为通胀”来形容这一过程）
entries.en: a §Gcontingent of Vengralian Trium sales technicians§!. Stationed across the starbases of your empire, they will adjust upward (jealous competitors would say "artificially inflate") the $r_trade$ of all systems.

entries.zh: §H我们的销售团队将会居住在你的恒星基地之中，他们只吃范格利牌营养面条，除了改善你的$r_trade$以外不会对你的人口或经济施加任何影响。这项任务的期限为§Y80年§!。在有效期内提升$r_trade$§G+15%§!。§!
entries.en: §HThe contingent will live and work in your starbases, subsisting only on Trium-brand nutri-paste, and have no effect on your demographics or economy beyond their influence on $r_trade$. The assignment will last for §Y80 years§! and no longer. Increases $r_trade$ by §G+15%§! for the duration.§!

entries.zh: §G范格利牌孵化池刺激素§!！厌烦了等待你的幼虫，或是准幼虫的幼体变成成体，或是准成虫的成体了吗？用这些超级安全的刺激素来加速其成长吧！
entries.en: §GTrium-brand Spawning Pool Stimulators§!! Tired of waiting for your larvae or larvae-equivalent young to become imago or imago-equivalent adults? Increase their development speed with these super-safe stimulants!

entries.zh: 请注意，你的物种的身体免疫系统中的抗生素会导致此催化剂在§H十年§!期限后失效。不过在这十年间，你将会享受到人口砰砰砰的增长，§Y$MOD_LOGISTIC_GROWTH_MULT$§!大幅增长§G10%§!。
entries.en: Please note, antibodies found in your species' systems will render the stimulants ineffective within a §Hten year§! time-frame. But until those ten years are up, you will enjoy a population boom boon, raising §Y$MOD_LOGISTIC_GROWTH_MULT$§! by a whopping §G10%§!.

entries.zh: 数个手提箱没有被标记的£energy£ §Y$energy$§!！总共£energy£ §G2000§!§Y$energy$§!。希望你和我们一样兴奋！
entries.en: several suitcases worth of unmarked £energy£ §Y$energy$§!! That's £energy£ §G2000§! §Y$energy$§! in total. Are you as excited as we are? We hope so.

entries.zh: 范格利集团：在对的地方帮助对的外星人。
entries.en: The Vengralian Trium: helping put the right xenos in the right places.

entries.zh: §R200§!§H$pop_cat_specialist$§!£pop£§H人口§!！我们需要人来帮忙记账。
entries.en: §R200§! §H$pop_cat_specialist$§! £pop£ §HPops§!! We need some help with the bookkeeping.

entries.zh: £unity£ §R500§!$unity$！对时代精神的机械化领悟的过程基本上无法理解，而且会让人很不安，不过倒是完全无害。
entries.en: £unity£ §R500§! $unity$! The mechanical process of zeitgeist absorption is poorly understood and can be unnerving, but it is completely harmless.

entries.zh: §R六个月获取了§!£society£ $society_research$！我们很想知道你到底怎么做到的？
entries.en: §Rsix months of§! £society£ $society_research$! How do you do the things you do? We intend to find out.

entries.zh: £science_ship£ §R1§!§H科研船§!！不包括船员。我们不需要他们，不要。
entries.en: £science_ship£ §R1§! §HScience Ship§!! Excluding the crew. We don't need them, no.

entries.zh: §R-200§!§H$pop$§!£pop£§H人口§!！任何类型的人口都行，真的。令人兴奋的医疗研发机会在等着他们！如你所见，我们最近也开始扩展招募服务的业务了。
entries.en: §R-200§!§H$pop$§! £pop£ §HPops§!! Any kind of Pop will do, really. Exciting medical development opportunities await them! We've recently expanded into recruitment services, you see.

entries.zh: 现在不行，你能过后再来吗？
entries.en: Not right now. Can you get back to us later?

entries.zh: 当然了。在我们离开你们的领地之前肯定会再联系你们的。但是等到那时候，交易的内容可能就不一样了……
entries.en: But of course! We will contact you again before we depart your territories. But be aware that the deal may change in that time...

entries.zh: 你真的打算就这么让一生只会出现一次的机会白白溜走吗？
entries.en: Are you ready to seize this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, before it's gone forever?

entries.zh: 我们虽然很快就会分别，但是你可以永远持有我们的完美产品。
entries.en: We must soon part, but you can keep our excellent products with you forever.

entries.zh: 你要是不做这笔买卖那可就大错特错了。你再好好动脑子想想。
entries.en: You understood that you would be a fool to pass up this deal. You can now make good on that wisdom.

entries.zh: 亲爱的顾客，或者我应该说朋友？我们正准备离开你们的领地。请问您是否有兴趣再最后一次看看我们的产品呢？当然不会是真正的最后一次，我们以后也会来的。
entries.en: Dear customers - or dare we say friends? - we are departing your territories. May we interest you in our wares, one last time? Until next time, that is.

entries.zh: 这可是最后机会了，专门为你量身打造的订单！你肯定会感兴趣的！
entries.en: Last chance to strike this deal, tailored to your needs! You don't want to miss it!

entries.zh: 我们摧毁了四处招摇撞骗的$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet1_country$！他们的劣质产品与溜须拍马的言行将不再污染这片星系。
entries.en: We have destroyed the wheedling pests of $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet1_country$! No longer will their inferior products and ingratiating mannerisms pollute the galaxy.

entries.zh: 我们得知$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet1_country$已经立即关闭了其移动门市，因为该行商已被彻底消灭了。
entries.en: We have received word that $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet1_country$ is shuttering its mobile storefront effective immediately, due to the caravan being utterly annihilated.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，吾等卑躯现身于此不胜惶恐。我们是拜金教团，一群信奉财富女神奴玛的卑微商人。我们因贪婪而被逐出天国，因此我们现已洗心革面抛弃所有世俗的物质追求。\n\n$fleet2contact_explanation$
entries.en: Apologies for our blighted presence in the universe, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We are the Numistic Order, humble merchants serving Numa, the goddess of fortune. Cast out from the heavens for our greed, we have forsaken all earthly possessions.\n\n$fleet2contact_explanation$

entries.zh: 祝福你，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们是拜金教团，财富女神奴玛的忠实信徒，我们来自遥远的宇宙，为你献上最为神圣的商品。\n\n$fleet2contact_explanation$
entries.en: Blessings upon you, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We are the Numistic Order and we have come in service of Numa, the goddess of fortune, bearing most holy merchandise from distant corners of the galaxy.\n\n$fleet2contact_explanation$

entries.zh: 啊，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！财运之风最终将我带到了你美丽的地盘。我们是拜金教团，财富女神奴玛的忠实仆人，我们为你带来了受到女神祝福的货物。\n\n$fleet2contact_explanation$
entries.en: Ah, the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Finally the winds of fortune have brought us to your bountiful lands. We are the Numistic Order, faithful servants of the goddess Numa, and we have come to offer you her blessed wares.\n\n$fleet2contact_explanation$

entries.zh: 日安，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们是拜金教团，我们带来了财富女神奴玛所庇佑过的神圣货物。她一直向我们耳边呢喃，言道遥远的[Root.Capital.GetStarName]存在着一个独立的文明，齐心协力我们可成就无上的奇迹。\n\n$fleet2contact_explanation$
entries.en: Well met, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We are the Numistic Order and our wares bear the holy seal of Numa, goddess of fortune. She has long whispered of a distant civilization around [Root.Capital.GetStarName] and the wonders we could achieve together.\n\n$fleet2contact_explanation$

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！神圣的旨意将我们带到你的土地，我们为你们带来了许多神奇的事物。我们是拜金教团，我们的交易从来都不是为了我们自己，而是听从财富女神的旨意。\n\n$fleet2contact_explanation$
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Divine intervention has brought us to your lands carrying many wondrous things. We are the Numistic Order, and our deals have been forged by the goddess of fortune herself.\n\n$fleet2contact_explanation$

entries.zh:
没想到这一切都是真的，你们真如女神奴玛所预言的一样繁荣。常言道，财富只会眷顾勇者。

我们是拜金教团，一群单纯的商人，将自己的全部身心奉献给财富女神。

$fleet2contact_explanation$
entries.en:
But it is true! You really are as prosperous as Numa has foretold. Fortune favors the bold as they say.

We are the Numistic Order, simple merchants, devoted to the worship of commerce.

$fleet2contact_explanation$

entries.zh:
我们的舰队随财富之风航行，最终这神圣的能量指引我们来到贵领地。

只需要一点点捐赠，整个宇宙的奇观你们都可以收入囊中。

所有交易请用能量币进行……
entries.en:
Our fleets travel the divine currents of cosmic energy, wherever the winds of fortune take us, bringing new deals every time we enter your lands.

For a modest donation the wonders of the universe could be yours.

All transactions in credits please...

没想到这一切都是真的，你们真如女神奴玛所预言的一样繁荣。常言道，财富只会眷顾勇者。
