But it is true! You really are as prosperous as Numa has foretold. Fortune favors the bold as they say.

We are the Numistic Order, simple merchants, devoted to the worship of commerce.

$fleet2contact_explanation_notinborder$

entries.zh: 我们的舰队随财富之风航行，最终这神圣的能量指引我们来到贵领地，让我们每次进入时都能提供新的交易。\n\n遗憾的是，目前我们的舰船全部位于你的领地之外。不过下一次我们访问你们宇域的时候，只需一点点捐赠。整个宇宙的奇观你们都可以收入囊中。
entries.en: Our fleets travel the divine currents of cosmic energy, wherever the winds of fortune take us, bringing new deals every time we enter your lands.\n\nSadly, our ships are beyond the bounds of your realm for the moment, but next time we visit your skies, the wonders of the universe could be yours for a modest donation of credits...

entries.zh: 来吧，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！喝下从拜金圣井中涌出的财富之水，保证你不会再渴了。
entries.en: Come, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Drink from the Numistic well of wealth and thirst no more.

entries.zh: 跟随能量币的脚步，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，它将指引你通往真相。没有什么货物能比承载着奴玛意志的货物更加神圣了……
entries.en: Follow the current of cosmic energy credits, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and it will take you to the truth. There is no better product than that which carries the holy seal of Numa...

entries.zh: 奴玛，在财富流动之时微笑。
entries.en: When credits pass hands, Numa smiles.

entries.zh: 你把那叫做公平！？你简直就是侮辱奴玛！\n\n哦，有客人来了！很抱歉让你看到刚才那一幕。刚才的一幕很好的证明了有些人就是不配发财。
entries.en: You call that a fair deal!? You spit in the face of Numa - pah!\n\nOh, but we have customers! Our sincerest apologies for that display. Some do not have the courage to accept good fortune when it falls into their lap.

entries.zh: 许多上好的货物流转到我们手中，但是我们从来不会保留这些东西。这是我们的牺牲，为了泰莎塔尔的最终建成，也为了我们的后裔能再次见到圣地。
entries.en: Many wondrous things pass through our hands, yet we never line our pockets. It is the sacrifice we make so that the construction of the Tessar Tarvil is completed and our children may one day see the holy land again.

entries.zh: 财富是灵魂的负担，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。让我们来减轻你的负担吧。
entries.en: Riches are a burden upon the soul, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Allow us to lighten your load.

entries.zh: 什么？商品要缴税？乖乖，你这可是在侮辱奴玛。
entries.en: A commodity tax hike? Hush, you profane Numa.

entries.zh: 任何献给奴玛的贡品都会在将来收到十倍返还。朋友，你花的越少，损失越大。
entries.en: Any donation given to Numa the universe will return tenfold. The less you spend, friend, the more you lose.

entries.zh: 来啊，别害羞！看看我们的商品，然后拜倒在奴玛面前吧。
entries.en: Come, do not be shy! Peruse our wares and join in the worship of Numa.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你知道吗？好买卖总会找到属于它的买家。你打算加入这神圣买卖吗？
entries.en: Good deals come to those who accept them, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Will you join us in holy barter?

entries.zh: 爱财之人总会受到财富的眷顾。让你的财富不断流转，这样你的财富才会源源不断地积累。
entries.en: Those who love money, money will love in return. Let your money flow and it will come back to you effortlessly, in abundance.

entries.zh: \n\n和一直以来的一样，如果你们需要时间思考一下，我们会在离开你的领地之前进行提醒，再给你们一次接受女神慷慨馈赠的机会。
entries.en: \n\nAs always, if you need time to consider, we can notify you before we depart your territory, giving you one more chance to accept the goddess' generous offer.

entries.zh: 你听到了吗？硬币正叮当作响。是的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我看到了财富正在不断向你涌去。\n\n奴玛在你的某个世界骄傲地展示了一个古龛。那个古龛将会为你带来超越你想象的财富。$fleetdeal_explanation$
entries.en: Listen, do you hear that? It's the sound of coin trickling in. Yes, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], we see great fortune coming your way.\n\nNuma has shown us a vision of a shrine in her honor on one of your worlds. A shrine that could bring you prosperity beyond your wildest dreams.$fleetdeal_explanation$

entries.zh: 把 [fleet2_recent_pop_species.GetName] 带上来。在我们穿越星系的朝圣之路中，我们拯救了许多迷失的魂灵……\n\n看看这优秀的物种，它们接受了拜金管理之道的熏陶。看到它[fleet2_recent_pop_species.GetMouthName]深处了吗？这颜色表明它是一个十分健康的个体。他们同样十分胜任体力活。而且他们的繁殖能力十分出色。你觉得如何？$fleetdeal_explanation$
entries.en: Bring in the [fleet2_recent_pop_species.GetName]. During our pilgrimage across the galaxy we have saved many lost souls...\n\nLook at this fine specimen, schooled in the art of Numistic administration. See the inside of his [fleet2_recent_pop_species.GetMouthName]? That color there indicates a healthy individual. They make great laborers too. And their reproductive capacities are astounding. What say you?$fleetdeal_explanation$

entries.zh: 关闭你的影像接收器，想象你正漂浮在能量币的洪流之中，而你即将抵达的，是一座满溢着更多能量币的山峰。\n\n有了我们拜金教的成像技术，你很快就会明白，意志之力凌驾于世间任何力量。能量币将如同往低处流的水一样自然的涌向你，而你将永远地从物欲中解放出来。$fleetdeal_explanation$
entries.en: Close your visual receptors. Now picture yourself on your back floating on a stream of energy credits towards a mountain of even more energy credits.\n\nWith our Numistic visualization techniques you will learn that there is no greater power than the power of the mind. You too will be free of material desires and credits will be drawn to you like arthropoids to dung.$fleetdeal_explanation$

entries.zh: 能量之流的图案……它们存在于各处，但无人可视。奴玛自己便可预测这神圣之潮和整个股票市场的流动。只要你愿献出一点点捐助，我们就将把她无穷智慧中的一角传授于你。$fleetdeal_explanation$
entries.en: Patterns in the energy flow... They are everywhere yet no one sees. Numa alone can predict the divine ebb and flow of the stock market. And for a small donation, we will share some of her wisdom with you.$fleetdeal_explanation$

entries.zh: 请允许我们引见我们最棒的一个精神领袖，拥有强大思维能力同时能够看穿一切的九阶沙克瓦。在女神的指引下，你的生意将会繁荣昌盛。\n\n而我们只希望你能提供小小的捐助……$fleetdeal_explanation$
entries.en: May we present one of our finest spiritual leaders, a level nine Shakvah with enhanced mind focus and inner gaze. Under the goddess' guidance, business on your worlds will flourish.\n\nAll we ask is a small donation in credits...$fleetdeal_explanation$

entries.zh: 尊敬的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们将向你提供一个特别的交易……奴玛认为你的人民很有潜力，并且欢迎一部分你的子民为奴玛效忠。她将奉上无价的水晶作为回报……$fleetdeal_explanation$
entries.en: Honored [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], we have a very special offer for you... Numa has seen great potential in your people and would like to welcome some of your kind into her ranks. In return these priceless crystals could be yours...$fleetdeal_explanation$

entries.zh: 这是财富之恩惠号，我们最受信任的警戒舰……她被女神亲自选中，在星系中护送我们受祝福的货物，并曾经击退过许多渎神者——海盗、异端、虚空怪物，以及任何阻碍奴玛的神圣之道的人！如今，她仍旧几乎完好如新……\n\n是的，她曾尽心为财富服务，而现在只需一点微不足道的捐赠，她也可以为你服务……$fleetdeal_explanation$
entries.en: Behold Fortune's Favor, our most trusted guard ship... She was chosen by the goddess herself to escort our blessed cargo across the galaxy and has thwarted many a blasphemer in her day - pirates, infidels, monsters of the void, all who interfere with Numa's divine path! Yet she is almost as good as new...\n\nYes, she has served fortune well and now, for a modest donation, she may also serve you...$fleetdeal_explanation$

entries.zh: 请原谅我们的冒犯，但我们注意到你的星球，§Y[fleet2deal8planet.GetName]§!，拥有一种尚未被发掘的独特潜力。我们可以打开一道通往其神圣地心的裂口，财富就将源源不断地从中涌出！\n\n让我们揭露你星球上隐藏的秘密吧。当然了，我们需要一笔象征性的酬劳。$fleetdeal_explanation$
entries.en: Forgive us our intrusiveness, but we have noticed your planet, §Y[fleet2deal8planet.GetName]§!, possesses a unique potential not currently being realized. A vent can be opened to its sacred core, from whence the flow of wealth can trickle forth!\n\nLet us reveal to you the hidden secrets of your land. We will require a nominal remuneration, of course.$fleetdeal_explanation$

entries.zh: 愿神圣的女神奴玛保佑你，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。她向我们展示了如何将你的单元更好地与§Y[fleet2deal9planet.GetName]§!的磁场进行同调。有了我们神圣而且专利注册的§G拜金教磁条§!，你在§Y[fleet2deal9planet.GetName]§!上的无人机将减缓对£energy£ §Y$energy$§!的依赖。\n\n作为交换，我们希望能在你的土地上举办一场献神的仪式。你意向如何？$fleetdeal_explanation$
entries.en: The Divine Numa smiles on you this day, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. She has shown us how to better align your units to §Y[fleet2deal9planet.GetName]§!'s magnetosphere. With our holy, patented §GNumistic Magnetostrips§!, your drones on §Y[fleet2deal9planet.GetName]§! will drain your sacred £energy£ §Y$energy$§! with less fervor.\n\nIn exchange, we require a ceremony to the Divine be hosted on your soil. What say you?$fleetdeal_explanation$

entries.zh: 我们的一位传教士在冥想之中被奴玛降临在她身上，迅速而含糊地说出了女神的旨意。尽管这位传教士并未活过这场考验，但我们解析了她话语中的含义，得到了一种能将一和零变为百万的算法。\n\n不要令她的牺牲白费，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。将财富引入你们的地核，她就不会抛弃你们。$fleetdeal_explanation$
entries.en: Deep in a meditative trance, one of our ecclesiasts gave herself over to Numa and spoke the goddess' sacred truth in a rapid stream of glossolalia. Though the ecclesiast herself did not survive her trial, we deciphered from her utterances an algorithm that can turn ones and zeros into millions.\n\nDo not let her sacrifice be in vain, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Invite fortune into your planetary core and she will not desert you.$fleetdeal_explanation$

entries.zh: 让奴玛凝视你的灵魂吧，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，她就能得知你需要什么。等等……你问题的答案此刻正在我面前浮现。是的，我能看到了！
entries.en: Let Numa gaze into to your core, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and she will tell you what it is you need. Hold on... The answer to your problem is materializing before me. Yes, I can see it now!
$fleet2dealdesc11$\n\nIt is... another guard ship, is it not?

entries.zh: $fleet2dealdesc11$\n\n答案是……异星天然气，不对么？嗯……真是令人陶醉的芳香！那是成功的气息！深吸一口气，你就能亲眼目睹奴玛的庄容。但是要小心，过量吸入可能会损害你的隔膜。
entries.en: $fleet2dealdesc11$\n\nIt's... exotic gases, is it not? Mm... and what a lovely scent they have! It is the smell of success! A deep breath of these and you will see Numa in the flesh. But be advised, excessive inhalation may dry out your membranes.

entries.zh: $fleet2dealdesc11$\n\n当然了！答案是……能量币……一直都是能量币。钱币能扭转乾坤。在你的问题上抛洒钱币，你的问题就会不见了。赞美奴玛！
entries.en: $fleet2dealdesc11$\n\nBut of course! It's... credits... always credits. Credits make the world go round. We will throw credits at your problem and your problem will disappear. Praise Numa!

entries.zh:
通过奴玛的指导，我们发现这些古代文物对我们的冥想很有启发性。

与它们分离的想法当然让我们感到痛苦，但我们认为你们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]可以通过研究它们获得很多知识。

我们需要一些高级物资，所以或许我们可以进行一个交易……？$fleetdeal_explanation$
entries.en:
By the guiding hand of Numa, we have come across these ancient artifacts which have been very inspiring for our meditations.

The thought of parting with them of course pains us, but we feel that you [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] could learn much by studying them.

We are in need of some advanced materials, so perhaps a deal could be made..?$fleetdeal_explanation$

entries.zh: 先给我们看看你打算用什么来交易。
祝福你，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你我之间的交易让我们离奴玛更近了。
entries.en: Blessings upon you, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], for your business brings us closer to the goddess.
Not right now. Please get back to us later.

entries.zh: 那好吧，[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们会在离开你的领地时再次联系你。但是请注意，奴玛可是一位多变的女士。如果她改变了主意，那么我们的交易可能会发生改变……
entries.en: As you wish, [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We will contact you again before we leave. But bear in mind, Numa is a fickle mistress. If her mind sways, the deal may change...

entries.zh: 错失一次投资的机会，那将会是你犯下最大的错误，我的朋友。你确定你能承担放弃我们提议的代价吗？这是在我们离开你的领地之前的最后机会。
entries.en: A missed opportunity to invest, my friend, is the most expensive mistake you will ever make. Are you certain you can afford to pass up on our offer? This is your last chance before we depart your territory.

entries.zh: 奴玛是一位大方的女士。我们正要离开时她提醒了我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！一定要在我们离开之前给他们一生中最后一次机会！
entries.en: Numa is a generous mistress. We were about to leave when she reminded us - the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! They must have one last chance at the deal of a lifetime, before we leave!

entries.zh: 往往在某些小选择中，你的命运就已注定。在这投资一点，在那儿投资一点，终有一天会变成一笔巨大的收益。小小的水滴终将汇聚成为海洋。\n\n命运让我们在离开之前再给你一次选择的机会。
entries.en: It is in the little moments your fate is decided. A credit well spent here, a credit there, will one day make a million. Small streams meet to make an ocean.\n\nFate has given you one more chance to take our offer before we leave.

entries.zh: 啊，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你听到奴玛的召唤了吗？我们马上就要离开你们的领地了，但首先，请问你们考虑过我们的交易了吗？\n\n好好想想吧，这也许是让你飞黄腾达的选择，否则就走向毁灭，你会如何选择？
entries.en: Ah, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], do you hear Numa calling? Soon we must depart your lands, but first, have you considered our offer?\n\nWeigh your options well, for one may set you on a path to great fortune. Another to ruin. Which will it be?

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们很快将会离开你的领地。我们将会让宇宙中的能量币指引我们前进。你考虑过我们的提议了吗？
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Soon we will depart your territory. We must go wherever the current of cosmic energy credits takes us. Have you considered our offer?

entries.zh: 启用建筑§G+1§!§Y拜金教神龛§!，这将为你所选的一个星球带去巨量财富。
entries.en: Enables the construction of  §G+1§! §YNumistic Shrine§!, bringing good fortune to a world of your choice.

entries.zh: 一位§G技能3级§!的行政官，受财富女神庇佑，现已加入[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: A §GSkill 3§! Official, blessed by the goddess of fortune, joins the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 你通过交换§R100§!£pop£§H人口§!获得了£rare_crystals£ §G200§!§Y$rare_crystals$§!
entries.en: You are granted £rare_crystals£ §G200§! §Y$rare_crystals$§! in exchange for §R100§! £pop£ §HPops§!

entries.zh: 在[From.From.solar_system.GetName]发生了敌对行为之后，[From.From.GetName]很高兴向我们报告$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet2_fleet$已被摧毁。\n\n曾经名噪一时的$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3_species$行商，如今不过是一堆太空垃圾罢了。这些道貌岸然的家伙以后不会再出现在我们面前了。
entries.en: Following hostilities in the [From.From.solar_system.GetName] system, the [From.From.GetName] Fleet is pleased to report that the $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet2_fleet$ has been destroyed.\n\nThe once-bustling $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3_species$ caravan is now little more than interstellar scrapyard. We shall be troubled by their sanctimonious presence no more.

entries.zh:
消息传到了[Root.Capital.GetName]，据报告说$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet2_fleet$已被歼灭。

在与[From.GetName]发生敌对接触之后，名噪一时的$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet2_species$行商现在不过是一堆太空垃圾罢了。

对于他们侍奉的财富女神来说可真是不幸啊。
entries.en:
News has reached [Root.Capital.GetName] that the $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet2_fleet$ is no more.

Following a hostile encounter with the [From.GetName], the once-bustling $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet2_species$ caravan is now little more than interstellar scrapyard.

An unfortunate end for those serving the goddess of fortune herself.

entries.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]！欢迎你们。我们是$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$的操作员，从属于$NAME_Caravaneer_Home$。

我们穿越于无垠的宇宙。我们捕捉每一丝星光。我们收集。我们交易！

$fleet3contact_explanation$
entries.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]! We greet you. We are operators of $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$, a member of the $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$.

We travel the stars. We view all that glows. We gather. And we trade!

$fleet3contact_explanation$

entries.zh: 你们好啊，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$向你们致意！我们是从$NAME_Tradestation_Tungle$出发的穿越星际的贸易者。\n\n$fleet3contact_explanation$
entries.en: Greetings to you, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], from the $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$! We are brokers, deal-makers who have traveled the stars from $NAME_Tradestation_Tungle$.\n\n$fleet3contact_explanation$

entries.zh:
见到你们真好，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。你的财富虽然在积累，但是你的灵魂却一片空虚，不是吗？我们感知到了这一点，我们前来与你进行交易，我们带的东西可好了。

我们是$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$，来自$NAME_Caravaneer_Home$的商人。

$fleet3contact_explanation$
entries.en:
Well met, well met, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Your credits amass, yet there is emptiness in your spirit, no? We sense it. We come with swift hands, bearing many goods!

We are the $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$, traders of the $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$.

$fleet3contact_explanation$

entries.zh: 我们带着和平的愿景来到了你们境内，我们仅仅只是想做点买卖，§H嘶！§!，我们将提供给你们上好的货物，合乎心意的交易。我们走之前会再见面的。\n\n如果您对我们有何要求，$NAME_Caravaneer_Home$一定随叫随到。
entries.en: We pass through your space in peace. Only to buy, to sell, §Hkssk!§! We will offer you good deals, many things. We will speak again before we leave.\n\nShould you call us, the $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$ will answer.

entries.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]！欢迎你们。我们是$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$的操作员，从属于$NAME_Caravaneer_Home$。

我们穿越于无垠的宇宙。我们捕捉每一丝星光。我们收集。我们交易！

$fleet3contact_explanation_notinborder$
entries.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]! We greet you. We are operators of $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$, a member of the $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$.

We travel the stars. We see all that glows. We gather. And we trade!

$fleet3contact_explanation_notinborder$

entries.zh: 你们好啊，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，来自$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$向你们问候！我们是从$NAME_Tradestation_Tungle$出发的穿越星际的贸易者。\n\n$fleet3contact_explanation_notinborder$
entries.en: Greetings to you, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], from the $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$! We are brokers, deal-makers who have traveled the stars from $NAME_Tradestation_Tungle$.\n\n$fleet3contact_explanation_notinborder$

见到你们真好，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。你的财富虽然在积累，但是你的灵魂却一片空虚，不是吗？我们感知到了这一点，我们前来与你进行交易，我们带的东西可好了。

我们是$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$，来自$NAME_Caravaneer_Home$的商人。

$fleet3contact_explanation_notinborder$
entries.en:
Well met, well met, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Your credits amass, yet there is emptiness in your spirit, no? We sense it. We come with swift hands, bearing many goods!

We are the $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$, traders of the $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$.

$fleet3contact_explanation_notinborder$

entries.zh: 我们穿过了你们的宇域。想买点啥，再卖点啥！我们能够提供上好的交易，商品满目琳琅。哎呀，我们的船突然走丢了，§H嘶哈！§!我们还会回来的，我们之后再继续洽淡。\n\n你要是想联系我们，$NAME_Caravaneer_Home$会进行答复。
entries.en: We pass through your space in peace. Only to buy, to sell! We will offer you good deals, many things. Just now, our ships are absent, §Hkssk!§! We will speak to you soon, when we come back.\n\nShould you call us, the $NAME_Caravaneer_Home$ will answer.

entries.zh: 我已经说过了。将能源转换器重新调至辅助模式。不，不是那个能源转换器！§H嘶！§!是不是什么都要我来啊？\n\n噢！客人啊！欢迎。我们有很多稀有的上乘的好货。穿越星际只为安全送达你手中！
entries.en: I have already explained. Re-route the power converter to the auxiliary manifold. No, not that power converter! §HKssk!§! Must I do everything my--\n\nOh! Customers! Welcome, please. We bear many goods, we have many wares. All carted safely through the stars for your convenience!

entries.zh: 你喜欢合金吗，§H嘶？§!你喜欢金属或者燃气吗？辛勤的劳工？贵重的矿石？我知道你肯定会有兴趣的。
entries.en: Do you like alloys, §Hkssk?§! Do you like metals and gases? Hard workers? Precious minerals? Yes. We thought you might.

entries.zh: 噢，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。这是最后一批货！你根本不敢相信，§H嘶！§!箱子里面装满了各种各样的武器。多到数不清的武器。来看看吧。
entries.en: Oh, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The last haul! You would not believe it, §Hkssk!§! Crates and crates overflowing with munitions. Cubic tons of it! Come, please. Look.

entries.zh: 真不该相信他们的，真不该和他们做买卖。肮脏的[scammer_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！§H嘶！§!\n\n哦，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们向您致敬，你愿意和我们交易吗？
entries.en: Never should have trusted them. Never should have made that deal. Filthy [scammer_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! §HKssk!§!\n\nOh. [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We greet you. Would you like to trade?

entries.zh: 这可不是什么破旧的遗物，这是一件古董！想想吧，§H嘶§!。它已经存在了多少个世纪了。而且还会一直存在下去！
entries.en: It is not a relic. It is an antique! Just think, §Hkssk§!. It survived this many centuries already. Built to last!

entries.zh: 生锈？什么生锈？\n\n哦，那个只要刮下来就行了。刮，刮，刮。马上就变新了！
entries.en: The rust? What rust?\n\nOh. That rust. Just scrape it off. Scrape, scrape, scrape. And good as new!

entries.zh: $NAME_Ketlings$？是的，我们知道他们。曾经我们是同族兄弟。但那是很久以前了。他们不喜欢也不承认我们比他们更优秀，更加擅长收集，寻找以及掠夺。他们流放了我们。让我们在虚空中流浪！\n\n不过没关系。我们现在变得更强大了，即使没有他们。
entries.en: $NAME_Ketlings$? Yes. We know of them. Our once-brethren. Generations ago, long back. They did not like, did not approve that we were cleverer than they! Better at collecting, finding, taking. Greater. They sent us away. Floating in the void!\n\nNo matter. We are stronger now, without them.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]看看你的那些点数。都快要爆出来了！让我们帮你减轻一点负担吧。让我们帮忙吧。
entries.en: Look at your credit silos, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Full to bursting! Please, let us lighten them. Let us assist.

entries.zh: 我们还有矿石，丰富、闪闪发光的矿石。将夜晚照亮的矿石！专门为[Root.GetName]准备的闪亮矿石。\n\n但我们很饿，我们很渴！请给我们[Root.GetFleet3ScaledCostDeal1]，我们将用[Root.GetFleet3ScaledProductDeal1]协助你的工人。
entries.en: We have ore. Rich, luminous ore. Torn right from the stone! Sparkling minerals for the [Root.GetName].\n\nBut we hunger. We thirst! Grant us [Root.GetFleet3ScaledCostDeal1], and we shall supply your builders, your makers with [Root.GetFleet3ScaledProductDeal1].

entries.zh: 我们有一个领袖，对于[Root.GetName]来说再合适不过了！[Root.GetFleet3ProductDeal2]\n\n给我们[Root.GetFleet3CostDeal2]，领袖就归你了！
entries.en: We have a leader, an excellent fit for the [Root.GetName]! [Root.GetFleet3ProductDeal2]\n\nGive us [Root.GetFleet3CostDeal2], and the leader is yours!

entries.zh: 我们可以为你提供工人，搬东西的，拖东西的，清东西的！健康。聪明。给我们£alloys£§R2000§!$alloys$，我们将会派出§G300§!$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3_species$£pop£人口前往你的星球。\n\n什么？犯罪记录？这种废纸片片我们恐怕找不到咯，§H嘶！§!
entries.en: We have good workers for you. Good lifters, draggers, pullers, cleaners! Healthy. Clever. Give us £alloys£ §R2000§! $alloys$, and we shall send §G300§! $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3_species$ £pop£ Pops to one of your planets.\n\nWhat? Criminal records? Afraid we've lost the papers, §Hkssk!§!

entries.zh: 我们可以为你提供工人，搬东西的，拖东西的，清东西的！健康。聪明。给我们£alloys£ §R2000§!$alloys$，我们将会派出§G300§!$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3_robot$£pop£ 人口前往你的星球。\n\n什么？犯罪记录？啊呀我们找不到了那些没用的文档了，§H嘶！§!
entries.en: We have good workers for you. Good lifters, draggers, pullers, cleaners! Healthy. Clever. Give us £alloys£ §R2000§! $alloys$, and we shall send §G300§! $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3_robot$ £pop£ Pops to one of your planets.\n\nWhat? Criminal records? Afraid we've lost the papers, §Hkssk!§!

entries.zh: 我们这里还有好东西，你看，设计图！是一个非常先进，非常特别的建筑。一个§G$building_waste_reprocessing_center$§!，将你的残渣和废料变成高电流能源和有用的矿物。\n\n不过我们需要……工人。开采平台715-B上发生了惨痛的事故，§H嘶！§!给我们§R300§!个§H$pop_cat_worker$§!£pop£人口，我们就会把建筑蓝图给你们。
entries.en: We have schematics. Designs! For a building, very advanced, very unique. A §G$building_waste_reprocessing_center$§!, to convert your scrap and waste into high-current energy and useful minerals.\n\nBut we need... workers. Terrible accident on Mining Platform 715-B, §Hkssk!§! Send us §R300§! §H$pop_cat_worker$§! £pop£ Pops, and we will give the blueprints to you.

entries.zh: 我们这里还有好东西，你看，设计图！是一个非常先进，非常特别的建筑。一个§G$building_waste_reprocessing_center$§!，将你的残渣和废料变成高电流能源和有用的矿物。\n\n不过我们需要……工人。开采平台715-B上发生了惨痛的事故，§H啐！§!给我们§R300§!个§H$pop_cat_simple_drone$§!£pop£ 人口，我们就会把建筑蓝图给你们。
entries.en: We have schematics. Designs! For a building, very advanced, very unique. A §G$building_waste_reprocessing_center$§!, to convert your scrap and waste into high-current energy and useful minerals.\n\nBut we need... workers. Terrible accident on Mining Platform 715-B, §Hkssk!§! Send us §R300§! §H$pop_cat_simple_drone$§! £pop£ Pops, and we will give the blueprints to you.

entries.zh:
我们有一个专门为你准备的交易。独有的技术，只由$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$打造的技术！

不知道你会不会为行星防御系统头疼，不知道怎么穿透这层系统？我们将会为你带来一个非常非常特别而且先进的技术，专门强化轰炸用的，我们称它为§G$ORBITAL_TRASH_1$§!！

给我们[Root.GetFleet3CostDeal6]。我们马上将方法教给你们，§H嘶！§!你的船只很快就会得到部件升级。
entries.en:
We have a special offer. Inimitable technology, only developed by the $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$!

Do you have trouble penetrating the defensive grids of planets? We can show you a way, very advanced, very technical, of improved bombardment. We call it... §Gthe $ORBITAL_TRASH_1$§!!

Give us [Root.GetFleet3CostDeal6]. Then we will show you the method, and §Hkssk!§! You will have a component to add to your ships.

entries.zh:
我们注意到了你在§Y[fleet3deal7planet.GetName]§!轨道上的开采站。它开采能源，对吧？我们可以帮忙。我们可以送你一颗卫星，它使用了最新的科技！我们称之为§G$racket_energy_extractor$§!！

它将留在轨道上，并增加你能从§Y[fleet3deal7planet.GetName]§!的表面上获取的£energy£§Y$energy$§!。

[Root.GetFleet3CostDeal7]
entries.en:
We have noticed your mining station in orbit of §Y[fleet3deal7planet.GetName]§!. It extracts energy, does it not? We can assist. We can grant you a satellite, one fitted with a clever technology! We call it the §G$racket_energy_extractor$§!!

It will remain in orbit, and increase the amount of £energy£ §Y$energy$§! you can obtain from §Y[fleet3deal7planet.GetName]§!'s surface.

[Root.GetFleet3CostDeal7]

entries.zh:
你需要§Y$energy$§!，对吧？为了让那些驱动你们一族的百万电路迸发出电火花？我们可以帮忙。

我们可以用§G$racket_generator_regulator$§!来增强你们的§Y[technician_drone.GetNamePlural]§!，使你们的§Y$district_generator_plural$§!性能提升百分之二十五！只要你给我们一些好处，我们就将在§Y[fleet3deal8planet.GetName]§!上部署这些装置。

[Root.GetFleet3CostDeal8]
entries.en:
You need §Y$energy$§!, do you not? To zap and spark along the million circuits that drive your kind? We can assist.

With the §G$racket_generator_regulator$§!, we can heighten the capacity of your §Y[technician_drone.GetNamePlural]§! to interface with the machines in your §Y$district_generator_plural$§! by twenty-five percent! We will deploy them on §Y[fleet3deal8planet.GetName]§!, if you grant us a small favor.

[Root.GetFleet3CostDeal8]

entries.zh: 我们有一艘船！一艘§G$destroyer$§!：很棒，很快，很强！装备很好！绝对不是出于某些理由才想把它甩掉的，绝对不是！没时间让你的机械师们仔细检查它了，§H嘶嘶！§!你想要这艘船，对吧？\n\n给我们£minerals£ §R2000§!$minerals$，船就归你了。
entries.en: We have a ship! A §G$destroyer$§!: very good, fast, strong! Well-equipped! Certainly not getting rid of it for a reason, oh, no! No time to let your mechanics examine it, §Hkssk!§! You want the ship, do you not?\n\nGive us £minerals£ §R2000§! $minerals$, and the ship is yours.

entries.zh: 不错。我们接受你的提议。
很高兴也很荣幸能够和[Root.GetName]做生意。我们会再来的！
entries.en: A pleasure, a joy to deal with the [Root.GetName]. We will visit again!

entries.zh: 一个工程师：拥有灵活的指头，敏捷的思维。十分擅长除法和线材！
entries.en: An engineer: nimble fingers, swift mind. Very good with wires and long division!

entries.zh: 一名拥有完美组织能力的行政官！十分聪明，很有远见。最喜欢在沙滩漫步！
entries.en: An official of superb logistics! Very clever, thinks ahead. Likes long walks on the beach!

entries.zh: 这合金。这重量。这光泽。这光芒！你以前见过这样的合金吗？难以置信的屈变力。简直就是最高等级。不包含任何杂质。我们能够感受到它。它正在召唤你。\n\n我们能为你提供£alloys£ §G2000§!§Y$alloys$§!，
entries.en: This alloy. The weight. The lustre. The glow! Have you ever seen such metallic bonding? Incredible yield strength. Maximum grade. Nominal impurities. We can feel it. It calls to you.\n\nWe will give to you £alloys£ §G2000§! §Y$alloys$§!,

entries.zh: 这些异星天然气，绝品啊！为了运输方便我们将其压缩到最大密度。不过注意了，它们十分不稳定！你肯定想要这些燃料吧？给你的护盾供能？还是你的大炮？现在它们就是你的了。\n\n我们能为你提供£exotic_gases£ §G150§!§Y$exotic_gases$§!，
entries.en: These exotic gases. Effervescent. Compressed to maximum density, for logistical convenience. Highly volatile - careful! You desire them, do you not? For your shields, your plasma cannons? They can be yours.\n\nWe will give you £exotic_gases£§G150§! §Y$exotic_gases$§!,

entries.zh: 这种金属不断移动，流动，重构，§H嘶！§!我们自己就发现了很多种用途。你肯定也会找到它的用途。\n\n我们能为你提供£sr_living_metal£ §G40§!§Y$sr_living_metal$§!，
entries.en: This metal. It moves. It flows. It reconstructs, §Hkssk!§! We have found many uses for it. We are certain you shall, too.\n\nWe will give you £sr_living_metal£  §G40§! §Y$sr_living_metal$§!,

entries.zh: 一名§G等级 3§!的§H科学官§!加入[Root.GetName]
一名§G等级3§!的§H行政官§!加入[Root.GetName]
现在到了讨论报酬的时候了。我们和……一些执法部门闹了些不愉快。都是小细节。并不重要。但是我们需要一些人来做我们的证人，一些帮助，一些正直的人来为我们撑腰！强大而充满智慧的你们愿意为我们这些可怜的商人做担保吗，值得信任，非常无辜，我们只不过是稍微没注意做错了一点事，结果就被监管部门给盯上了§H嘶§!。
entries.en: Now. For the cost. We have... run afoul of some legalities. Minor details. Very trivial. But we would require some witness, some support. An upstanding face, to back our cause! Would your strong and wise nation vouch for us, poor trustworthy traders, very innocent, whose only mistake was a distraction of the mind, a mere oversight that led to the transgression of some pesky §Hkssk§! legislature?

entries.zh: 给我们£exotic_gases£ §R15§!§Y$exotic_gases$§!，然后我们立马布置卫星！
entries.en: Give us £exotic_gases£ §R15§! §Y$exotic_gases$§!, and we will deploy this satellite!

entries.zh: 我们会为你们布置这颗卫星！前提是你先给我们£consumer_goods£ §R100§!§Y$consumer_goods$§!。
entries.en: We will deploy this satellite for you! If you grant us £consumer_goods£ §R100§! §Y$consumer_goods$§!.

entries.zh: 现在到了讨论报酬的时候了。我们和……一些执法部门闹了些不愉快。都是小细节。并不重要。但是我们需要一些人来做我们的证人，提供一些帮助。强大而充满智慧的你们愿意为我们这些可怜的商人做担保吗，值得信任，非常无辜，我们只不过是稍微没注意做错了一点事，结果就被监管部门给盯上了§H嘶§!。
entries.en: We have... run afoul of some legalities. Minor details. Very trivial. But we would require some witness, some support. Would your strong and wise nation vouch for us, poor trustworthy traders, very innocent, whose only mistake was a distraction of the mind, a mere oversight that led to the transgression of some pesky §Hkssk§! legislature?

entries.zh: 那么等我们要离开时会再次联系你们。不过到那时候交易条件可能就不一样了！
entries.en: Then we shall call you again, before making our leave of your space. But we may alter the deal!

entries.zh: 你想过了吗？你深思熟虑过了吗？你改变主意了吗？§H嘶！§!
entries.en: Have you thought? Have you considered? Have you changed your minds? §HKssk!§!

entries.zh: 我们很长一段时间都不会前来[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]了。你可别错过这次机会啊。
entries.en: We shall not return to [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] space for quite some time. You would not want to be left without.
Take the deal! Take it! Take it! Take it!

entries.zh: 我们能够感知你的思维。这桩买卖萦绕在你的心头。它呼唤着你，我说的对吗？
entries.en: We can feel your minds. The deal, it tempts you. It calls to you. Does it not?

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！我们马上就要离开了。这桩买卖现在还奏效，商品都还完好无损！别错过机会了！§H嘶！§!
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We are about to make leave of your space. The deal, it still stands, the wares are still fresh! Strike while the slag is hot! §HKssk!§!

entries.zh: 关于发生在[From.From.solar_system.GetName]星系的敌对活动，目前[From.From.GetName]舰队很高兴地告诉我们$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$已经被摧毁了。\n\n曾经名声大噪的$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3_species$行商，现在不过是星际中漂浮的垃圾罢了。今后他们再也不会来打扰我们了。
entries.en: Following hostilities in the [From.From.solar_system.GetName] system, the [From.From.GetName] Fleet is pleased to report that the $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$ has been destroyed.\n\nThe once-bustling $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3_species$ caravan is now little more than interstellar scrap. We shall be troubled by their clattering presence no more.

entries.zh:
消息传到了[Root.Capital.GetName]，$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$已经不复存在了。

在与[From.GetName]发生冲突之后，曾经名声大噪的$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3_species$行商，现在不过是星际中漂浮的垃圾罢了。

希望这样的结果会令他们感到满意。
entries.en:
News has reached [Root.Capital.GetName] that the $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$ is no more.

Following a hostile encounter with the [From.GetName], the once-bustling $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3_species$ caravan is now little more than interstellar scrap.

Perhaps it is an end that would not have displeased them.

entries.zh: 来自[pops_join_caravan_planet.GetName]的报道指出，有一批居民离开了殖民地，选择加入正穿行于我们领地的[pops_join_caravan_fleet.GetName]舰队，他们表面上说是为了冒险的梦想，不过是被赤裸裸的利益熏昏了头罢了。
entries.en: Reports from [pops_join_caravan_planet.GetName] inform us that a number of inhabitants have left the colony to join the [pops_join_caravan_fleet.GetName] fleet passing through our territory, ostensibly drawn by dreams of adventure or the heady aroma of raw mercantilism.

entries.zh: [caravan_pops_join_planet.GetName]传来一条紧急消息，上面说有一批[caravan_pops_join_country.GetName]的原成员目前正打算在这颗星球上寻求政治庇护。当地管理部门决定上报这一情况，让更高阶的官员定夺。
entries.en: An urgent missive from [caravan_pops_join_planet.GetName] explains that a number of now-former members of the [caravan_pops_join_country.GetName] seek political asylum on the planet. The local administration has seen fit to pass the decision of what to do with them up the chain of command.

entries.zh: 我们驻扎在[caravan_hulk_system.GetName]星系恒星基地的情报员报告说，[caravan_hulk_country.GetName]已经离去并遗弃了一艘破旧船只，现在位于中央恒星的不稳定轨道。
entries.en: Our starbase in the [caravan_hulk_system.GetName] system reports that the [caravan_hulk_country.GetName] fleet has evacuated and abandoned a decrepit ship, now in unstable orbit around the system's central star.

entries.zh: 把它拖到我们的恒星基地进行报废处理。
entries.en: Tow it to the starbase for disposal.

entries.zh: 大概因为是民用运输船的缘故，舰上的数据库并未按照报废规程进行完全清除。尽管在船上没有别的有价值的发现，我们的科学家仍设法获取了某种未知外星科技的部分资料。
entries.en: Likely due to the vessel being a civilian transport, the shipboard databases were not fully scrubbed as part of the decommissioning process. So while nothing else of value was found aboard the ship, our data scientists have managed to recover partial references to unknown alien technologies.

entries.zh: 今天在[disgruntled_planet.GetName]爆发了大规模抗议，由于这个星系中[xeno_fleet.GetName]的种种暴行。他们肮脏的存在侵犯到了所有有正义感的[disgruntled_planet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural]。
entries.en: Mass protests erupted on [disgruntled_planet.GetName] today, due to outrage over the [xeno_fleet.GetName] in the system. Their grubby presence offends all right-thinking [disgruntled_planet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural].

entries.zh: 当[welcome_fleet.GetName]按照原计划进入[pleased_planet.GetName]轨道开展简短的参观的时候，一场自发的友好行动演变成了露天市场和派对，[pleased_planet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural]与[welcome_fleet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural]之间建立起了许多羁绊，做成了很多买卖。
entries.en: As the [welcome_fleet.GetName] entered the orbit of [pleased_planet.GetName] for what should have been a brief courtesy visit today, a spontaneous outbreak of goodwill turned into a combination of open-air market and party. Many bonds between [pleased_planet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural] and [welcome_fleet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural] were forged, and much trading took place.

entries.zh: 近期[stealing_fleet.GetName]参观[stolen_from_planet.GetName]之后，人们发现有一部分资源居然莫名其妙消失了。人们怀疑是被[stealing_fleet.GetName]给顺手牵羊了。
entries.en: After a recent visit of the [stealing_fleet.GetName] to [stolen_from_planet.GetName] it has been noticed that a number of resources are missing from the central reserve. It is suspected that the [stealing_fleet.GetName] somehow made off with them.

entries.zh: 在[pleased_planet.GetName]与[party_host.GetNamePlural]共同待了几个月之后，有迹象表明他们之间的关系比预想的更加紧密了。他们想要留下来。
entries.en: In the months following the party with the [party_host.GetNamePlural] on [pleased_planet.GetName], evidence is mounting that some of the bonds formed were closer than expected. They have asked to stay.

entries.zh: 打造$mega_art_installation_3$的第一步就要同时面临两个困难：修建一个巨大到能容纳一个错综复杂的展览馆的空间站与组织一场空前规模的展览会。当所有基本设施都准备完全时，修建保险库将成为第一要务。保险库必须足够安全以及牢固，专门用来保护这星系之中的艺术财富。
entries.en: The first stage of constructing a $mega_art_installation_3$ combined the difficulties of building a vast station with the complexities of organizing a museum and gallery on an unprecedented scale. With the basic structure in place, the Vault will be the top priority. Planned to be a marvel of security and stability, the Vault will contain and protect the artistic wealth of the galaxy.

entries.zh: 我们$mega_art_installation_3$的第二阶段已经完成，填满保险库的工作已经开始。一只专门的运输舰队将会持续不断地将我们帝国的瑰宝运送到它们的新家来。同时，可供工作人员居住的住所以及更多的展览空间等其他建筑也正在建造。
entries.en: The second stage of our $mega_art_installation_3$ is complete and the process of filling the Vault has begun. A dedicated fleet of transport ships operates constantly to transport the treasure of our empire to its new home. Meanwhile, additional structures are being built to house the multitude of required staff, and to display a vast number of exhibits.

entries.zh: 展览空间站群目前已经建设完毕。这些空间站论单个都比许多普通的恒星基地要大，每天能够容纳数以百万计的访客。万事俱备，只待开门大吉，我们的展厅能够展示[From.Owner.GetSpeciesName]和来自星系其他地区的满目琳琅以涤荡普罗大众的心灵。运输第一批游客的舰船已经到站了。
entries.en: The Exhibition Stations are complete. Each larger than many Starbases, these stations can accommodate millions of visitors per day. Now ready to open at long last, they will display the artistry of [From.Owner.GetSpeciesName] and the galaxy to the delight of all. The first fleet of transport ships carrying visitors is already making its approach.

entries.zh: 展览空间站群目前已经建设完毕。这些空间站论单个都比许多普通的恒星基地要大，每天能够容纳数以百万计的访客。万事俱备，只待开门大吉，我们的展会将会展出来自星系各国的艺术臻品以彰显不同物种的多样性。运输第一批游客的舰船已经到站了。
entries.en: The Exhibition Stations are complete. Each larger than many Starbases, these stations can accommodate millions of visitors per day. Now ready to open at long last, they will show samples of art from every race to celebrate the diversity of the galaxy. The first fleet of transport ships carrying visitors is already making its approach.

entries.zh: 展览空间站群目前已经建设完毕。这些空间站论单个都比许多普通的恒星基地要大，每天能够容纳数以百万计的访客。万事俱备，只待开门大吉，我们的展会将会展示[From.Owner.GetAdj]的真正艺术作品！同时还会展出一小部分外星艺术作为陪衬。运输第一批游客的舰船已经到站了。
entries.en: The Exhibition Stations are complete. Each larger than many Starbases, these stations can accommodate millions of visitors per day. Now ready to open at long last, they will display the true glory of [From.Owner.GetAdj] art! A small selection of Xeno-art shall also be displayed for comparison and mockery. The first fleet of transport ships carrying visitors is already making its approach.

entries.zh: 全副武装的战略指挥中心已经建设完成。目前我们军队的指挥精英们都已经集结于其中，它是如此的无坚不摧。因为既安全又集中，他们可以全心全意为如何最好地防御我国的计划服务。
entries.en: The armored hull of the Strategic Coordination Center is complete. Now housing the absolute cream of our military command, it is virtually impregnable. Secure and concentrated they are able to devote their every waking hour to planning how best to defend our empire.

entries.zh: 全副武装的战略指挥中心已经建设完成。目前我们军队的指挥精英们都已经集结于其中，它是如此的无坚不摧。因为既安全又集中，他们可以全心全意为如何最好地征服星海的计划服务。
entries.en: The armored hull of the Strategic Coordination Center is complete. Now housing the absolute cream of our military command, it is virtually impregnable. Secure and concentrated they are able to devote their every waking hour to planning how best to conquer the galaxy.

entries.zh: 全副武装的战略指挥中心已经建设完成。目前我们军队的指挥精英们都已经集结于其中，它是如此的无坚不摧。因为既安全又集中，他们可以全心全意为如何最好地抓捕奴隶的计划服务。
entries.en: The armored hull of the Strategic Coordination Center is complete. Now housing the absolute cream of our military command, it is virtually impregnable. Secure and concentrated they are able to devote their every waking hour to planning how best to capture the maximum number of slaves.

entries.zh: 强大的通信阵列已被加入到战略指挥中心之中，这样我们的舰船无论在哪都可以收到来自于我们的战略指令了。这些目前最为先进的通信阵列能够克服一切干扰，并且它量子纠缠的信号完全无法被破解。
entries.en: Powerful communication arrays have been added to the Strategic Coordination Center, enabling our strategists to issue orders to our ships throughout the galaxy. These state-of-the-art arrays are powerful enough to burn through any possible jamming, and the quantum-entangled signal is utterly unhackable.

entries.zh: 战略指挥中心：全面运行

战略指挥中心最后的附加部分是一些分离的\"敌方军队\"模拟堡垒。这些堡垒差不多就是战略指挥中心的微缩版，而且完全独立运行。精英指挥官和他的手下们在其中能够完整地沉浸在敌人的文化与传统之中，通过学习他们的艺术，能更好地理解并模拟他们的军事思想。当完全沉浸之后，他们会与战略指挥中心的工作人员开展一场场虚拟战争，使得我们能够模拟任何可能的冲突，并能从两边学习到所有的细节，我们便能够在实战当中拥有比敌人更加卓越的战术。
entries.en: The final additions to the Strategic Coordination Center are several detached "Hostile force" simulator bastions. These bastions contain much of the functionality of the Strategic Coordination Center on a smaller scale, but are completely independent of the main system. Within, elite commanders and their staff can become totally immersed in the culture and traditions of our enemies, and by studying their artwork can better understand and simulate their military thinking. Once fully immersed, they will fight virtual wars against the staff of the Strategic Coordination Center, allowing us to stimulate conflicts with any possible enemy in excruciating detail which can then be studied from the perspectives of both sides and our strategies refined upon.

entries.zh: 星际集会第一阶段最关键的特征的就是§S基座§!了。一个复杂的黑洞全息影像，它被用来召唤星系中心潜伏的引力深渊：那整个星系旋转的支点。\n\n等到建成之后，这个地方也将会成为某些事务的轴心，那些能驱使整个星河旋转的静默外交与软实力博弈将会紧紧围绕着它。
entries.en: The most crucial feature of the initial stage of the Interstellar Assembly is the §SLocus§!. A sophisticated holographic projection of a black hole, it is meant to evoke the gravitational chasm that lurks in the galactic core: the fulcrum upon which the galaxy turns.\n\nOnce fully built, this place will also be an axle of sorts, around which the quiet diplomacy and soft power that often drive the galaxy swirl.

entries.zh: 星际集会的第二阶段，领事环，现已建成。这个内环将能够容下我们大部分的外交人员在里面活动。
entries.en: The second stage of the Interstellar Assembly, the Consul Ring, is now complete. This inner circle will house most of our diplomatic staff going forward.

entries.zh: 星际集会：会议广场模块
星际集会的外环将会配有大量最先进的隐私保护会议室（当然，只有[Root.GetAdj]能够进行监控）。这座空间站正在迅速成为非现场谈判方面无可辩驳的星系枢纽。
entries.en: The Interstellar Assembly's outer ring is populated with vast, state-of-the-art conference rooms equipped with privacy filters (penetrable only by [Root.GetAdj] surveillance, of course). The station is quickly becoming the de-facto galactic hub for off-site negotiations.

entries.zh: 星际集会已全力运作，目前正在招待星际间几股大势力的重要人物们，无论他们是政界还是商界的。\n\n我们的外交官们在跟进空间站内传出的那些国家利益与政治羞辱的信息流时受了不少累。不过至少我们的客人对我们的监控并不关心，只要我们一直为他们提供这种同竞争对手角力的理想环境就好了。
entries.en: The Interstellar Assembly is now fully operational, and plays host to a number of embassies from the galaxy's major powers, be they political or corporate.\n\nOur diplomats are having a hard time keeping up with the steady flow of information on national interests and political embarrassments we are extracting from the station. At least our guests seem largely disinterested in our surveillance, as long as we provide the ideal environs for them to strong-arm their competitors.

entries.zh: 为了对[From.GetName]进行开采，我们首先需要一个安全基地才能开始建造其他。星锚已经在黑洞事件视界的最边缘处建造完成，并且已经由一个重力重定向引擎牢牢稳定住，通过逆转[From.GetName]自身产生的重力去抵抗巨大的引力。
entries.en: To extract matter from [From.GetName] we first need a secure base to build the facility on. The Anchor has been built on the very edge of the event horizon and is held in place against the immense gravitational pull by an advanced gravity redirection engine, which turns [From.GetName]'s own gravity against it.

entries.zh: 建造于现有重力重定向系统之上，重力透镜设施能够使一部分力穿过“透镜”，将力更加密集地集中在某一片选中的区域。
entries.en: Built on the existing gravity redirection system, the Gravity Lensing Facility is able to redirect a portion of the force into a "Lens", concentrating the force even more strongly in a selected area.

entries.zh: 从黑洞提取物质的关键就在于究极精致的重力重定向系统：在某个区域集中生成一片引力扭曲的区域，然后打造出一个专门用来应对重力情况下的大型重定向钻头。
entries.en: The key to extracting matter from the black hole is the ultimate refinement of the gravity redirection system: Forming a focused area of twisted gravity, in effect creating a vast drill whose bore is made of redirected and concentrated gravitational force.

entries.zh: 物质解压器的最后一步看上去十分单调，但也有他最令人震撼的一面。一大堆自动化的冶炼厂以及处理器开始将采取自[From.GetName]的物质分解，解压缩并分离为实用的矿物，再装入连续不绝的机械驳船舰队中，送往帝国各地。
entries.en: The final stage of the Matter Decompressor is the most mundane, but in its own way the most impressive. A vast automated array of smelters and processors break down, decompress, and separate the material of [From.GetName] into useful minerals which are decanted into an unending fleet of robotic barges to be delivered around our empire.

entries.zh: 你好。我是一个收藏家，在这向你提供一个千载难逢的机会。我有一个盒子要出售，盒子当中有什么我不会泄露，我也不会给你看。你可以用3000£energy£能量币来买，然后不管里面有什么都归你了，但是一旦出手概不退换。
entries.en: Greetings. I am The Collector and I offer you an opportunity. I have a box for sale, a box obtained through means I will not divulge and with a content I shall not reveal. You may purchase this box for £energy£ 3000 and keep whatever it contains, but I offer no refunds.

entries.zh: 你都不让我们知道箱子里面有什么就打算让我们付钱？
entries.en: You expect us to pay for this box with no idea of its contents?

entries.zh: 我是收藏家。我经常委托行商舰队收集星系中的遗物。你只需要知道这些。
entries.en: I am the Collector. I have long worked through the Caravaneer fleets to acquire the relics of the galaxy. That is all you need to know.

entries.zh: 经常光顾绰尔的罗盘使得[cara_border_planet.GetName]的很多人开始沉迷赌博。许多人为了筹钱继续赌下去而走上了犯罪的道路。
entries.en: Frequent visits to Chor's Compass have resulted in many people on [cara_border_planet.GetName] becoming addicted to gambling. Many have turned to crime in order to pay for repeated trips

entries.zh: [caravaneer_neighbor.GetName]来的大量[caravaneer_neighbor_species.GetName]观光客在[cara_border_planet.GetName]上演变成了一个巨大的派对。然而“派对”开着开着却出了问题，现在变成了一场全球暴动。
entries.en: A visit by a large number of [caravaneer_neighbor_species.GetName] from the [caravaneer_neighbor.GetName] has resulted in a massive party on [cara_border_planet.GetName]. Unfortunately, things have gotten out of hand and the "party" now resembles a planet-wide riot.

entries.zh: [caravaneer_neighbor.GetName]最近发布了一种全新的老虎机，这也使得[cara_border_planet.GetName]在游客的帮助下成功迎来了一次经济的突飞猛进。
entries.en: The [caravaneer_neighbor.GetName] recently revealed a new range of slot machines, and the increased traffic has caused an economic boom on [cara_border_planet.GetName] as visitors pass through.

entries.zh: 绰尔的罗盘是一个专门找刺激的地方。由于经常光顾的原因，[cara_border_planet.GetName]的公民们对于周遭事物的冷静已经到了一个前所未有的水平。
entries.en: Chor's Compass is a rowdy place which is not for the faint of heart. Due to frequent visits, the citizens of [cara_border_planet.GetName] have become accustomed to conditions there to an unprecedented level.

entries.zh: 巨尸乐队音乐会：百万雄尸！
[cara_border_planet.GetName]在灵能金属乐巨尸乐队的音乐会失控后陷入混乱。破坏面之广使得人们只能一点点拼凑出当时的情况。不过有一件可以确认的事情是，在演出高潮时科尔-阿赞在月球上打出了一个洞，将它给完全摧毁了。
entries.en: [cara_border_planet.GetName] has been left in chaos after a concert by the Psi-Metal phenomenon Megacorpse got out of hand. Reports are scrambled due to the wide-spread devastation, but one thing they all agree on is that at the height of the performance frontbeing Kel-Azaan punched a hole in the moon, destroying it utterly.

entries.zh: [cara_border_planet.GetName]在灵能金属乐巨尸乐队的音乐会失控后陷入混乱。破坏面之广使得人们只能一点点拼凑出当时的情况。不过有一件可以确认的事情是，在演出高潮时科尔-阿赞把他的超级吉他重重地朝地上砸去，这导致了整个区域被完全破坏。
entries.en: [cara_border_planet.GetName] has been left in chaos after a concert by the Psi-Metal phenomenon Megacorpse got out of hand. Reports are scrambled due to the wide-spread devastation, but one thing they all agree on is that at the height of the performance frontbeing Kel-Azaan slammed its hyper-guitar into the stage with such force the entire area was destroyed.

entries.zh:
巨尸乐队是企业中最伟大的灵能金属乐队。传说那些形态迥异的乐队成员——科尔-阿赞，甘荃，人类，勇达尔，和塞可达瑞——互相之间通过虚境进行交流。

这是真的。

仅仅只有少数人知道，虚境是星河之声下辖的一个绝密的超声音乐研究部门的代号。星河之声在多元宇宙中引领着音乐潮流，同时也是声波武器制造商。巨尸乐队成立的初衷是作为灵能突击部队。他们会在棘手的“会场”进行“演奏”，通过将微弱的灵能攻击性抑制术埋藏在那些公然辱骂企业的歌词下进而影响听众，高效地暗中破坏叛乱行动。

最后，音乐对于乐队成员那已经十分强大的灵能的催化效果实在过于强大，以至于不能被管理者们控制。成员们分道扬镳，只剩空壳乐队名——因为星河之声不愿意撕毁一个无比赚钱的合约。如今巨尸乐队走到哪弹到哪，只要他们觉得合适，只要那是§R金属乐§!。
entries.en:
MegaCorpse is the greatest psionic-metal band in corporate space. It is said that the disparate bandmates -- Kel-Azaan, Gantren, Human, Yondar, and Scyldari -- made contact through the Shroud.

This is true.

Known only to a select few, the Shroud is the code-name of a top-secret sono-musical skunkworks division of Galactic Sounds, the leading music conglomerate and sonic weapons manufacturer in the multiverse. The MegaCorpse initiative was originally developed as a psionic strike force. They would "play" difficult "venues," effectively subverting rebellious movements with overtly anti-corporate lyrics disguising subtle psionic aggression-dampening measures inflicted on the listener.

Ultimately, the catalytic effects of their music on the band's already-potent psionic powers soon proved too much for managers and executives to control. The band went rogue in all but name - as Galactic Sounds were unwilling to break a fantastically profitable contract - and today MegaCorpse play whatever and wherever they see fit, as long as it is §Rmetal§!.

entries.zh: 我们在[matter_decompressor_system.GetName]的视界线上不可思议地存在着某种采矿装置。我们的科学家认为这可能是一个“§H物质解压器§!”——用于从黑洞中开采矿物的巨型结构。尽管它已无法正常运转，但某些阻止它被意大利面条化的装置一定仍在运作。
entries.en: Impossibly perched on the event horizon of [matter_decompressor_system.GetName] is some kind of mining apparatus. Our scientists theorize that this may be a "§HMatter Decompressor§!" - a megastructure designed to mine materials from a black hole. While it is no longer fully functional, some mechanism preventing its spaghettification must still be operational.

entries.zh: 位于[matter_decompressor_system.GetName]事件视界上的是一个“§H物质解压器§!”——一个从黑洞中获取矿物的巨型结构。即使机能不全，它的引力扭曲引擎一定仍在运作，否则它早就因为黑洞的引力变成一团意大利面条了。
entries.en: Perched on the event horizon of [matter_decompressor_system.GetName] is a "§HMatter Decompressor§!" - a megastructure designed to mine materials from a black hole. While it is no longer fully functional,  its gravitational twist engine must still be operational as it has not suffered spaghettification.

entries.zh: 它似乎与我们自己的很像。
entries.en: It seems similar to our own.

entries.zh: 我们在[strategic_coordination_center_system.GetName]发现了一座被毁的巨大空间站。它破碎的残骸中包含了大量的战斗计算机、模拟器、以及通讯阵列，因此我们的科学家认为这一定是某种“§H战略指挥中心§!”。
entries.en: A massive, ruined space station has been discovered in [strategic_coordination_center_system.GetName]. Its shattered remains contain a plenitude of battlecomputers, simulators, and broadcasting arrays which leads our scientists to speculate it must have been some type of "§HStrategic Coordination Center§!".

entries.zh: 我们在[strategic_coordination_center_system.GetName]发现了一座被毁的巨大空间站。它似乎是一座“§H战略指挥中心§!”的残骸。
entries.en: A massive, ruined space station has been discovered in [strategic_coordination_center_system.GetName]. It appears to be the remains of a "§HStrategic Coordination Center§!".

entries.zh: 我们的永远不会被摧毁!
位于[From.GetName]的废弃战略指挥中心已被完全修复，并由[Root.GetName]最有才华的军事人员掌管。这座巨型结构将恢复其原本的功用，指挥我们整个星系中的军事力量。
entries.en: The abandoned Strategic Coordination Center in [From.GetName] has been fully repaired and staffed by the most brilliant military minds of the [Root.GetName]. True to its original purpose, the megastructure will be put to use coordinating our military might throughout the galaxy.

entries.zh: 我们在[mega_art_installation_system.GetName]中发现了三座被毁的空间站。它们被一团碎片所环绕，其中某些仍可辨识出是艺术品，虽然是非常异星的艺术品——看来这里曾是一座“§H巨型艺术设施§!”。
entries.en: A trio of wrecked space stations have been discovered in [mega_art_installation_system.GetName]. They are surrounded by a cloud of debris, some of which is still vaguely recognizable as works of art, albeit of a very alien nature. It seems that this was at one point a "§HMega Art Installation§!".

entries.zh: 我们在[mega_art_installation_system.GetName]发现了一座被毁的“§H巨型艺术设施§!”。其中的展品已遭受了时间与真空的摧残。
entries.en: A ruined "§HMega Art Installation§!" has been discovered in [mega_art_installation_system.GetName]. Time and vacuum-exposure have not been kind to the exhibits.

entries.zh: 被毁的巨型艺术设施已修复
位于[From.GetName]的被毁巨型艺术设施已被修复完毕。除了[Root.GetName]最伟大的艺术品之外，它也陈列了一小部分从原本的巨型结构中回收并修复的外星艺术品。
entries.en: The once-ruined Mega Art Installation in [From.GetName] has been restored to operation. Fully repaired and stocked with a selection of the greatest artworks of [Root.GetName], it also contains a small selection of exhibits which were recovered and restored from the original megastructure.

entries.zh: 我们在[interstellar_assembly_system.GetName]发现了一座巨大的被毁空间站。从大量办公空间以及一座配有各种不同类型生命维持设施的论坛看来，我们的科学家认为这是一座“§H星际集会§!”的残骸。
entries.en: The remains of a vast space station have been found in [interstellar_assembly_system.GetName]. Judging by the amount of what seems to be office-space and a vast forum outfitted with dozens of different types of life-support systems, our scientists suspect that this is all that remains of an "§HInterstellar Assembly§!".

entries.zh: 我们在[interstellar_assembly_system.GetName]发现了一座“§H星际集会§!”的残骸，并辨别出了十几种不同物种的干尸。
entries.en: The remains of an "§HInterstellar Assembly§!" have been found in [interstellar_assembly_system.GetName]. The mummified remains of at least a dozen different species have been identified so far.

entries.zh: 位于[From.GetName]的星际集会已经再次上线了。它已准备好再次迎接星系中的外交官们，共同商讨当前太阳周期中的问题。
entries.en: The Interstellar Assembly in [From.GetName] is online again. Once more it is ready for the diplomats of the galaxy to gather in one place to debate the great issues of the current solar cycle.

entries.zh: 在多年的研究之后，[Root.GetName]上的某些研究者们觉得自己开始理解太虚了。有一些……波动。力量。一股流动轻柔地通过传送门流向[From.GetName]，并带来我们可以收集的微量暗物质。从理论上讲，我们应该可以使我们的传送门对这股波动更加“显眼”，以此产生更多的暗物质。
entries.en: After years of study, some researchers on [Root.GetName] are beginning to feel they understand the Null Void. There are... currents. Forces. Some flow which gently pushes against the portal to [From.GetName], bringing the traces of Dark Matter we are able to collect. In theory it should be possible to make our portal more "visible" to this force, which should result in a larger harvest.

entries.zh: 一座巨大的信号增幅器将一道能量射入了[Root.GetName]上的传送门。效果立竿见影，传送门另一端的压力明显开始增加，并涌出了更多的暗物质流。
entries.en: A vast signal amplifier has sent a blast of energy through the portal on [Root.GetName]. The effect was immediate, the pressure on the far side of the portal is noticeably stronger, and with it comes an increased flow of Dark Matter.

entries.zh: 校验错误：身份无效！这里是[Root.Owner.Leader.GetName]！表明你的身份！
entries.en: Checksum error: invalid ID! This is [Root.Owner.Leader.GetName]! Identify!

entries.zh: **§Y处理中！§!** 结果：这道传送门连通着次元之间的缝隙。我们都是[Root.Owner.Leader.GetName]，来自不同的次元。
entries.en: **§YPROCESSING!§!** Results: This portal bridges the gap between alternate dimensions. We are both [Root.Owner.Leader.GetName], from divergent dimensions.

entries.zh: 一个未计算的变量。报告另一个[Root.Owner.Species.GetNamePlural]的状况！
entries.en: An uncalculated variable. Report status of alternate [Root.Owner.Species.GetNamePlural]!

entries.zh: 在发明曲速引擎之后，[Root.Owner.Species.GetName]从[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]开始向星海进发——
entries.en: The [Root.Owner.Species.GetName] have spread out through space from [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] since the discovery of the Warp Drive-

entries.zh: 错误！意外值：曲速引擎。预期值：超空间航道。
entries.en: Error! Unexpected value: Warp Drive. Expected value: Hyperlanes.

entries.zh: **§Y处理中！§!** 结果：探索出不同类型的超光速旅行方式是我们宇宙之间的分歧点。查询：曲速兽袭击？
entries.en: **§YPROCESSING!§!** Results: Discovering a different type of FTL travel was the divergence point between our two universes. Query: Warp beast assault?

entries.zh: 值未找到：曲速兽。查询：曲速兽威胁等级？
entries.en: Value not found: Warp beasts. Query: Threat level of Warp beasts?

entries.zh: 曲速兽袭击所有已知文明，它们是所有存在的威胁。假设：一旦曲速旅行在星系中达到某种临界值，曲速兽将觉醒并攻击。数个物种已灭亡，但目前我们仍撑得住。
entries.en: The Warp beasts assail every known civilization, they are a threat to all existence. Hypothesis: Once Warp travel reached a certain critical level in the galaxy, the Warp beasts awoke and attacked. Several species we know of have already fallen, but so far we are holding them off.

entries.zh: 查询：你是否需要物质支援？
entries.en: Query: Do you require material support?

entries.zh: 设立跨次元贸易来增强两个次元的[Root.Owner.Species.GetNamePlural]。
entries.en: Establish inter-dimensional trade to strengthen [Root.Owner.Species.GetNamePlural] in both dimensions.

entries.zh: 状态更新：[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]离线。[Root.Owner.GetName]战斗能力：理想值的23%。剩余殖民地网络：[Root.GetName]。预期结果：曲速兽将在2个太阳周期内完全胜利。错误！[Root.GetName]轨道内发现曲速兽活动！错误！\n\n**§Y信号突然中断§!**
entries.en: Status update: [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] offline. [Root.Owner.GetName] combat capacity: 23% of optimal. Remaining Colony network: [Root.GetName]. Expected results: Total Warp beast victory within 2 solar cycles.  Error! Warp beast activity detected in [Root.GetName] orbit! Error!\n\n**§YThe signal abruptly ends§!**

entries.zh: 自从我们意识到自己不是寰宇之中的孤独之身后，不受外交关系影响的实质星系贸易就一直存在着。随着星系的边境线被不断刷新，旧的商路也不断重绘，星际领袖们同意应该§Y使这种贸易市场合法化§!，让大家都可从中受益。\n\n在今后的几年里，私营贸易者与政府机构将试图建立一个准星系贸易中心。如果该贸易中心坐落于[Root.GetAdj]境内，一定会使我们受益，因此我们可以§Y宣传我们的一颗星球§!作为位置候选。
entries.en: De facto galactic trade, unbound by the performance of international diplomacy, has existed since we first discovered that we are not alone in the universe. As new borders are discovered and old ones redrawn across the galaxy, galactic leaders agree that it is time to §Ylegitimize this commercial forum§! so that all may benefit.\n\nIn the coming years, independent traders and government agencies will be looking to establish a quasi-centralized hub for galactic commerce. We would surely benefit were this hub to fall within [Root.GetAdj] space, so we can choose to §Ypromote one of our worlds§! for this purpose.

entries.zh: 星际消费者们，客户们还有各位乡巴佬们，终于准备好迎接一个准中心化的平台进行轻监管的、中等规模的国际贸易。\n\n我们可以§Y提名一个我们的星球§!成为贸易枢纽，通过这种方式以获得最大化的潜在收入。
entries.en: The customers, clients, and rubes of the galaxy at long last seem ready to accept a quasi-centralized platform for deregulated, mid-scale international commerce.\n\nWe can §Ypromote one of our worlds§! to play host to this commercial hub, to maximize potential revenue.

entries.zh: 遗憾的是，我们一直未能有效地打击§Y与异种社会的违法贸易§!。同样令人遗憾的是，这一不受外交关系影响而且几乎匿名的贸易市场带来了实实在在的利润。\n\n在今后的几年里，私营贸易者与政府机构将试图建立一个准星系贸易中心。如能主导此贸易中心的运营，想必一定会比囤积外星货物要有用得多，因此我们可以§Y宣传我们的一颗星球§!作为位置候选。
entries.en: It is a regrettable fact that we have consistently failed to quash the illicit §Ytrade with the xenos§!. Equally regrettable is that the economic benefits of a largely anonymous forum for trade decoupled from international relations cannot be denied.\n\nIn the coming years, independent traders and government agencies will be looking to establish a quasi-centralized hub for galactic commerce. The economic gains from playing host to such a nexus might well outweigh the burden of harboring alien goods, so we can choose to §Ypromote one of our worlds§! for this purpose.

entries.zh: 尽管很少有人愿意与我们直接进行贸易，星海之中一直存在着一个繁荣的黑市，而我们终于可以利用它了
entries.en: While few are willing to trade with us directly, there exists a thriving galactic black market that we have finally managed to tap into.

entries.zh: 这将使我们的成员切实收益。
entries.en: This may indeed benefit our members.

entries.zh: §H解锁决议：§!提名泛星系贸易市场中心
entries.en: §HUnlocks Decision:§! Nominate for Galactic Market Hub

entries.zh: 我们对[market_founder_planet.GetName]进行的推广宣传有了收获，而贸易巨头们决定将大部分商业活动集中在[market_founder_planet.GetStarName]星系内！
entries.en: Our marketing campaign on [market_founder_planet.GetName] has borne fruit, and the market-powers-that-be have seen fit to centralize much of their activity within the [market_founder_planet.GetStarName] system!

entries.zh: 很不幸，我们发起的建立泛星系贸易市场的动议§Y碰壁了§!。虽然我们明显成功地为该计划调动了政治意愿，但却没收到任何有效的主办地提名。\n\n原则上，商业说客和政治拥趸都支持这个想法，并发誓会加倍努力，只要[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]希望再次尝试。
entries.en: Our motion to bring forth a new Galactic Market has unfortunately §Yfailed§!. While we clearly succeeded in mustering the political will for such a scheme, it did not receive any valid nominations for a host site.\n\nCommercial lobbyists and political proponents alike stand by the idea in principle, having vowed to redouble their efforts should the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] wish to try again.

entries.zh: 看来星系的市场范围无法承载其政治意图。苦于缺乏有效的主办地提名，最近 [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]为构建专门的交易中心而做出的努力都§Y白费了§!。\n\n泛星系贸易市场计划的支持者们旋即表明一点都不觉得尴尬，声称只要[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]认为时机成熟，他们将再次提出自己的主张。
entries.en: It would seem the galaxy's political will has exceeded the reach of its markets. Recent efforts by the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] to establish a dedicated trading hub have §Yfailed§!, with no valid nominations for a host site.\n\nProponents of the Galactic Market scheme were quick to deny any hint of embarrassment, declaring that they will make their case again whenever the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium] considers itself ready.

entries.zh: [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的市场范围无法承载其政治意图，因为最近他们为形成统一的泛星系贸易市场而做出的努力都§Y白费了§!。到头来，异种人备受推崇的项目连一个有效的主办地提名都没能吸引到。\n\n计划的支持者否认这表明异星人的“合作”想法是弄巧成拙。相反，他们坚定地宣称，如果星系的成员认为时机成熟了，可以再次尝试。
entries.en: The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]'s political will has exceeded the reach of its markets, as their recent effort to form a unified Galactic Market has §Yfailed§!. After all was said and done, the xenos' much-vaunted project couldn't entice a single valid nomination for a host site.\n\nProponents of the scheme have denied that this exposes the true folly behind ideas about xeno 'collaboration'. Instead they are resolute in claims that the galaxy may try again, when its members consider themselves ready.

entries.zh: 泛星系贸易中心已被设立在§Y[galactic_market_station.solar_system.GetName]§!恒星系，位于[From.GetName]境内。[From.GetAdj]政府已经正式宣布这一市场合法，资源已经可以通过中立第三方进行买卖。
entries.en: The center of galactic commerce has manifested in the §Y[galactic_market_station.solar_system.GetName]§! system, within the borders of the [From.GetName]. The [From.GetAdj] administration has officially legitimized this marketplace, where resources can be bought and sold through unaffiliated third parties.

entries.zh: 心怀鬼胎的§Y[From.GetName]§!异种建立了一个外星商品的交易市场。尽管我们对此不屑一顾，但市场的大门仍对我们敞开。
entries.en: The dubious xenos of the §Y[From.GetName]§! have established a marketplace for the trade of alien goods. While we are naturally loath to take part in this exchange, the option is available to us.

entries.zh: 在与其前中心失去联络之后，星系商贸团体选择在我们境内设立一座新的空间站。
entries.en: Following loss of contact with their former hub, the galactic merchant community has chosen to establish a new station within our borders.

entries.zh: 通过新的联系，我们已经获得了通过泛星系贸易市场进行资源买卖的权利。这一定会刺激[Root.GetAdj]经济。
entries.en: Through our newly-established contacts, we have gained access to a galactic marketplace for the purchase and sale of resources. This will surely be a great boon to the [Root.GetAdj] economy.

entries.zh: 我们得知恶心的异种们建立了一个交易外星商品的星系市场。尽管我们不愿涉足其中，但市场的大门仍对我们敞开。
entries.en: We have learned of a galactic marketplace for the trade of alien goods, established by the loathsome xenos. While we are naturally reluctant to take part in this exchange, the option is now available to us.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]在[FromFrom.GetName]发现了一种新的战略资源，称为§H$rare_crystals$§!。这些水晶优异的衍射特性使其极为适合用来制作电子元件或是打造激光武器系统。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] has discovered a previously unknown strategic resource on [FromFrom.GetName], dubbed §H$rare_crystals$§!. The crystals lend themselves well to both high-end electronics as well as laser weapons systems, thanks to their spectacular refractive properties.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]在[FromFrom.GetName]发现了一种新的战略资源，称为§H$exotic_gases$§!。这些气体不但可以用来作战甚至还可以作为消遣性毒品使用。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] has discovered a previously unknown strategic resource on [FromFrom.GetName], dubbed §H$exotic_gases$§!. These gases have a number of tactical and even recreational uses.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]在[FromFrom.GetName]发现了一种新的战略资源，称为§H$volatile_motes$§!。这些微尘被化学激活后能够在爆炸中释放出大量动能，据说如果用来做菜的话还会很辣。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] has discovered a previously unknown strategic resource on [FromFrom.GetName], dubbed §H$volatile_motes$§!. These particles produce an explosive amount of kinetic force when chemically activated, and are supposedly very spicy when used in cooking.

entries.zh: 泛星系贸易市场中心提名
基于当地状况，为星球添加§Y基础市场竞争力评分§!修正。评分越高，星球就越有可能被§H泛星系贸易市场§!选中。\n\n最好提名一颗产出许多贸易额的星球，以提高其被选中的可能性。
entries.en: Applies a §YBase Marketplace Competitiveness Rating§! modifier to the planet, according to its local conditions. The better the rating, the more likely the planet will play host to the future §HGalactic Market§!.\n\nIt is best to nominate a planet which produces a lot of trade, as that will make it more likely to be chosen.

entries.zh: 提名这颗星球作为§H泛星系贸易市场§!中心的候选位址。
entries.en: Nominate this planet as a trade hub candidate for the coalescing §HGalactic Market§!.

entries.zh: 成为星系贸易的枢纽可谓名利双收。市场风云莫测，但只要给出足够的津贴，我们或许可以引诱贸易巨头们进驻这颗星球。
entries.en: Being the nexus of galactic trade is a position as prestigious as it is profitable. The market is fickle, but with enough incentives we might be able to lure the big players to establish themselves on this planet.

entries.zh: 有时你不希望成为瞩目的焦点。
entries.en: Sometimes you don't want to be the center of attention.

entries.zh: 采取各种措施，进一步增加星球的§Y基础市场竞争力评分§!。
entries.en: Augment the planet's §YBase Marketplace Competitiveness Rating§! with additional measures.

entries.zh: 降低管理间接费。经济特区。贿赂。
entries.en: Reduced administrative overhead. Special economic zones. Bribes.

entries.zh: 我们失去了[From.GetName]星系内的祝圣之物！\n\n悲痛与沉重的失落笼罩了[Root.GetAdj]的殖民地。不同于一个星球被宣布不再为神所庇佑，这种对心灵依靠的以暴力手段无情践踏否定的行为让[Root.GetName]的信徒们陷入震惊与迷茫。神职人员决定进行五年的哀悼。
entries.en: We have lost access to the objects of worship in the [From.GetName] system!\n\nGrief and a profound sense of loss grips the [Root.GetAdj] colonies. Different from a world being declared unconsecrated, this violent denial of spiritual agency leaves the believers of [Root.GetName] shell-shocked and disoriented. The clergy have decreed a half-decade of mourning.

entries.zh: 这艘废弃的舰船被路过的行商抛弃，漂流在我们的一颗恒星的轨道上，或许里面仍有一些有价值的东西。
entries.en: Left drifting in orbit around one of our stars by a passing caravan, this decommissioned hulk may still contain something of value.

entries.zh: 无论是什么样的力量在将暗物质带往我们的传送门，将其更多的吸引过来应该可以增加暗物质的产出。
entries.en: Whatever the strange force bringing Dark Matter to our portal is, attracting a higher level of it should result in increased production.

entries.zh: 高效的范格利牌可堆叠休眠箱可以降低这个星球的住房需求。
entries.en: Efficient Trium-brand stackable rest enclosures reduce housing needs on this world.

entries.zh: 使用范格利牌食品容器可降低这颗星球上的食物浪费。
entries.en: The use of Trium-brand food storage containers reduce food waste on this world.

entries.zh: 大气层清洗器可使这颗星球的空气如薄荷般清新。
entries.en: Atmospheric scrubbers lend the air on this planet a quality of minty freshness.

entries.zh: 来自范格利集团的销售骨干们正在增加我们所有贸易路线的$r_trade$。
entries.en: A cadre of elite Vengralian Trium sales agents are boosting $r_trade$ across all our trade routes.

entries.zh: 我们正在偿还欠范格利集团的债务。
entries.en: We are paying off a debt to the Vengralian Trium.

entries.zh: 泛星系贸易市场空间站坐落于此。
这颗星球不太适合被祝圣。
entries.en: This is deemed a poor object of worship.
This is deemed a suitable object of worship.

entries.zh: 这是一颗被祝幅的星球。
entries.en: This is deemed a most blessed planet.

entries.zh: 这是一颗完美无瑕的神圣星球。
entries.en: This planet is deemed an immaculate and sacrosanct place.

entries.zh: 这处神圣的土地已按照我们信仰的传统被祝圣，散发着神圣的光辉，坚定着我们族人的精神信念。
entries.en: This sacred place has been consecrated in the traditions of our faith, radiating a holy aura that strengthens the spiritual conviction of our people.

entries.zh: 这个星球被提名作为未来泛星系贸易市场空间站的星球基地。
entries.en: This world has been nominated to serve as the planetary underpinnings of a future centralized Galactic Market station.

entries.zh: 基础市场竞争力评分：§R弱§!
基础市场竞争力评分：§Y中§!
基础市场竞争力评分：§G强§!
增强的市场竞争力评分：§G极强§!
增强的市场竞争力评分：§G完美§!
一个低轨道研究小组正在研究这颗行星上奇怪的海洋。
entries.en: A low-orbit research team is currently studying the strange sea on this planet.

entries.zh: 拉奇工业公司生产的一种奥术工程卫星正在环绕该天体，提升了从天体表面开采能源的可能性。
entries.en: A satellite of arcane engineering created by the Racket Industrial Enterprise hangs in orbit of this astral body, heightening possibilities for energy extraction from its surface.

entries.zh: 这些拉奇工业公司的拉奇牌发电机调节器能够提升我们的科技无人机的兼容性，让它们能够以微秒级的水平进行发电作业。
entries.en: These Racket Industrial Enterprise-brand Generator Regulators help fine-tune the compatibility of our Tech-Drones to Generator District electric grids down to the microsecond.

entries.zh: 一种皮质类固醇与肾上腺素的混合物能够促使幼体更快发育成熟。
entries.en: A gentle blend of corticosteroids and adrenal hormones to help ease the passage of young into adulthood.

entries.zh: 由$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet2$打造，这些磁条将部署在我们行星周围的单位上，让他们与行星磁层同调。这可以使他们的离子排列整齐，降低他们的能源需求。
entries.en: Created by $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet2$, these strips are applied to our planetside units, tuning them to planet's magnetosphere. The process helps align their ions, thereby lowering their energy upkeep needs.

entries.zh: 对远古贸易路线图的解密显示此地的进口贸易比最初预想的更加繁荣。
entries.en: The deciphering of ancient trade route charts have revealed this place to be of greater mercantile import than first assumed.

entries.zh: 窃取银河之星光芒的邪恶盗贼
entries.en: Wicked Thieves of the Galatron's Light

entries.zh: 沐浴在银河之星的光芒之下是每一个智慧生命的权利。那些闭关锁国的文明不配成为银河之星的管理者。
entries.en: To bathe in the glory of the Galatron is the right of all sapient beings. A civilization that would close its borders to others is not a fit steward of the Galatron.

entries.zh: 发动战争的目的是为了关闭那些大公司在我们星球上的分部并征收他们的财产。
entries.en: War is waged to close down the corporation's branch offices and expropriate their properties on our planets.

entries.zh: 关闭位于§Y[Root.GetName]§!境内所有属于§Y[From.GetName]§!（及其盟友）的分部。\n每关闭一个分部，§Y[From.GetName]§!（及其盟友）获得§Y$trade_with_icon$§!§G1000§!。
entries.en: All Branch Offices owned by the §Y[From.GetName]§! in the §Y[Root.GetName]§! (and their allies) are closed.\n§Y[From.GetName]§! (and their allies) receives §Y$trade_with_icon$§! §G1000§! for each closed Branch Office.

§Y[Root.GetName]§! takes control of the planetary Branch Office\n

entries.zh: 关闭位于§Y[Root.GetName]§!境内所有属于§Y[From.GetName]§!（其盟友和附属国）的分部。\n每关闭一个分部§Y[From.GetName]§!将收到§Y$trade_with_icon$§!§G1000§!。
entries.en: All Branch Offices owned by the §Y[From.GetName]§! in the §Y[Root.GetName]§! (their allies and subjects) are closed.\n§Y[From.GetName]§! receives §Y$trade_with_icon$§! §G1000§! for each closed Branch Office.

entries.zh: 关闭位于§Y[Root.GetName]§!境内所有属于§Y[From.GetName]§!（及其盟友和附属国）的分部。\n每关闭一个分部，§Y[Root.GetName]§!将收到§Y$trade_with_icon$§!§G1000§!。
entries.en: All Branch Offices owned by the §Y[From.GetName]§! in the §Y[Root.GetName]§! (and their allies and subjects) are closed.\n§Y[Root.GetName]§! (and their allies and subjects) receives §Y$trade_with_icon$§! §G1000§! for each closed Branch Office.

entries.zh: 泛星系贸易市场的成立
国际贸易论坛即将成立，而其中央贸易空间站的控制者必将从中获益。[GetMarketFoundingChainEnd]
entries.en: The establishment of an international commercial forum is nigh, and whoever controls the centralized exchange station stands to benefit.[GetMarketFoundingChainEnd]

entries.zh: \n\n如果我们希望竞争市场东道主的头衔，可以在几年的时间里使用§H决议§!来提名我们的一个星球主持$galactic_market_station$。
entries.en: \n\nShould we desire to compete for the title of market host, we have a few years to use §HDecisions§! to nominate one of our worlds to tether the $galactic_market_station$.

entries.zh: \n\n我们没有星球可以作为$galactic_market_station$的锚地，因此我们无法承担东道主之责。但无论该空间站选址何处，我们都可自由参与贸易。
entries.en: \n\nOur people have no world to offer as the $galactic_market_station$'s anchor, and so we cannot compete for the role of market host. We may yet trade freely through whichever port the station calls home.

entries.zh: 拥有银河之星是我国崛起之路中至高无上的目标。除非银河之星被从那些不值当的附属品中解放出来并以其永恒长存庇佑我们的国家，我们永远不会停手。
entries.en: Possession of the Galatron is paramount to our ascendance. We will not rest until the Galatron blesses our empire with its eternal presence, liberated from less worthy appendages.

[Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]被选中来将我们的£energy£ §Y能量币§!盈余提升到至少£energy£ §Y+20§!/月。

entries.zh: 根据我们[Root.GetRulerTitle]的承诺，我们的资源产出得到了提升。
entries.en: As per our [Root.GetRulerTitle]'s mandate, our resource production has improved.

entries.zh: 根据我们[Root.GetRulerTitle]的承诺，我们的行星区划得到了扩张。
entries.en: As per our [Root.GetRulerTitle]'s mandate, our planetary districts have expanded.

entries.zh: 在这个社会的看来，一切都是商品。所有人都有个价钱，所有东西都可以卖掉。包括垃圾。尤其是垃圾。
entries.en: In the view of this society, everything is an object. Everyone can be bought, and everything can be sold. Including garbage. Especially garbage.

entries.zh: 对于如何拦截来去如飞的行商舰队，这位领袖有着丰富的经验。
entries.en: This leader has ample experience stopping the flighty Caravaneer fleets dead in their tracks.

entries.zh: 这位领袖减少和回收工业废物的能力简直不可思议。到底是怎么办到的？最好别问。
entries.en: This leader has an almost uncanny ability to reduce and repurpose industrial waste. How do they do it? It's best not to ask.

entries.zh: 泛星系贸易市场空间站
虽然名义上无组织且不受星系政治影响，但泛星系贸易市场的许多管理部门都集中于此空间站内。
entries.en: While nominally amorphous and independent of galactic politics, many of the administrative functions of the Galactic Market are physically located in this station.

entries.zh: $COUNTRY|Y$寰宇企业在$PLANET|Y$开设了新的分部。
entries.en: The $COUNTRY|Y$ Megacorporation has established a new Branch Office on $PLANET|Y$.

entries.zh: $COUNTRY|Y$寰宇企业关闭了位于$PLANET|Y$的分部。
entries.en: The $COUNTRY|Y$ Megacorporation has closed down their Branch Office on $PLANET|Y$.

entries.zh: 我们失去了对§Y$SYSTEM$§!星系中的§H泛星系贸易市场空间站§!的控制！
entries.en: We have lost control of the §HGalactic Market Station§! in the §Y$SYSTEM$§! system!

entries.zh: §E银河之星§!脉动着微弱的光芒，这光芒为我们的储蓄增加了£energy£ §G1000§!。
entries.en: The gentle light of the §EGalatron§! pulses to reveal £energy£ §G1000§! added to our stockpiles.

entries.en: The gentle light of the §EGalatron§! pulses to reveal £consumer_goods£ §G800§! added to our stockpiles.

entries.en: The gentle light of the §EGalatron§! pulses to reveal £influence£ §G500§! added to our stockpiles.

entries.en: The gentle light of the §EGalatron§! pulses to reveal £society£ §G1000§! added to our stockpiles.
