entries.en: The gentle light of the §EGalatron§! pulses to reveal £engineering£ §G1000§! added to our stockpiles.

entries.zh: §E银河之星§!脉动着微弱的光芒，这光芒为我们的$NAVY_SIZE_TITLE$永久增加了§G+10§!。
entries.en: The gentle light of the §EGalatron§! pulses to reveal a permanent §G+10§! boost to our $NAVY_SIZE_TITLE$.

entries.zh: 创始物种在奴隶市场上售卖
有属于我们创始物种$SPECIES|H$的人口正在§H奴隶市场§!上待售。
entries.en: Pops of our founder species $SPECIES|H$ are up for sale on the §HSlave Market§!.

entries.zh: 我们§H$SPECIES$§!在奴隶市场上被卖掉了。\n\n最终价格：$PRICE$
entries.en: Our §H$SPECIES$§! were sold on the Slave Market.\n\nFinal price: $PRICE$

entries.zh: 星球的一站式回收中心，可将工业和生物废物转换成可重新利用的清洁能源和矿物。它由$NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$设计，其构造很神秘，而且大部分无法逆向工程。
entries.en: A planet's one stop center for converting industrial and bio-waste into mostly clean, mostly reusable energy and minerals. Designed by the $NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3$, its construction is somewhat arcane, and largely non-reverse- engineerable.

entries.zh: 你是否要提议[Root.GetName]成为你的子公司？
entries.en: Are you proposing that the [Root.GetName] becomes your subsidiary?

entries.zh: 作为您的子公司，[Root.GetName]将向您上供其部分贸易额。作为交换，我们期望你捍卫[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的生命，自由和独立。
entries.en: As your subsidiary, the [Root.GetName] will share some of its trade with you. In exchange we expect you to defend the defend the life, liberty and independence of the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]无论什么情况下都不愿意成为[From.GetSpeciesAdj]剥削对象。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] will under no circumstances be a willing subject to [From.GetSpeciesAdj] exploitation.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]需要军事保护。请让我们成为[From.GetAdj]的子公司，作为您忠诚的下属，我们将会在我们的贸易中为您提供分成。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] is in need of military protection. Make us a subsidiary under [From.GetAdj] rule and we, as your loyal subject, will offer you a substantial portion of our trade.

entries.zh: 啊，是[From.GetName]啊。让我猜猜，是有什么生意要来谈吗？
entries.en: Ah, [From.GetName]. Let me guess, you have a special offer just for us?

entries.zh: 啊，这不是[From.GetName]嘛。你今天打算来干嘛？准备说什么谎言，骗取什么东西，还是准备给我们开些空头支票？
entries.en: Ah, if it isn't [From.GetName]. What have you come to offer us today? What lies, what scams, what empty promises?

entries.zh: 啊，是你啊……你愿意“自己动手”挪个地吗？
entries.en: Oh, it's you... Would you mind "self-actualizing" somewhere else?

entries.zh: [From.GetName]，资本主义不过是通往无阶级社会的垫脚石罢了。
entries.en: Capitalism is but a stepping stone on the path to a classless society, [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 你好，[From.GetName]！我们的翻译系统似乎出了点小问题。你刚刚是说要来摸一摸我们的基地？
entries.en: Well met, [From.GetName]! It seems our translation modules are having a slight hiccup. Are you saying you would like to touch our base?

entries.zh: 你好啊，[From.GetName]。我们希望你能够注意到[Root.GetAdj]市场的潜力。
entries.en: Greetings, [From.GetName]. We hope you recognize the potential in the [Root.GetAdj] market.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]，我们看到了你最近的广告，无话可说，收下我的钱吧！
entries.en: We saw your latest advertisement campaign and what can we say, just take our money, [From.GetName]!

entries.zh: [From.GetName]，今天真是个做生意的好日子啊，对吗？能量币，能量币，能量币……如同音乐般动听。
entries.en: A good day for business, is it not, [From.GetName]? Credits, credits, credits... Like music to our ears.

entries.zh: 你好啊，[From.GetName]！最近生意怎么样，有没有收到什么好消息，口袋子有没有变得更鼓啊？
entries.en: Hello there, [From.GetName]! How goes the bar raising, the envelope pushing, the number crunching?

entries.zh: [From.GetName]，我们对你的清仓甩卖很感兴趣。你的一些行星让我很感兴趣……
entries.en: We are very excited for your clearance sale, [From.GetName]. Some of your planetary bodies have garnered our interest...

entries.zh: [From.GetName]，对我们而言，中断你们的未来是我们当下的任务……
entries.en: Cutting your future short is our present, [From.GetName]...

entries.zh: [From.GetName]，起锚吧，因为[Root.GetName]100%会与你一道同行！
entries.en: Anchors aweigh, [From.GetName], because the [Root.GetName] is 100% on board with you!

entries.zh: [From.GetName]，最近我们感觉你在偷偷摸摸利用我们获得能量币……
entries.en: Lately we've had a sneaking suspicion that you are using us for credits, [From.GetName]...

entries.zh: [From.GetName]，有些东西是用钱买不到的，好好看，好好学。
entries.en: There are some things credits cannot buy, [From.GetName]. Watch and learn.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]对于所有智慧生物来说都是威胁。在我们的星系道德沦丧之前必须清除你这些庸脂俗粉。
entries.en: [Root.GetName] is a threat to all sapient life. The galaxy must be purged of your tawdry wares before it succumbs to complete moral decline.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]不会再容忍你卑鄙的行径，同时也不会允许你再剥削星系中的共有资源。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] will no longer stand for your underhanded practices and unconscionable exploitation of common galactic assets.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的出现就是对品味的冒犯。我们无法容忍你再出现在星系之中。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] brand is an affront to good taste. We can no longer tolerate your presence in the galaxy.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]，让我们打开天窗说亮话，这个星系再也不需要你们的“服务”了……
entries.en: Let it be known that the galaxy has no further need for your "services", [Root.GetName]...

entries.zh: [From.GetName]，那是什么？我们刚研究了你们最近的市场活动！你们这是要上天啊！
entries.en: What was that, [From.GetName]? We were just poring over your latest marketing campaign! It's gone viral!

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，快把话说明白了。如果说你就打算这么在[From.GetName]做生意，那我们根本就不感兴趣。
entries.en: Explain yourselves, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. If this is how you do business at [From.GetName] we're not interested.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]，坦白说。我们已经受够了你们那平庸的企业。
entries.en: Speak plainly, [From.GetName]. We've had enough of your corporate obscurities.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]，这星系不是你乱丢垃圾的地方。把你们那些自称为商品的垃圾自己留着吧。
entries.en: The galaxy is not your personal garbage disposal unit, [Root.GetName]. Keep your so-called products to yourselves.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的商品……从货架直接丢到垃圾桶就好了……
entries.en: [Root.GetName] products... Straight from the bargain bin to the garbage bin...

entries.zh: 你的存在就是资本主义最基本缺陷的最好证明。能量币并不能给你带来地位，[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: You are an embodiment of the capitalist system's most fundamental shortcoming. Credits cannot buy you class, [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 哈！有意思。反正朋友之间互相开开玩笑也无所谓对吗？
entries.en: Ha! That's a good one. What's a little light-hearted banter between friends, eh?

entries.zh: 啊，你的口才是真的很棒！我们都被你逗得不行。好了，言归正传，该谈生意了……
entries.en: Ah, you pen-pushers are a real hoot! You really know how to tickle our giggly bone. Now, if we could return to business...

entries.zh: [From.GetName]里全部都是骗子和企业间谍！要不了多久[Root.GetName]就会像全世界曝光你们的真面目。
entries.en: [From.GetName] is run by swindlers and corporate hacks! Soon the [Root.GetName] will expose your true face to the world.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]你的商业策略真是奇怪……居然和你未来的客户们为敌……
entries.en: That's an interesting business strategy you've got, [From.GetName]... Antagonizing your future clients...

entries.zh: [From.GetName]，你的无耻将会让你付出惨重的代价。我们走着瞧。
entries.en: Your cheek will cost you, [From.GetName]. We hope it was worth it.

entries.zh: 你很快就会明白，有一种东西叫做，严峻的公共关系。
entries.en: You will soon learn that there is, in fact, such a thing as bad PR.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你们真的能够承担失去我们这单生意的后果吗？
entries.en: Can you really afford to lose our business, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?

entries.zh: [From.GetName]，赶快从我面前消失。[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]根本不需要你们这些杂牌垃圾。
entries.en: Take your business elsewhere, [From.GetName]. The [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have no need for your off-brand refuse.

entries.zh: 走吧，我们没什么好谈的，[From.GetName]。
entries.en: There is no marketplace need for the likes of you, [From.GetName].

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，这只是作为一个商家对另一个商家的友好建议……如果你行动合理将会获得财源广进的未来，否则你会迅速一穷二白。
entries.en: Some friendly advice from one business to another... You would do well to start future-proofing. Or you will soon be obsolete, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
The [Root.GetName] is not open for business, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
The [Root.GetName] has nothing to offer you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: [From.GetName]，您正当的公司名字却烂透了。
entries.en: You give honest corporations a bad name, [From.GetName].

entries.zh: [Root.GetAdj]秘密酱汁吸引着所有的外星人。我们可以教你，但我们得收钱……
entries.en: The [Root.GetAdj] secret sauce brings all the aliens to the yard. We could teach you, but we'd have to charge...

entries.zh: 欢迎来到[Root.GetName]，您的智慧资本最有可能实现的地方。请问有什么可以效劳的？
entries.en: Welcome to [Root.GetName], your number one, on-demand actualizer of intellectual capital. How can we help you?

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！想要体验一次我们办公室波波池的虚拟漫游吗？
entries.en: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Would you like a virtual tour of the office ball pit?

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，世间的一切好东西都不是免费的。但是在[Root.GetName]，它们都很便宜。
entries.en: None of the best things in life are free, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. But here at [Root.GetName], they're cheap.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]，你最近的市场策略反响不错啊！我们很能产生共鸣。
entries.en: Good going on your latest marketing campaign, [From.GetName]! It really resonated with us.

entries.zh: 天下丰沛，地广物博；各取其半，两不相干。如若以武犯境，勿谓言之不预。
entries.en: The world is vast and full of exploitable riches. Surely there is enough for both of us?

entries.zh: 啊，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。看上去似乎是一个很不错的合作对象。
entries.en: Ah, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Prospects are looking good for a future joint venture.
How's it hanging, [From.GetName]? Business as usual?

entries.zh: 我代表我们的质保部门感谢你，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，毕竟你为我们提供了期待已久的测试武器的机会。
entries.en: On behalf of our quality assurance department we thank you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], for this long awaited opportunity to test our latest line of weaponry.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们的新船设计如何？品相完美，送货上门。我们[Root.GetName]竭诚为您服务。
entries.en: How do you like our new ship designs, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? Megatons of chrome perfection, delivered straight to your door. At [Root.GetName] we always go the extra mile!

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]是全星系领先的革命性防务装备开发者及生产商。您很快就会发现，我们对质量的承诺所言非虚。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] is the galaxy's leading constructor and developer of revolutionary defense hardware. As you will soon find, our commitment to quality is absolute.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]，我们奔着你们的市场份额而来。等我们完事了，没人会再记得你们。全星系的人们只会为了[Root.GetAdj]产品尖叫！
entries.en: We're coming for your market shares, [From.GetName]. And when we're through, your name will be forgotten. The galaxy will be screaming only for [Root.GetAdj] product!.

entries.zh: 我们会让你扫地关门的，[From.GetName]。
entries.en: We will put you out of business, [From.GetName].

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！我们刚刚通过D.O.R.P标准对你们的表现进行了评估，我们很高兴的宣布：你们已经§G达成指标§!！！请再接再厉！
entries.en: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We were just now evaluating your performance based on the D.O.R.P scale, and are pleased to announce that you §Gmeet expectations§!!! Keep up the good work!

entries.zh: 不要问你能为你的公司做些什么，而是公司能为你做些什么，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们在此赋予您这样的权力。
entries.en: Ask not what you can do for your holding company, but what your holding company can do for you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We are here to empower YOU.

entries.zh: 我们是渴求知识的学生，未来的希望，充满了无限的活力！而你则是备受尊重的导师，是领袖，是过去的余音……
entries.en: We, the eager student, the hope of the future, full of untapped potential! You, the revered mentor - the guru, the voice of generations past...

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你看了我们的季度收益报告表吗？预测下一季度它会一飞冲天，步步高升!
entries.en: Did you see our quarterly earnings report, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? Projections for the next quarter are skyrocketing. Up and to the right!

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你在耍什么把戏？[From.GetName]可是最优秀的吸金公司之一。你到底打算拿什么来和我们谈？
entries.en: What's your game plan, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? The [From.GetName] is a top of the line, resource-maximizing machine. What exactly are you bringing to the table?

entries.zh: 我们掌控了市场，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。学着我们你也可以做得很好。
entries.en: We dominate the market, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. You would do well to take a page out of our book.

entries.zh: 啊，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]……你还在这啊！或许我们的舰队可以促使你们走向……黄泉？
entries.en: Ah, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]... You're still here! Maybe our fleet can incentivize you to...die?
Nothing drives development forward like a little friendly competition.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你可别往心里去。这些都是生意罢了。
entries.en: Don't take it personally, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. It's just business.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！作为我们的控股公司，我们再次评估了你们的不足之处，我们在你的防御体系里面发现了一个漏洞……
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! As we once again evaluated your inadequacy as our holding company we discovered a hole in your defenses...

entries.zh: 要是你准备和[From.GetName]开战的话，那么就准备好一次彻头彻尾的全面战争吧！我们要么回家，要么干一场大的。
entries.en: If it is war you want the [From.GetName] will give you plenty of bang for your buck. We go big or go home!
Prepare to have your assets liquidated, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 尊贵的客人！在[From.GetName]无论什么要求都可以接受。我们能够提供以用户为主的专门客制化体验。舰队准备！
entries.en: Valued clients! Here at [From.GetName] no request is too big. We bring custom-made, user friendly solutions to all our clients. Ready the fleet!

entries.zh: 尊贵的客人！我们正在尽全力评估你的请求。
entries.en: Valued client! We are doing our utmost to evaluate your request.

entries.zh: 尊贵的客人！在我们评估你们的要求的同时，是否能够花费一点时间来填一下我们的信托调查？只需要几分钟就可以了！你的意见对我们来说很宝贵！
entries.en: Valued client! As we evaluate your proposition, would you care to fill out our trust survey? It will only take a minute of your time! Your opinion matters!

entries.zh: 我们是不是应该把现在的这个设备淘汰了换一个有保障的好东西？
entries.en: Shall we replace this costly exchange of lost hardware and lives for one of goods and services?

entries.zh: 到头来，我们发现战争并不能解决预算赤字。我们提议无限期休战。
entries.en: As it turns out, war was not the answer to our budget deficit. We propose an indefinite truce.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，继续打下去对我们双方都没什么好处，为什么要把钱白白浪费掉呢？
entries.en: It is clear that none of us stands to gain from a continued conflict. Why throw good money after bad, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?

entries.zh: 这场冲突已经超越了其本身该有的目的，我们已经搜集到了足以证明我们产品的优势的全部数据。现在是时候回归和平了。
entries.en: This conflict has outlived its purpose. We have garnered all the data we need to demonstrate the superiority of our product. We would like to negotiate for peace.

entries.zh: 这场战争目前已经进入了双输的局面，这和我们所求相悖。我们现在想要打算根据季度总结协商一下缔结长期停战协议的事宜。
entries.en: This war has turned into more of a lose-lose situation than we had bargained for. We propose to table the issue for an indefinite period, subject to quarterly reviews.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，目前的战势对你方有利。但只有在和平之下我们才能繁荣发展。
entries.en: The numbers speak in your favor, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. In peace there is prosperity.

entries.zh: 和平？呵！想都别想。把那个红色按钮给我拿来！
entries.en: Peace? Hah! I think not. Gimme' that big old red button!

entries.zh: 和平……别傻了。我们这只是刚刚热了身。
entries.en: Peace schmeaze... Don't be such a stiff. We were just warming up.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesName]，很抱歉不能接受你的协议。这场战争对于我们来说大有可图。
entries.en: Regrettably we cannot agree to your terms, [From.GetSpeciesName]. This war has proven much too lucrative.

entries.zh: 抱歉，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们还没完成对你们孱弱的军队完全占优。
entries.en: Sorry, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We are not yet done taking advantage of your military inferiority.

entries.zh: 你们这些反动派阻挡不了[Root.GetName]！
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] will not be held back by a nation of reactionaries.

entries.zh: 在这一场经济浪潮之中，我们无法保证您的独立性。你们将会因你们的无能在重压下崩溃。
entries.en: We cannot grant you independence in this financial climate. You would crumble under the burden of your own incompetence.

entries.zh: 和平？那我们就得好好来算算经济意义了。
entries.en: Peace? We will have to weigh the financial implications closely.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]你这次准备好全力以赴了吗？§Y[From.GetName]§!像原来那样可不行啊……
entries.en: Are you ready to bring your A-game [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? The §Y[From.GetName]§! doesn't roll with yesterday's news...

entries.zh: [Root.GetAdj]的牌子因为其品质而响当当！加入我们，你也可以从这个好名声中受益。
entries.en: The [Root.GetAdj] brand is renowned for its quality! Joining us would allow you to benefit from that credibility.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]！我们联手一定可以一骑绝尘，垄断市场。现在就看你了。
entries.en: [From.GetName]! Together we could thwart the competition, inflate prices and dominate the market. What say you?

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesAdj]-[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]联盟的模拟收益看起来很不错，[From.GetRulerName]，或者我应该喊你为伙伴？我们加入！
entries.en: Simulated revenue projections from a [From.GetSpeciesAdj]-[Root.GetSpeciesAdj] joint venture are looking good, [From.GetRulerName], or shall I say, partner? We are in!

entries.zh: [Root.GetAdj]就是高级品质的代名词。我们不能让[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]坏了我们的名声。
entries.en: The [Root.GetAdj] brand is synonymous with premium quality. We could not risk affiliation with the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你有多大本事啊？你的本事足不足够让你加入§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!啊？
entries.en: How many balls can you keep in the air, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? Do you have what it takes to join §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!?

entries.zh: 灵活快速，用户至上的解决方案和收益最大化只不过是[From.GetName]能够带给§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!的一小部分罢了……你这是答应了？我确实听到你答应了……
entries.en: Agile, user-centered solutions and result maximization are just some of the many things the [From.GetName] could bring to the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!. Is that a yes? I definitely heard a yes...

entries.zh: 恭喜你，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！你现在进入了一个大联盟。欢迎加入§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!。
entries.en: Congratulations, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! You're in the big league now. Welcome to the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!.

entries.zh: 我们将你们的经济情况用G-WACK柱进行了一次评估，很抱歉告诉你们，你们当前想要成为§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!一员的要求未被审核通过。请下次继续努力。
entries.en: We have appraised your financials based on the G-WACK pillars and sadly you do not qualify for §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§! membership. Please do not be afraid to try harder next time.

entries.zh: 我们已经收到你们的申请，说实话，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]和[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]真的是完全不在同一水平线上。你能听懂我在说什么吗？
entries.en: We have reviewed your application and if we can speak frankly, the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] just aren't singing from the same sheet. If you catch our drift?

entries.zh: 如果你们选择离开§Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!，那么我们将会对你们施加制裁。
entries.en: If you leave the §Y[From.GetAllianceName]§! we may have to impose sanctions against you.

entries.zh: 由于未达成目标财富增长，根据合约我们打算终结[From.GetName]与§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!之间的同盟协议。如果有任何问题，请和我们的法律顾问谈判。
entries.en: As per agreement we wish to terminate the partnership between [From.GetName] and §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§! on grounds of unfulfilled profit increase. Please refer any complaints to our legal counsel.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]你这是跳下了一艘坚实强大的巨轮，坚实强大的巨轮！
entries.en: You're jumping a mighty fine ship, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], a mighty fine ship!

entries.zh: 如果说你加入§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!是为了看到自己的经济体系毁于一旦的话，那我们不会拦你的，伙伴……
entries.en: If financial ruin is what you are after the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§! won't stand in your way... partner...

entries.zh: 请确认你想要[Root.GetName]臣服的意图。
entries.en: Please confirm your intention to subjugate the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: [Root.GetAdj]的董事会投票支持[Root.GetName]成为[From.GetName]的附属国。
entries.en: The [Root.GetAdj] board has voted in favor of the [Root.GetName] becoming a subject state to the [From.GetName].

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]不会成为某个下级代理商的附属。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] will not become a subject to an inferior agent.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]需要一个军方赞助商保护其发展不受敌对竞争对手干扰。作为交换，[From.GetName]将会成为你的附庸国。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] is in need of a military sponsor to defend us from hostile competitors. In exchange for your protection the [From.GetName] will become your vassal state.

entries.zh: 请确认你要成为[Root.GetName]附庸的请求。
entries.en: Please confirm your request to subsidiarize the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 你的军事力量不足将会让你的敌人有可乘之机。成为[From.GetName]的一员，那样作为你的控股公司，我们将会保证你们人民的自由。
entries.en: Your military insufficiency has put you at risk of hostile takeover. Become a supplement of the [From.GetName] and we, as your holding company, will ensure the liberty of your people.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们为你们准备了一个特别的提案。成为[From.GetName]的子公司并且参加我们的10步就能自我发展计划。让我们的舰队成为你们信心的来源。
entries.en: We have a special offer for you, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Become a subsidiary of the [From.GetName] and partake in our 10 step self-development program, free of charge. Allow OUR fleet to boost YOUR confidence.

entries.zh: 作为你的子公司，[Root.GetName]以及其一切相关的品牌现在都将合法地成为[From.GetName]母公司的一部分。作为回报，[From.GetName]将保护[Root.GetName]不受敌人的干扰。
entries.en: As your subsidiary, the [Root.GetName] and all its associated brands are now legally a part of the [From.GetName] parent company. In return, the [From.GetName] is required to protect the [Root.GetName] from hostile interference.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]认为你们的条款不可接受，并且无论什么情况下都不愿意成为[From.GetSpeciesAdj]剥削的对象。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] finds your terms unacceptable and will under no circumstances be subject to [From.GetSpeciesAdj] exploitation.

entries.zh: 如果我们继续的话，[From.GetName]会成为[Root.GetName]的附庸。作为你的母公司[Root.GetName]将和[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]患难与共，面对共同威胁。
entries.en: Should we proceed, the [Root.GetName] will subsidiarize the [From.GetName]. As your parent company the [Root.GetName] will stand united with the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] against mutual threats.

entries.zh: [Root.GetRulerName]作为一个上下一心的组织想要向[From.GetSpeciesAdj]学习。让[From.GetName]成为子公司，我们将与你们分享一部分我们的贸易。
entries.en: [Root.GetRulerName] runs a tight ship and we want to learn the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] way. Make the [From.GetName] a subsidiary and we will share some of our trade with you.

entries.zh: 欢迎来到[From.GetAdj]公司大家庭。尽管目前[Root.GetName]作为一个独立的合法公司运营，[From.GetName]目前对控制你的公司很有兴趣，并且愿意与你共同面对敌对威胁，保障我们的共同利益。
entries.en: Welcome to the [From.GetAdj] corporate family. While the [Root.GetName] still operates as a distinct legal entity, the [From.GetName] now holds a controlling interest in your company and will protect our joint interests from hostile threats.

entries.zh: 好消息，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你现在成为我们的经济奴隶了……
entries.en: Good news, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. You are now our financial slave...

entries.zh: 很抱歉我们目前无法接受你们成为子公司的申请。希望你们未来能够继续努力，你们确实需要努力。
entries.en: Regretfully we cannot accept your application for subsidiarization at this time. We wish you good luck in your future endeavors, as you will surely need it.

entries.zh: 请问您是否愿意放弃控制[Root.GetName]，让[Root.GetAdj]重新自治？
entries.en: Do you wish to revoke your status as holding company of the [Root.GetName] and reinstate [Root.GetAdj] autonomy?

entries.zh: 在此，[From.GetName]放弃其对[Root.GetName]控制权，归还其自治权，立即生效。
entries.en: Hereby the [From.GetName] rescinds its ownership of the [Root.GetName] returning it to autonomy, effective immediately.

entries.zh: 我们会好好珍惜这来之不易的独立的。
entries.en: We will treasure our newly won independence.

entries.zh: 先说好了，[Root.GetName]将会采取合法措施保障其利益。
entries.en: Be advised, the [Root.GetName] will take legal action to protect its interests.

entries.zh: 在多次未履行[From.GetSpeciesAdj]的要求之后，[From.GetName]希望你们能够立刻撤销子公司地位，否则将诉诸法庭。
entries.en: Following repeated failure to comply with [From.GetSpeciesAdj] requirements, the [From.GetName] recommends that you revoke our subject status immediately or seek legal counsel.

entries.zh: 在此，[Root.GetName]保证[From.GetName]的独立性，放弃对[From.GetSpeciesAdj]财政的一切掌控。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] hereby grants the [From.GetName] independence, forsaking all legal claims to [From.GetSpeciesAdj] financials.

entries.zh: 很抱歉通知你们在可预见的未来[Root.GetName]并不打算恢复[From.GetSpeciesAdj]的自治。有任何问题请与我们的法务部门联系。
entries.en: We regret to inform you that the [Root.GetName] has no intent of reinstating [From.GetSpeciesAdj] autonomy within a foreseeable future. Please refer any complaints to our legal department.

entries.zh: 虽然我们不断提升我们代理人的能力，但是我们建议你们还是选择追求一些比较现实的发展目标。
entries.en: Though we always strive to empower our agents, we advise you to pursue more realistic development goals.

entries.zh: 请确认你们成为[Root.GetName]保护者的提议。你们所签署的协议具有法律效力。
entries.en: Please confirm your offer to become a protector of the [Root.GetName]. The agreement, should you sign, is legally binding.

entries.zh: 好了呆子们，让我们的敌人颤抖吧，把你们的技术全部传授给我们，接下来就看我们的市场部门如何点石成金吧。你们将会获得你们梦寐以求的名号。整个星系都会知道你们的名字！
entries.en: All right nerds, make our enemies go boom and teach us all your science stuff and our marketing department will work its magic. You will have the "it" factor you so badly crave. The galaxy will know your name!

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们自己有强大的舰队，如果有人胆敢侵犯我们的合法利益，我们将毫不犹豫地对他们使用舰队。
entries.en: We have a capable fleet of our own, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and we will not hesitate to use it against those who would impinge upon that which is lawfully ours.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]是一个商业集团，不是什么军事巨头。如今我们的竞争对手拿起武器来对抗我们，我们不得已来找到你，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你会保护我们吗？
entries.en: The [From.GetName] is a business conglomerate, not a military power. As our competitors take up arms against us, we find ourselves at the mercy of your good will, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Will you protect us?

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你想让我们上贡吗？说一个数字吧，我们会考虑的……
entries.en: You want tribute, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? Give us a number and we'll think about it...

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们无法承受不能与你达成生意的损失。毕竟对于和平而言，贡品那点不过是蝇头小利。
entries.en: We can ill afford to lose your business, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. In the grand scheme of things, tribute is a small price to pay for peace.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，朋友之间哪有什么算计可言？[Root.GetName]将会很乐意呈上贡品。友情可是无价的……
entries.en: Ah, what is a little extortion between friends, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? The [Root.GetName] will gladly pay tribute. You cannot put a price on friendship...

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]将不会接受[From.GetAdj]的敲诈。法律可是站在我们这边的。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] will not give in to [From.GetAdj] extortion. We have the law on our side.

entries.zh: 为了保持[From.GetName]与[Root.GetName]之间的和平，我们愿意每月向你们上贡。
entries.en: In the interest of promoting a continued peace between the [From.GetName] and the [Root.GetName], we are willing to pay you monthly tribute.

entries.zh: 一桩生意的后面是更大更好的生意，我们将要提出的交易保证会让[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的每一个器官都发出同意的赞叹。
entries.en: From one business to another, we have an offer that will make your [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] sensory organs sing.

entries.zh: 尊敬的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们有一笔生意想与你们谈一谈……
entries.en: Esteemed [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We have a business proposal...

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，这就是你的最终报价了嘛？要不再加点矿石什么的？不答应？那好，成交吧！
entries.en: Is that your final offer, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? How about some extra minerals to sweeten the deal? No? We'll take it!

entries.zh: 一切为了我们最尊贵的客户。别忘了谁给你们带来了最棒的交易，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！是[Root.GetName]哒！
entries.en: Anything for our most valued customers. Never forget who brings you the best deals, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! The [Root.GetName]!

entries.zh: 成交！[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，和你做生意真是太棒了。
entries.en: It's a deal! It's always a pleasure doing business with you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你看上去有点紧张。你以为[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是三岁小孩吗？
entries.en: You have some nerve, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. You think the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] were born yesterday?

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是在故意搞笑吗？[Root.GetName]谈的是生意，不是慈善……
entries.en: Is that meant to be funny [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? The [Root.GetName] is a business, not a charity...

entries.zh: 谢谢你，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。愿财富在你的世界流转。
entries.en: Thank you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. May business on your worlds prosper.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你打算购买我们的爱吗？我们来谈谈吧。
entries.en: Are you looking to buy our love, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? Let us bargain.

entries.zh: 有意思。[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]打算寻找生意伙伴？再说多点……
entries.en: How intriguing. The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are looking for a business partner? Tell us more...

entries.zh: 你可曾觉得你的生活尽是些你不得不做的而不是你想要做的吗，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？在[From.GetName]这儿，我们存在的意义就是完成那些你不愿做的事情，因此你也不必做这些事。与我们签订商业合约，让你的存在更加有意义！
entries.en: Ever feel like your life is all about the have-tos and never about the want-tos, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? Here at [From.GetName] we live for doing the things you don't want to, so you don't have to. Enter a commercial pact with us and maximize the meaningfulness of your existence!

entries.zh: 在[From.GetName]这儿，我们一直坚持以多换少，今天我们有一个你无法拒绝的交易。一个商业协议……我俩之间的！怎么样，无法拒绝吧！
entries.en: Here at [From.GetName] we consistently deliver more for less, and today we would like to offer you a deal you simply cannot refuse. A commercial pact... with us! Tell us you can't refuse!

entries.zh: 我们之间的自由贸易？嗯……这似乎很有前途。我们答应了，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: Free trade between our worlds? Yes... It's quite a vision. We agree to your terms, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 商业协议？这听起来似乎是个双赢啊，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们会着手起草必要文件。
entries.en: A commercial pact? Sounds like a win-win, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We will draw up the necessary paperwork.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们已收到你们的请求，但是很抱歉[From.GetName]暂时不打算在新的星球扩张生意范围。
entries.en: We have reviewed your offer, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and sadly the [From.GetName] is not currently looking to expand its business to new worlds.

entries.zh: 但是……我们的经济怎么办？
很抱歉，不得不说我们双方的商业协议已经背离了原来的目的，我在此宣布此协议终止。
entries.en: Regrettably the commercial agreement between us has outlived its purpose and we hereby declare it void.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesName]，你的孤立政策已经严重影响到了我们双方的经济增长了。
entries.en: Your isolationist policies have weakened both our economies, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult]，把你的钱都放在[From.GetSpeciesMouthName]那里吧。哦，对了，你没钱……
entries.en: Put your money where your [From.GetSpeciesMouthName] is, [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult]. Oh wait, that's right, you don't have any money...

entries.zh: 看来我们财政上的成功原来是以你们的友情为代价的吗……
entries.en: It would seem our financial success has come at the price of your friendship...

entries.zh: 这对[From.GetSpeciesOrganName]是一次沉重的打击……
[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，很抱歉看到我们的成功居然让我们渐行渐远。
entries.en: We are sorry to see that our recent success has come between us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]，你们的想法果然和那些井底之蛙一样。
entries.en: Just what you would expect from an inside-the-box thinking nation of backward [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult].

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你的嫉妒会让你付出代价的。
蠢货，你这么做对你的市价毫无帮助。
entries.en: You just lowered your market value, fools.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你认为你在[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的主场还玩得过我们吗？[Root.GetName]掌管着整个星系。
entries.en: You think you can beat the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] at our own game, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? The [Root.GetName] runs this galaxy.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesClassPlural]，如果你不是我们的客户的话，那你就是我们的敌人了。
entries.en: If you're not a client you're the competition, [Root.GetSpeciesClassPlural].

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesClassPlural]，我就明说了，我们从来都不喜欢你们……
entries.en: Cards on the table, [Root.GetSpeciesClassPlural], we never really liked you...

entries.zh: [From.GetName]已对[Root.GetName]实施了贸易禁运，限制今后所有的交易。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] has issued a trade embargo against the [Root.GetName], restricting all transactions henceforth.

entries.zh: 是时候为这星系做点好事了，把你的这些垃圾货都从市场给打扫出去。
entries.en: It's time we did the galaxy a service and rid the market of your cheap, off-brand knockoffs.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]与[Root.GetSpeciesClassPlural]之间的贸易没有理由不成功。
entries.en: There is no reason why trade between the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and the [Root.GetSpeciesClassPlural] should not flourish.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesClassPlural]你们都一样。你们都为了[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的商品而来……
entries.en: You [From.GetSpeciesClassPlural] are all the same. You all come crawling back for [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] product...

entries.zh: 我们保留拒绝向一切[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]提供服务的权利。
entries.en: We reserve the right to refuse service to all [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你难道不觉得无意义的争吵对于生意来说毫无帮助吗？
entries.en: This pointless squabble is bad for business, don't you think, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?

entries.zh: 等等！合并也许会影响到[Root.GetAdj]的品牌……
entries.en: Hold on! A merger might compromise the integrity of the [Root.GetAdj] brand...

entries.zh: 接管已完成。[Root.GetName]接下来将与[From.GetName]合并。
entries.en: The takeover is complete. The [Root.GetName] will now merge with the [From.GetName].

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]白手起家一步一个脚印才让[Root.GetAdj]有了今天的成就，这一切我们是不会忘记的。
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] resolve and work ethic built the [Root.GetAdj] franchise from the ground up. We will never forget who we are.
Are you having second thoughts regarding the merger, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?

entries.zh: [Root.GetAdj]的品牌将不会发生任何改变……
entries.en: So the integrity of the [Root.GetAdj] brand will remain intact...

entries.zh: 请确认你们希望加入[From.GetName]防御条约的请求。
entries.en: Please confirm your request to enter a defensive pact with the [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 你是否愿意加入星系第一的军备供应商的防御条约？
entries.en: How would you like to enter into a defensive pact with one of the galaxy's number one suppliers of armaments?

entries.zh: 我们的计算显示这里面大有可图，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。让我们一同面对敌人吧。
entries.en: Our calculations show there is great strength in numbers, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Let us stand united against our enemies.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们的生意只归我们自己管。[Root.GetSpeciesName]都只为了他们自己而活！
entries.en: Our business is our own, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. It's every [Root.GetSpeciesName] for himself!

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]谈的是生意不是慈善。[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你必须学会保障自己的利益。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] is a business, not a charity. You must learn to fend for yourselves, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 请确认你希望终止[Root.GetAdj]-[From.GetAdj]防御条约的请求。
entries.en: Please confirm your request to terminate the [Root.GetAdj]-[From.GetAdj] defensive arrangement.

entries.zh: 由于你无法完成防御条约的要求，我们决定终止条约。
entries.en: Due to persistent failure on your part to meet with defensive pact requirements, we hereby terminate said agreement.

entries.zh: 由于你选择终止[Root.GetAdj]-[From.GetAdj]之间的条约，我们现收回一切军事援助。
entries.en: In accordance with your wish to terminate the [Root.GetAdj]-[From.GetAdj] defensive arrangement, we now withdraw all military support.

entries.zh: 请确认与[Root.GetSpeciesName]签署互不侵犯条约的请求。
entries.en: Please confirm you request to form a non-aggression pact with the [Root.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 为了保护我们交界区域的自由贸易，[From.GetName]希望与我们签订互不侵犯条约。
entries.en: In the interest of securing free trade in our joint sector [From.GetName] would like to propose a non-aggression treaty.

entries.zh: 根据我们的预测，[From.GetName]与[Root.GetName]保持和平的话，能够有效促进双方的经济增长。那么我们在哪里签字？
entries.en: Our revenue projections do indeed confirm that a mutual peace between the [From.GetName] and the [Root.GetName] is financially beneficial to both parties. Where do we sign?

entries.zh: 很抱歉通知你们[From.GetAdj]-[Root.GetAdj]之间的互不侵犯条约将会限制[Root.GetAdj]将来的扩张计划。
entries.en: We regret to inform you that a [From.GetAdj]-[Root.GetAdj] non-aggression pact does not align with [Root.GetAdj] future expansion goals.

entries.zh: 你打算危害我们之间的安全吗？
entries.en: You wish to jeopardize our mutual safety?

entries.zh: 亲爱的，[From.GetName]。我们很抱歉通知你们我们将终止[Root.GetAdj]-[From.GetAdj]的互不侵犯条约，立马生效。
entries.en: Dear, [From.GetName]. We regret to inform you that we are terminating the [Root.GetAdj]-[From.GetAdj] non-aggression pact, effective immediately.

entries.zh: 很好，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们以后可能会考虑一个更加激进的扩张计划了。
entries.en: Very well, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We may have to consider a more aggressive expansion plan in the future.

entries.zh: 你们对[Root.GetAdj]这一品牌的忠诚让我们十分感动，这一举动融化了我们冰冷的心。你们真是不可多得的忠实客户！
entries.en: Your devotion to the integrity of the [Root.GetAdj] brand makes our cold corporate hearts melt. You truly are our most loyal customers!

entries.zh: 尊敬的客户你好啊！我们很在乎你们的感受！事实上为了庆祝我们之间的友谊我们派出了一只舰队保护你们的独立自主权！[From.GetAdj]舰队现在听你指挥！
entries.en: Valued customers! We care! In fact, we would like to celebrate our mutual friendship by supporting your independence from aggressors! The [From.GetAdj] fleet is now at your disposal!

entries.zh: 感谢您的帮助，我们可以确保将位于[Root.GetName]的商品送达您的手中。这些东西配你简直太值当了！
entries.en: Thank you for helping us ensure that we here at [Root.GetName] can continue to deliver the quality products upon which you have come to rely. Because you're worth it!

entries.zh: 等等，好好想想。如果我们不复存在了，谁来给你送去那些你需要的优质商品呢？
entries.en: Hold on, think about it. Who's going to deliver the quality products upon which you have come to rely if we're no longer around?

entries.zh: 很遗憾[From.GetName]无法再保障[Root.GetAdj]的独立性了。我们希望你们未来一切顺利。
entries.en: Regrettably the [From.GetName] can no longer guarantee [Root.GetAdj] independence. We wish you the best of luck in your future endeavors, as you will surely need it.

entries.zh: 请援助我们的众筹活动，以表示你支持[Root.GetAdj]独立！
entries.en: Please confirm your support for [Root.GetAdj] independence by backing our crowdfunding campaign!

entries.zh: 客户的未来就是我们[From.GetName]的利益，我们将支持你们的独立。
entries.en: We here at [From.GetName] have a vested interest in the future of our clients and will back your independence.

entries.zh: 我们[Root.GetName]感谢你们支持[Root.GetAdj]独立。
entries.en: We at [Root.GetName] thank you for interest in [Root.GetAdj] independence.

entries.zh: 你是否希望撤回对[Root.GetAdj]独立的支持？
entries.en: Do you wish to retract your support for [Root.GetAdj] independence?

entries.zh: 遗憾的是，我们必须撤回对[Root.GetAdj]独立的支持。衷心祝愿您在今后的事业中一切顺利。
entries.en: Regrettably we must retract our support for [Root.GetAdj] independence. We wish you the best of luck in your future endeavors as you will surely need it.
We are sorry to hear that, [From.GetAllianceName].

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]急需商业头脑，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]能为[Root.GetName]提供些什么？
entries.en: The [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] business acumen is high in demand. What can the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] offer the [Root.GetName]?

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！我们邀请你们参加我们的人才交流计划。我们发现，允许人们在星球之间自由迁徙，对经济增长有着很好的作用。
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We would like to invite you to our talent exchange program. We have found that free migration of people between worlds can be highly beneficial to a growing economy.

entries.zh: 我们的预测表明，允许生命资本在我们的星球之间自由流通对于经济发展来说是不可或缺的。让我们的人才开始流通吧！
entries.en: Our projections suggest a free exchange of living capital between our worlds is imperative for economic advancement. Commence the brain drain!

entries.zh: 我们的招聘部门目前不对外招聘。
entries.en: Our talent acquisition department is not currently recruiting externally.

entries.zh: 我们不会允许我们的工人位于错误的经济岗位。
entries.en: We will not allow for the economic dislocation of our workers.

entries.zh: 请确认你终止[Root.GetAdj]-[From.GetAdj]人才交流计划的请求。
entries.en: Please confirm your request to terminate the [Root.GetAdj]-[From.GetAdj] talent exchange program.

entries.zh: 我们发现[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]喋喋不休的[Root.GetSpeciesMouthName]严重影响了[From.GetAdj]的企业文化。
entries.en: We have found the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] with their blabbering [Root.GetSpeciesMouthName] to have a disruptive effect on [From.GetAdj] corporate culture.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]在此确认，立即终止[Root.GetAdj]-[From.GetAdj]人才交流计划。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] hereby confirms the discontinuation of the [Root.GetAdj]-[From.GetAdj] talent exchange program, effective immediately.

entries.zh: 开放你们的边境，并享受自由贸易的各种好处吧。
entries.en: Open your borders and partake in the many benefits of free trade.

entries.zh: 为了促进星系贸易自由，[From.GetName]现在将对你们开放边境。
entries.en: In the interest of promoting the liberalization of trade across the galaxy the [From.GetName] will now open its borders to you.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]感谢你为我们的贸易船开放边境。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] thanks you for opening your borders to our trade vessels.

entries.zh: 请谨慎考虑，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。保护主义将阻碍你们国家的经济发展与繁荣。
entries.en: Weigh your options carefully, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Protectionism will inhibit your nation's economic growth and welfare.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]将不再容忍[Root.GetAdj]舰船对[From.GetAdj]领地的侵犯。所有[Root.GetAdj]舰船必须立即离开[From.GetAdj]领地。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] will no longer tolerate [Root.GetAdj] intrusions into [From.GetAdj] space. All [Root.GetAdj] vessels are expected to vacate [From.GetAdj] territory immediately.

entries.zh: 星系贸易的自由化是大势所趋，你的保护主义政策只能是螳臂当车。
entries.en: Your protectionist policies will only serve to delay the inevitable liberalization of trade in the galaxy.

entries.zh: 请确认您将[Root.GetName]逐出§Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!的请求。请注意，[Root.GetName]将采取合法行动来保护自己的经济利益。
entries.en: Please confirm your request to exclude the [Root.GetName] from §Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!. Be advised that the [Root.GetName] will take legal action to protect its financial interests.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]遗憾地通知您，[From.GetAllianceName]董事会投票一致决定将[Root.GetName]逐出联盟。如有任何意见，请联系我们的法律顾问。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] regrets to inform you that the [From.GetAllianceName] board has voted unanimously to exclude the [Root.GetName] from the alliance. Please refer any complaints to our legal counsel.

entries.zh: 思维超前者的困境，就是他们的才华只会在事后才被认可。总有一天，人们会明白[Root.GetName]的真正商业天赋。
entries.en: The curse of the forward thinker is that their brilliance will only be recognized in hindsight. One day the true financial genius of the [Root.GetName] will be understood.

entries.zh: 请确认您希望邀请[Root.GetName]成为§Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!的合作国。
entries.en: Please confirm your intent to offer the [Root.GetName] association status with the §Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!.

entries.zh: 在经历了卓有成效的长期合作之后，我们很高兴邀请[Root.GetName]成为[From.GetAllianceName]的合作国。
entries.en: After a long and fruitful cooperation, we are pleased to finally offer the [Root.GetName] association status with the [From.GetAllianceName].

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]感激地接受成为§Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!合作国的邀请，希望我们能够开展长期的有利合作。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] graciously accepts your offer for association status with the §Y[From.GetAllianceName]§! and looks forward to a long and prosperous cooperation.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]当前没有与§Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!进行更密切合作的计划。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] is not currently open to closer association with the §Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!.

entries.zh: 请确认您希望撤销[Root.GetAdj]§Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!合作国地位。
entries.en: Please confirm your intention to revoke [Root.GetAdj] association status with the §Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]遗憾地通知您，因合作上存在分歧，董事会投票一致决定撤销[Root.GetAdj]§Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!合作国地位。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] regrets to inform you that the board has voted unanimously to withdraw [Root.GetAdj] association status with the §Y[From.GetAllianceName]§! due to inherent incompatibility.

entries.zh: 尽管我们对撤销[Root.GetAdj]§Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!合作国地位的这一决定表示惋惜，但我们仍将以合理的价格继续提供我们的服务。
entries.en: Though we are saddened by your decision to revoke [Root.GetAdj] association status with the §Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!, we will continue to offer our services at affordable prices.

entries.zh: 请确认您希望成为§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!的合作国的请求。
entries.en: Please confirm your request for association status with the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!.

entries.zh: 尊敬的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！为了进一步巩固我们的双边关系，我们提议成为§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!的合作国。
entries.en: Honored [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We propose strengthening our ties further by granting us association status with the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！[Root.GetName]荣幸地代表§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!宣布，您已获得§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!的合作国地位。
entries.en: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! On behalf of the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§! the [Root.GetName] is pleased to announce that you now have association status with the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!.

entries.zh: 我们遗憾地通知您，您希望成为§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!合作国的请求已被拒绝。
entries.en: Regrettably we must inform you that your request for association status with the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§! has been denied.

entries.zh: 请确认您希望放弃§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!的合作国地位的请求。
entries.en: Please confirm the renunciation of your association status with the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]在此宣布放弃§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!的合作国地位。如有意见，请联系我们的法律部门。
entries.en: Hereby the [From.GetName] renounces its association status with the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!. Please refer any complaints to our legal department.

entries.zh: 您的§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!的合作国地位已被撤销。
entries.en: Your association status with the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§! has been revoked.

entries.zh: 啊，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们最宝贵的伙伴！请问有何贵干？
entries.en: Ah, the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Our most treasured associates! To what do we owe the pleasure today?

entries.zh: 如果您对我们的服务有意见，请联系客服……
entries.en: Please contact customer support if you are dissatisfied with our service...

entries.zh: 你说什么，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？引擎声音太大了，听不清。我们正开着办公舰船兜风呢。
entries.en: What was that, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? We could not hear you over the roar of the engines. We were just taking the office jet out for a spin.

entries.zh: 我们[From.GetName]的鼻子对金钱非常敏感，而你们，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，浑身散发着绝望的恶臭。
entries.en: Here at [From.GetName] we have a nose for money and you, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], reek of desperation.

entries.zh: 我们会将死亡做成商品，并将卖给你们的[From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: We will merchandise death and sell it to your [From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural], [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 如果时间就是金钱，那么从你们的年度财报来看，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的死期快到了。
entries.en: If time is money, then judging by your annual report [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], yours is coming to an end.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]已是昨日黄花，[From.GetName]才真正属于未来。接受这一点并没什么难的。
entries.en: [Root.GetName] is yesterday's news, [From.GetName] the future. It's hardly rocket science.

entries.zh: 贸易比叫骂更有益，你永远无法动摇[From.GetSpeciesAdj]这一信念。
entries.en: You will never shake the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] conviction that more can be gained from trading goods than insults.

entries.zh: 你已经失去优势了，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。或许你们该跳出自己的思维定势？
entries.en: You have lost your edge, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Perhaps it is time to step out of your thinking-box?

entries.zh: 啊，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]……你们非常努力，可一直徒劳无功。有些人注定无法飞黄腾达。
entries.en: Ah, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]... You try so hard, yet persistently fail to move the needle. Some are just destined for mediocrity.

entries.zh: 叫骂与空头威胁是破产者的首选武器。而[Root.GetName]将以铁甲和火力保护自己的利益。
entries.en: Insults and empty threats are the insolvent's weapons of choice. The [Root.GetName] protects its interests with steel and firepower.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，如果你们想挑起争端，那么最好记住，打赢战争靠的是武器而不是嘴巴。
entries.en: If conflict is what you desire, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], you would do well to remember that war is won with weapons, not with words.

entries.zh: 啊，你来得正好！我们刚刚给我们的长程弹道导弹注册了§Y[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]必须死§!的商标。
entries.en: Ah, how lovely to hear from you! We just trademarked §Y[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] Must Die§! for our new long-range ballistic missile.

entries.en: §RNot possible to construct districts on this planet§!

entries.en: Sector type does not handle one or more of the resources.

entries.en: Country is not owner of the sector

entries.en: Show Sectors with no active focus.

entries.en: §HShow/Hide§!\nToggle if Sectors with no active focus will be shown.

entries.en: §RWe do not own the starbase in $SYSTEM|Y$.§!

entries.en: §R$SYSTEM|Y$ contains colonies owned by other empires.§!
Amount of resources stockpiled in your Empire.

entries.zh:
§H星域自动托管§!

设置星域焦点将为该星域中所有行星启用§H行星自动托管§!。

每颗行星将会自动依据§H规划类型§!进行发展。

具有§H自动殖民地规划类型§!的行星将会选择一个星域焦点相一致的规划类型。
entries.en:
§HSector Automation§! 

Setting a sector focus will enable §HPlanet Automation§! for all planets in this sector. 

Each planet will be automatically developed according to its §HDesignation§!. 

Planets with the §HAutomatic Colony Designation Selection§! will choose a designation that aligns with the sector focus.
